title: AI & Automation Lead (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.

lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.

We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.

Your Mission:

As AI & Automation Lead, you will establish and lead lemon.markets’ first dedicated AI function, making AI a safe, practical and measurable part of how the whole company works. Reporting directly to the VP Engineering and operating across the first line, you will identify high-value opportunities across Engineering, Finance, Operations, Compliance, Product, Sales, Partner Management and People and turn them into solutions that improve efficiency without compromising quality or control.

You will build on the foundations already being established, including a governed AI platform, an inventory of current use cases and an initial risk assessment aligned with the EU AI Act. A key part of your role will be creating the standards, measurement framework and decision processes that determine which use cases are scaled, improved or stopped.

Working closely with Engineering, Finance, Risk Management and Compliance, you will balance innovation with data protection, operational resilience, cost discipline and regulatory expectations. This is your opportunity to shape how a regulated financial company adopts AI responsibly, while building a function that leaves lasting capability across the organisation.

In this role you will

  • Lead the AI function and work with department heads across lemon.markets to identify, prioritise and deliver use cases that create measurable business value beyond Engineering.

  • Build a transparent, evidence-based portfolio of AI initiatives with business owners, baselines, success metrics and appropriate guardrails, ensuring that promising ideas become sustainable improvements.

  • Enable teams across the company to use AI effectively themselves by developing practical workflows, guidance and capabilities that reduce manual effort without creating dependency on the AI function.

  • Set the standards for our governed AI platform with Engineering, including model selection, evaluation, access controls, data protection, human approval points and reliable fallback processes.

  • Partner with Risk Management, Compliance and Finance to ensure AI use cases meet regulatory expectations, remain within agreed risk and cost boundaries, and receive the appropriate independent review and sign-off.

  • Establish a measurement framework that connects efficiency gains to quality, risk and customer outcomes, enabling clear decisions about when to scale, improve or stop an initiative.

  • Lead and grow a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists, setting priorities and using demonstrated demand and measurable impact to guide future investment.

You’ll be successful in this role if

  • You have shipped applied AI or data solutions into production and managed use cases from discovery through implementation, measurement and improvement.

  • You have driven adoption beyond Engineering, helping teams such as Finance, Operations, Compliance, Sales or Product improve how they work.

  • You have experience in a regulated or highly controlled environment and understand the importance of governance, independent scrutiny and clear lines of responsibility.

  • You are rigorous about measurement, establishing baselines, defining quality guardrails and assessing the full impact of a solution before scaling it.

  • You understand the economics of AI, including inference costs, model routing, evaluation and the difference between an assistant and an autonomous workflow.

  • You are technically credible and hands-on enough to work effectively with engineers, with a working understanding of topics such as retrieval, access controls, evaluation and AI security risks.

  • You take ownership and communicate clearly, challenging assumptions, stopping initiatives when the evidence does not support them and building trust with senior stakeholders and control functions.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and enjoy building a new function while balancing practical delivery with long-term standards.

  • You are fluent in English. Knowledge of German is a major advantage given our regulatory environment and our parent company.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

The role:

Join us as a Product Engineer to build a new product within Brevo called Brevo OS.

Brevo OS is a startup inside Brevo: a team of six, a product we started from an empty repository earlier this year, and the feel of a small company within the big one. The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.


Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate
  • Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it
  • Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job
  • Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations
  • Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible

descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in post-training methodologies, with a special focus on agentic behaviors and tool use. Your work will refine pre-trained models so that they not only deliver enhanced intelligence and domain specific capabilities, but also learn to reason, plan, and autonomously invoke external tools to solve real world, multi step tasks and applications on edge devices (i.e., smartphones).

You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from streamlined, resource efficient agents that run on limited hardware to complex multi modal architectures integrating text, images, and audio, all optimized for tool augmented decision making.

We expect you to have deep expertise in large language model architectures and substantial experience in post-training for agentic workflows, including tool use fine tuning, function calling, and reinforcement learning from feedback on multi turn interactions. You will adopt a hands-on, research driven approach to developing, testing, and implementing new post-training algorithms that unlock goal directed behavior, self correction, and reliable tool invocation.

Your responsibilities include curating agentic training data (e.g., trajectories of tool use, reasoning chains, environment interactions), strengthening baseline performance, and identifying as well as resolving bottlenecks in post-training for tool augmented agents to achieve SOTA model quality. The goal is to build models that do not just know but also act, use tools, and adapt, pushing the limits of what agentic AI can achieve.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering initiatives to advance post-training of agentic and tool-use models to achieve SOTA results.

  • Drive broad, cross-cutting model improvements, including factuality, instruction adherence, tool/function use, multi-agent coordination, and reasoning calibration.

  • Design and enhance large-scale post-training systems, including data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation frameworks, and benchmark infrastructure.

  • Develop rigorous evaluation suites and diagnostic tools to assess model readiness for deployment.

  • Strengthen feedback loops from real-world product usage, incorporating both explicit and implicit user signals into post-training.

  • Collaborate with tooling, product, and training teams to improve the usefulness, reliability, and agentic capabilities of frontier models.

  • Closely liaise with research, engineering and cross-functional teams to determine which integrations are production-ready for inclusion in major model releases.


  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; advanced degree (MS/PhD) preferred with a strong publication record in top-tier AI conferences.

  • Experience with multimodal post-training workflows and data pipelines, particularly for agentic systems and tool use.

  • Hands-on experience applying post-training at scale using distributed training frameworks (e.g., multi-node GPU environments).

  • Demonstrated experience improving model capabilities in areas such as reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent coordination that achieve SOTA results.

  • Proven track record of open-source contributions related to agentic systems or tool use (code, datasets, or models) on platforms such as GitHub or Hugging Face.

  • Publications at leading AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, ECCV).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: AI Solutions Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity.

As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference.

This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define!

What You'll Do

Discover and design

  • Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration

  • Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard

  • On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently

  • Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor

Build with AI, not instead of it

  • You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team

  • The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually

  • Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here

  • Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships

  • Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics

Deploy and prove value

  • Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in

  • Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting

  • Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team

  • Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves

  • Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer

  • Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations

  • Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer

  • You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed.

  • 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back

  • Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. You can point to a time you went well beyond what a client expected

  • A track record of doing something exceptionally well, whether that's work, academia, sport, or anything else you've put your mind to

  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture - how data models, primary keys, and integration sequencing interact across a dozen enterprise systems. You don't need to write the integration code, but you need to know why it breaks and be able to reason with the people who do, and you'll need to become an Omnea product expert

  • You build real relationships with people at any level, from a junior procurement analyst to a CFO, and know how to handle pushback and stakeholder politics, not just build rapport

  • Comfortable running rooms of stakeholders across a genuinely cross-functional tool - on a single project you'll interface with the CPO, Legal, Finance, AP, InfoSec, and Compliance, plus each of their technical resources, often all with competing priorities on the same decision

  • Comfortable moving between the detail and the big picture: configuring a workflow in the morning, presenting a project plan to an exec in the afternoon

  • Entrepreneurial, have high ownership, and want to be part of building something. We've signed up to the Future Founder Promise

  • An excellent communicator: clear and concise, verbal and written, even when the subject is complicated

  • Highly organised: comfortable running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently, each at a different stage, without dropping any of them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Associate Principal (European Competition practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

CRA's European Competition Practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation of effects and damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit http://ecp.crai.com.

Associate Principals have the unique opportunity to learn from, and work alongside, some of the most respected scholars, specialists, and industry experts in the world.  We tailor our analyses to the facts of each case, employing tools such as merger simulation, upward pricing pressure analysis, econometrics, bargaining theory, or game theory as needed. Whether before a court or a regulatory agency, CRA consultants set a high standard for the clear communication of sophisticated economic analysis in complex cases. You will have access to internal training programs focused on creative problem solving, communications, and leading and managing colleagues, teams and cases.  In addition, our firm offers extracurricular activities where you can take additional leadership roles in recruiting, training, and volunteer activities in the local community.

A typical Associate Principal would:

  • Work closely with leading academics and consulting with attorneys and other clients in industry and government on a wide variety of finance, strategy and economics issues;
  • Conduct research in a supportive, team-oriented environment;
  • Act as a primary point of contact for clients and assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables including expert reports summarizing our opinions, conclusions, and recommendations and third party financial, market and industry data;
  • Independently conceptualize and identify issues, design complex economic and financial models to analyze economic and financial data;
  • Oversee analysis in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, SAS, R or Python);
  • Manage the research process, and supervising, training and mentoring junior analysts;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions;
  • Work with those testifying in judicial proceedings to provide economic analyses of mergers and other competition matters before the major competition authorities of the world;
  • Assist with recruiting and training of new colleagues.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong achievement in a graduate degree program (Masters or PhD) with focused study in economics or a related discipline;
  • Extensive and relevant experience (6-9 years), economics/antitrust consulting experience preferred;
  • Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills;
  • Experience managing and developing teams of junior colleagues;
  • Executive client presence and interaction skills.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current contact information;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in London and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or academic paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

title: (Associate) Product Manager - Customer Lifecycle (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As an Associate Product Manager in the Customer Lifecycle domain, you will support the engine which makes sure our already onboarded customers have a positive experience on lifecycle events like re-KYC, account termination and customer service. Furthermore, you will be responsible for making sure lemon.markets delivers on its ongoing regulatory commitments. Your remit also covers owning the tooling which our operations colleagues use every day and making sure these evolve in sync with evolving regulatory landscape as well as business growth.

Reporting to the domain's Senior PM, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work cross-functionally at lemon.markets and regularly interface with stakeholders from varying functional backgrounds. To be successful in this role, you should be able to bring stakeholders on the same page and drive a coherent product strategy aimed at improving the efficiency of processes which kick-in during the lifecycle of a customer with lemon.markets while making sure lemon.markets adheres to its regulatory obligations.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for the problem space end-to-end - i.e. from problem framing through to release, adoption and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional team including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, and your colleagues in functions such as finance, risk and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off tactical fixes.

  • Interface regularly with your immediate customers and stakeholders to understand their pain points, capture feedback and use this information to shape your roadmap and product strategy.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in your problem space, and bring the insights back to the team and introduce informed iterations of your product strategy.

  • Write clearly and often - decision records, partner-facing specs, internal narratives. Writing is how decisions get made here.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 1-2 years of product experience, including independently shipping complex products. You take ownership of outcomes, not just features.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can define an unclear problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You are comfortable working through legal text. You form your own preliminary view on a legal or regulatory question before discussing it with experts, and you know which questions to bring to them.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and you iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You write clearly. Decisions, specs, and partner communication are a core part of this job, and you can make complex topics easy to follow on paper.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and actively explore how far they can take your output.

  • You are professionally fluent in English. However, German speakers would be preferred.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

title: B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) im Außendienst / Köln & Bonn
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Köln zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Als B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Franken für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

  • Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

  • Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

  • Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im Außendienst mit – idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Franken (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

  • Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

  • Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Unser Doctolib Parent Care Programm

  • Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen – darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

  • Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner

 

So sieht unser Interviewprozess aus

  1. Interview mit Talent Acquisition (Video Call – ca. 45 Minuten)

  2. Interview mit der/dem Regional Manager:in (Video Call – ca. 1 Stunde)

  3. DoctoDay (vor Ort in einem unserer Offices - ca. 1,5 Stunden): verbringe Zeit mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen praxisnahen Einblick in die Aufgaben eines Account Executives bei Doctolib

  4. Eine Referenzprüfung

  5. Unser Angebot an Dich

 

Job Details

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit (40h / Woche)

  • Außendienst in der Region Köln, Bonn

  • Startdatum: so schnell wie möglich

 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte hier.

Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

title: Bachelor / Master Facility Management (m/w/d) I Hightech-Produktionsstandort
descriptionHtml:
Erfolgreicher Facility-Service-Dienstleister sucht einen ambitionierten und persönlich überzeugenden Manager* zur gesamtverantwortlichen Betreuung seines internationalen Kunden aus der Halbleiterindustrie.

Sie stellen die vertragskonforme operative Leistungserbringung der einzelnen Services am Standort Berlin sicher. Zwei Bereichsverantwortliche (TGM und IFM) und ein leistungsstarkes Team unterstützen Sie dabei.

Ihr Anspruch: Hohe Kundenzufriedenheit und langfristige Partnerschaft

  • Services: Technische Dienstleistungen (TGM), Gebäudereinigung, Grün- und Grauflächenpflege, Winterdienst, Transport- und Logistikdienste, Helpdesk, Schädlingsbekämpfung & weitere Services

  • Arbeitsort: Berlin

  • Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (Mo-Fr, freie Wochenenden und freie Feiertage)

Aufgaben

Was auf Sie zukommt…

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Sicherstellung der ordnungsgemäßen sowie reibungslosen Vertragserfüllung hinsichtlich der mit dem Kunden vertraglich vereinbarten Facility-Service-Leistungen

  • Zentraler Ansprechpartner* für alle vertragsrelevanten Themen und Anliegen des Kunden

  • Kontinuierliche Bedarfsanalyse, Entwicklung, Präsentation und aktive Umsetzung von neuen, maßgeschneiderten Service-Lösungen am Standort

  • Die Sicherstellung der Durchführung von regelmäßigen Leistungs-, Qualitäts- und Erfolgskontrollen haben für Sie oberste Priorität

  • Die Gestaltung und nachhaltige Umsetzung von Prozessoptimierungen sind für Sie 'Daily Business'

  • Sie tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für die Wirtschaftlichkeit und Effizienz der Services am Standort - laufende Budgetkontrolle und frühzeitige Einleitung von wirksamen Maßnahmen bei Budgetabweichung, regelmäßiges Reporting

  • Intensive persönliche Kontaktpflege zu den Kundenansprechpartnern* vor Ort, Weiterentwicklung des Standorts und proaktiver Ausbau des Bestandsgeschäfts durch zusätzliche Service-Leistungen

  • Verantwortung für die übergeordnete Führung und Steuerung eines leistungsstarken Teams (ca. 50 Mitarbeitende gesamt, 2 'Direct Reports‘ TGM / IFM), Personalauswahl, -einsatz, Einarbeitung, Personalentwicklung, Trainings und Schulungen etc.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen…

  • Studium / Weiterbildung im Bereich Facility Management, Gebäudemanagement oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Leitungsfunktion im Gebäudemanagement - Sie haben bereits als Objektleiter*, Site Manager*, Betriebsleiter*, Facility Manager* große Objekte mit Produktionsumgebung im TGM / IFM erfolgreich gemanagt

  • Praxiserfahrung in der Steuerung von Veränderungsprozessen wünschenswert

  • Ausgeprägte Qualitäts-, Service- u. Kundenorientierung - Sie sind ein Manager* mit hoher Lösungskompetenz und Hands-on-Mentalität und leben den 'Multiservice-Gedanken'

  • Auch in schwierigen oder stressigen Situationen sind Sie 'Dienstleister'* durch und durch und bewahren aufgrund Ihrer Organisationsstärke stets einen kühlen Kopf

  • Sie kommunizieren proaktiv - auf allen Ebenen verständlich, überzeugend und immer lösungsorientiert, zeigen wenn`s drauf ankommt das nötige Maß an Verhandlungsstärke und Fingerspitzengefühl

  • Betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenz, Zahlenaffinität, starkes unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln

  • Als starke Führungspersönlichkeit sind Sie Vorbild für Ihre Mitarbeitenden, führen als Teamplayer* stets kooperativ, motivierend und wertschätzend

  • Einen routinierten Umgang mit PC und den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen, Erfahrung mit einem CAFM-System vorteilhaft

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Was Ihr neuer Arbeitgeber Ihnen bietet…

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche und sehr verantwortungsvolle Führungsaufgabe im Facility Management

  • Berufliche und private Sicherheit durch einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Mo-Fr, freie Wochenenden und freie Feiertage) für eine bessere Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben

  • Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket (solides Grundgehalt, Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld als 13. Monatsgehalt zzgl. einer erfolgsabhängigen Bonus-/Prämienregelung), Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, 30 Tage Urlaub, Mitarbeiter-Rabatte bei diversen Vertragspartnern, Teilnahme an der Mitarbeiterverpflegung, Mobiles Arbeitsequipment…

  • Einen Dienstwagen zur Privatnutzung

  • Eine strukturierte und umfassende Einarbeitung

  • Förderprogramme zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Einen sicheren und langfristigen Arbeitsplatz bei einem erfolgreichen Facility-Service-Dienstleister mit wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur

Jetzt sind Sie dran…

Lust mehr zu erfahren?

Dann freue ich mich auf unseren Austausch.

Diskret. Persönlich. Auf Augenhöhe.

title: Backend/API Engineer, Money as a Service (Product)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Organization 

Money as a Service (MaaS) oversees a diverse portfolio of Stripe's core platforms and services. Our Stripe Treasury suite helps users manage and move their funds with ease, providing the robust financial infrastructure and tools they need to power their businesses on a global scale.

Team Matching: exact team matching for one of the subteams within this org will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different orgs based on your experience, location, etc. More information on our team matching process can be found here. 

What you’ll do

We’re looking for Backend Engineers who want to make an impact on managing money at a global scale with a passion for building ergonomic APIs. You’ll play a key role in extending our foundational Money Management APIs and services powering our Treasury products globally. Our team collaborates with many cross-functional teams – from Infrastructure to Product Manager – at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs.

Responsibilities

  • Scope, design, build, and maintain APIs, services, and large-scale systems that reliably and efficiently handle billions of money movement requests
  • Debug and solve critical production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack
  • Mentor engineers to help them grow
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the company to build new features at large-scale, while improving internal engineering standards, tooling, and processes
  • Collaborate effectively in a distributed and hybrid team, maintaining open communication and strong connections with colleagues

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2-12+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships nor includes co-ops)
  • Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic)
  • Strong collaboration skills, can work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers’ success
  • Have the ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy, responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial
  • Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale financial tracking systems
  • Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud based services (e.g. gRPC, GraphQL, Docker/Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.)

title: Full-Stack Developer (PHP/Laravel & React), 80 - 100 % (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Konova AG bietet mit der SaaS-Lösung «E-Mitwirkung» öffentlichen Verwaltungen eine innovative Plattform, um Rückmeldungen aus der Bevölkerung und von Organisationen effizient und zeitgemäss einzuholen und auszuwerten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die sich im Backend und im Frontend zu Hause fühlt, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und die Plattform in einem Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen aktiv mitgestaltet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Plattform mit PHP/Laravel und React

  • Umsetzung innovativer Funktionen, beispielsweise KI-Integrationen, Online-Kollaboration und intelligente Datenauswertung

  • Mitarbeit bei technischen Entscheidungen und der Spezifikation neuer Features in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von REST-APIs, Datenbankmodellen und Geschäftslogik

  • Entwicklung benutzerfreundlicher, performanter und wartbarer Benutzeroberflächen mit React

  • Sicherheitsbewusste Entwicklung, gegenseitige Code Reviews sowie Schreiben und Pflegen automatisierter Tests

  • Mitarbeit an CI/CD-Pipelines und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse

Unser Tech-Stack

PHP 8.4, Laravel 12, React 18, TypeScript, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Sentry

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Full-Stack-Bereich

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und React in produktiven Anwendungen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Laravel oder einem vergleichbaren PHP-Framework

  • Sicherer Umgang mit JavaScript, REST-APIs und relationalen Datenbanken

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests, Git und CI/CD-Prozessen

  • Verständnis für saubere Softwarearchitektur, wartbaren Code und sicherheitsbewusste Entwicklung

  • Erfahrung mit Docker; Kenntnisse in Kubernetes sind ein Plus

  • Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Tools sinnvoll und verantwortungsbewusst im Entwicklungsalltag einzusetzen

  • Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und kommunikative Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen Team

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse und Wohnsitz in der Schweiz

Benefits

  • Du entwickelst eine Plattform weiter, die von öffentlichen Verwaltungen und tausenden von Einwohnenden genutzt wird, digitale demokratische Prozesse unterstützt und einen echten Mehrwert für die Gesellschaft schafft.

  • Deine Ideen sind willkommen. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen mitprägen und Verantwortung für deine Lösungen übernehmen.

  • Du arbeitest an der gesamten Anwendung – von der Datenbank über die API bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.

  • Direkte Kommunikation, pragmatische Entscheidungen und keine unnötigen Hierarchien oder endlosen Meetings.

  • Raum, um Neues auszuprobieren, Technologien kennenzulernen und deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.

  • Marktgerechte Entlöhnung und flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Modell – remote und in unserem Büro in der Stadt Zug.

Klingt nach dir?

Du entwickelst gerne durchdachte Lösungen, fühlst dich mit PHP und React wohl und möchtest mit deiner Arbeit etwas bewegen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Bewirb dich direkt über das Formular und erzähl uns kurz, weshalb du gut zu unserem Team passt.

Bei Fragen steht dir Samuel Hauser, Teamleiter Entwicklung, gerne zur Verfügung.

Wir besetzen diese Stelle ausschliesslich direkt. Anfragen von Personalvermittlern und Headhuntern werden nicht berücksichtigt.

title: Beleidsadviseur Cultuur en Participatie | Publieke Sector
descriptionHtml:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor een onafhankelijke publieke organisatie in de culturele sector op zoek naar een Beleidsadviseur Cultuur en Participatie.

Deze organisatie ondersteunt een onafhankelijke adviesraad die bestuurders en volksvertegenwoordigers adviseert over vraagstukken rondom cultuurbeleid, cultuurparticipatie en de ontwikkeling van de culturele sector. Vanuit een zelfstandige en objectieve positie levert het bureau onderzoek, analyses en beleidsadviezen waarmee ontwikkelingen, knelpunten en kansen binnen het culturele landschap inzichtelijk worden gemaakt.

Als beleidsadviseur vervul je een centrale rol in het ophalen, analyseren en vertalen van signalen uit de culturele praktijk.   • Je zorgt voor een objectieve en zorgvuldige vertaling van signalen uit het culturele veld naar beleidsmatige aanbevelingen.


Wat vragen wij?

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Cultuurwetenschappen, Kunstbeleid, Communicatiewetenschappen of een vergelijkbare richting.

title: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit, Stabilität und Transparenz im Herzen unserer Organisation.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die korrekte Buchführung und die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem vielseitigen Unternehmensumfeld. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle, begleitest steuerliche Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte.

In einem schlanken, dynamischen Team bringst du deine Sorgfalt, dein Fachwissen und deine Hands-on-Mentalität ein und trägst damit wesentlich zur finanziellen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation bei.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.

Deine Chance

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussexpertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld einzubringen.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die sachgerechte Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen, die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und die Mitwirkung an internen Berichtsprozessen. title: Sales Manager Cyber Security (m/w/d) – Aufbau Neukundengeschäft
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Cyber Security entscheidet heute über die Zukunftsfähigkeit von Unternehmen. Als Sales Manager (m/w/d) für unsere Cyber-Security-Beratung erschließt du neue Kundenbeziehungen, vertiefst bestehende Partnerschaften und identifizierst konkrete Geschäftschancen für unsere Beratungsleistungen.

Deine Stärke ist es, Menschen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Vertrauen aufzubauen und gemeinsam mit unseren Solution Managern passgenaue Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln. Dein Ziel: echten Bedarf frühzeitig erkennen, qualifizierte Opportunities aufbauen und realistische Budgets verhandeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst aktiv neue Kundenbeziehungen im Offline-Vertrieb und baust unser Netzwerk systematisch aus.

  • Du knüpfst neue Kontakte, organisierst Erstgespräche und führst überzeugende Ice-Breaker-Pitches durch.
  • Du qualifizierst potenzielle Leads hinsichtlich Bedarf, konkreten Herausforderungen, Entscheidungsstrukturen, Zeitplanung und Budget.
  • Du lieferst vorqualifizierte Business Opportunities an unser Management und unsere Solution Manager.
  • Du begleitest Kontakte kontinuierlich vom ersten Austausch bis zur konkreten Opportunity und stellst ein konsequentes Follow-up sicher.
  • Du nimmst an relevanten Fachveranstaltungen, Branchen-Events und Networking-Formaten teil.
  • Du analysierst Events im Vorfeld, identifizierst für uns relevante Kontakte und sprichst diese gezielt an.
  • Du entwickelst unseren bestehenden Sales-Prozess weiter und machst Vertriebsaktivitäten messbarer und effizienter.
  • Du arbeitest als Sparringspartner eng mit Marketing, Management und Solution Managern zusammen.
  • Du gibst Markt- und Kundenfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebs- und Beratungsangebots zurück.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung neuer Kunden und im Aufbau belastbarer Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Ein eigenes, für unser Geschäft relevantes Netzwerk sowie die Fähigkeit, dieses kontinuierlich auszubauen.
  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Ansprache und Vorqualifizierung potenzieller Kunden.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für den Markt des Security Consulting und die Abgrenzung zum Vertrieb von Security-Produkten.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Bedarf, Needs und Budgets potenzieller Kunden strukturiert zu erfassen und realistisch einzuschätzen.
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Freude an persönlichen Kundenterminen, Networking und Events.
  • Ausgeprägte soziale Kompetenz und ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner.
  • Die Fähigkeit, dich auf Menschen, Rollen, Branchen und Gesprächssituationen flexibel einzustellen.
  • Ein modernes, digitales und unternehmerisches Mindset.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du musst nicht zu jedem Kunden bereits die fertige Lösung präsentieren. Deine Aufgabe ist es, Interesse zu wecken, relevante Gespräche zu eröffnen und echte Herausforderungen zu erkennen.

Wir suchen deshalb eine Persönlichkeit, die:

  • Einen überzeugenden Ice-Breaker-Pitch beherrscht
  • Nicht versucht, vorschnell eine dedizierte Solution zu verkaufen
  • Aufmerksam zuhört und die richtigen Fragen stellt
  • Vertrauen aufbaut, ohne aufdringlich zu wirken
  • Auch komplexe Cyber-Security-Themen verständlich vermitteln kann
  • Kontakte nicht nur sammelt, sondern nachhaltig entwickelt

Unser Vergütungsmodell

Wir bieten dir ein transparentes und leistungsorientiertes Vergütungsmodell:

  • 60.000 bis 70.000 € fixes Jahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation.
  • Ein variabler Vergütungsanteil von rund 40 % auf Basis klar definierter Vertriebsziele.
  • Bei Überperformance ist eine Gesamtzielerreichung von bis zu 150 % möglich.
  • Ein Firmenwagen wird gestellt.
  • Die Provision wird quartalsweise ausgezahlt.
  • Im ersten Quartal gleichen wir den noch nicht vorhandenen Provisionsanteil durch eine Aufstockung des Fixgehalts aus.

Warum du zu uns kommen solltest

  • Du baust einen wichtigen Vertriebsbereich in einem zukunftskritischen Markt aktiv mit auf.
  • Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum bei Kundenansprache, Netzwerkaufbau und Prozessentwicklung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Solution Managern, Marketing und Management zusammen.
  • Du verkaufst keine beliebigen Produkte, sondern hilfst Unternehmen, ihre Cyber Security strategisch und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Deine Kontakte, Ideen und Erfolge werden sichtbar und wertgeschätzt.
  • Du profitierst von einem attraktiven Fixgehalt, einer leistungsorientierten Provision und einem Firmenwagen.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Du erkennst dich in dieser Rolle wieder und möchtest Cyber-Security-Consulting gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und einigen Sätzen zu deinen bisherigen Erfolgen im B2B-Vertrieb, deinem relevanten Netzwerk und deiner Motivation für den Bereich Cyber Security.

title: Business Intelligence Data Architect
descriptionHtml:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.

In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.

If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:

  • Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.
  • Build governed data models and semantic layers: Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish analytics engineering best practices: Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Enable secure, reliable data access: Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.
  • Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.
  • Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You

  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.
  • Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.
  • Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.
  • Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.
  • Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
  • Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.
  • You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…
