title: Business Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Engineer C2

Team: Product & Tech Business Operations

Salary: £45,600 - £57,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Business Operations

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work inthe UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

You'll own and evolve the technical systems that power P&T Business Operations — Jira architectures, data pipelines, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise platforms. You identify where operational capability could be stronger, scope those opportunities, and design and build solutions in collaboration with the Business Operations Manager. You approach problems with an AI-first mindset and make technical decisions with clarity about trade-offs.

  • Own and evolve the standardisation of Jira and other Kaluza data systems. Configure, extend, and redesign them to support increasingly complex business operations.

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and dashboards that turn raw operations data into clear signals for decision-making. Explore where AI agents and autonomous systems can streamline operations.

  • Identify opportunities for new capabilities (better delivery planning data & tooling capabilities, improved management insights solutions, plugging into adjacent Kaluza products) and design and build solutions, aligned with the direction from the business operations manager who will lead the product & delivery enablement side of things

  • Connect and integrate internal products and platforms — Workday integrations, locally-built internal tools, and other solutions. Make recommendations on what to build, integrate, or take over — clearly articulating trade-offs, impact, and delivery path.

  • Anticipate security, compliance, and regulatory constraints upfront. Navigate Kaluza's systems to unblock delivery quickly.

  • Spot when something's off — in the data, in a process, or in a tool — and fix it before it becomes someone else's problem.

  • Iterate on our operational tooling continuously, testing new approaches early and sharing what you learn openly with the team.


What you'll bring

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • 3–5 years building and maintaining operational tooling — not just writing code, but owning what you ship.

  • Strong Jira expertise (including JQL) and Confluence; comfortable configuring them for complex portfolio structures.

  • Experience with APIs/integrations and data exchange, SQL + basic scripting, BI tools, AI tools and automation.

  • Experience building data pipelines or automated workflows with practical understanding of keeping them reliable at scale.

  • Confident in identifying improvements and implementing them independently. You break down ambiguous problems, scope solutions, and drive delivery without constant prompting. You don't wait to be told what's next.

  • Comfortable with data analysis, ambiguity, and working in scaling organisations where processes and systems need to grow as fast as the people using them.

  • You navigate Kaluza's systems to move fast. You share progress openly and communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

What will set you apart:

  • You're the kind of person who spots a constraint, maps it back to its root cause, and builds a fix (or identifies where a temporary workaround is needed, whilst you work on a fix). You set a high bar for your own work and raise it over time, and you're not satisfied leaving a system in a worse state than you found it.

  • You work openly by default: you share progress, flag blockers early, and communicate what's working and what isn't without waiting to be asked. People across the organisation find it easy to understand what you're doing and why.

  • You're genuinely curious about new tools and approaches — especially AI — and you actively bring others along by sharing what you've tried, what landed, and what didn't. Learning in the open comes naturally to you.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Category Management Werkstudent (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale perfekt mit den besten lokalen und internationalen Produkten ausgestattet sind – und das immer frisch und zu den besten Preisen.

Als WerkstudentIn (m/w/d) bist du das operative Rückgrat dieses Teams und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in den E-Commerce und den FMCG-Bereich (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods). Du tauchst tief in Daten ein, unterstützt bei der Sortimentsgestaltung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte in der App optimal präsentiert werden. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Category Managern sowie cross-funktionalen Teams (wie Supply Chain und Marketing) zusammen, pflegst wichtige Stammdaten und hilfst dabei, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist. Mit deinem analytischen Denken und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse zudem jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser.

Das erwartet dich

  • Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft: Du hilfst unseren Category Managern bei operativen und administrativen Aufgaben im E-Commerce-Alltag – von der Ein- und Auslistung von Produkten bis hin zur Überprüfung von Datenblättern.
  • App & Content Pflege: Du bist mitverantwortlich für den In-App Content deiner Produktkategorien. Du sorgst dafür, dass Artikelbeschreibungen, Bilder und Promotions immer up-to-date sind und unseren KundInnen ein Lächeln ins Gesicht zaubern.
  • Daten & Analysen: Du wertest Verkaufszahlen, Kundenfeedback und Markttrends aus, erkennst Muster und hilfst dem Team dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zur Sortimentsoptimierung zu treffen.
  • Lieferanten- & Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du unterstützt bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung von Lieferantengesprächen und arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Teams wie Supply Chain und Customer Success zusammen.
  • Projektarbeit: Du bekommst die Chance, eigene, übergreifende Projekte zur Verbesserung unserer Tools und Prozesse zu übernehmen und so aktiv zur Unternehmensstrategie beizutragen."

Das bringst du mit

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Ein scharfes Auge fürs Detail, starkes logisches Denkvermögen und eine natürliche Neugier, um hinter die Kulissen zu blicken und operative Rätsel zu lösen.
  • Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.
  • Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software und automatisierten Systemen.
  • Zeit, unser Team für 16 - 20 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Ein moderner Workspace: Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.

descriptionHtml:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. title: CDI - Manager AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Au contact des dirigeants et des responsables métiers, vous définissez des dispositifs de montée en compétences, de construction d’agents et d’accompagnement au changement. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions : vous en garantissez la qualité, l’impact et la rentabilité, faites grandir vos équipes et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables.

Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre ambition : faire de l’IA un levier de transformation du travail, avec un impact concret, mesurable et durable sur les équipes et leur performance.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Conduire le cadrage avec L&D, RH, sponsors et métiers: définir populations cibles, priorités, objectifs observables et parcours différenciés.Concevoir une stratégie de démultiplication combinant sessions, contenus digitaux, coaching, champions et transfert aux équipes internes.Piloter un portefeuille de cas d'usage opérationnels: valeur, faisabilité, risque, capacité de build et séquencement des sprints.Organiser les ateliers de discovery et faire arbitrer les points de dépendance, d'accès ou de gouvernance par les interlocuteurs habilités.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Piloter budget, planning, staffing, qualité pédagogique et satisfaction ; réaliser les arbitrages nécessaires et faire grandir les équipes.Superviser les assets pédagogiques, animer les sessions à forte visibilité et garantir l'alignement entre exercices, capacités des plateformes et besoins métier.Superviser les solutions low-code/no-code, les standards, les jeux de tests, la documentation et les quality gates adaptés au périmètre technique et aux standards de la practice.Concevoir avec les Analytics Engineers l’architecture de reporting d’un programme, définir les standards de visualisation et de KPIs, coacher les équipes en data storytelling, superviser leurs dashboards et en piloter l’adoption.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Coordonner la mise en usage, la formation des utilisateurs et le handover client: relais managériaux, communautés, rituels et office hours.Piloter les boucles de feedback, les indicateurs de valeur et, si désigné, le plan de change sur une mission ciblée.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Définir des indicateurs de compétences, d'autonomie et d'usage; restituer les résultats aux sponsors et ajuster la démarche.Contribuer aux avant-ventes, estimations, chiffrages et propositions, en identifiant les extensions pertinentes chez les clients.Qualifier la nécessité d’un co-delivery avec Solutions Engineering ou la DSI, sans empiéter sur leurs autorités techniques.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision

5 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.Une expérience confirmée de pilotage de missions complexes et de management d’équipes, avec une responsabilité sur la qualité des livrables, les délais, les budgets et la satisfaction client.Une solide maîtrise des usages de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir, challenger et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et à guider les équipes dans leur construction.Une expérience dans la conception et le pilotage de dispositifs de montée en compétences et de programmes d’adoption de l’IA, ainsi que dans la transformation des processus, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.Une aisance dans la relation avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau, la capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes, faire grandir les consultants et contribuer au développement commercial.Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA).

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering).Piloter ce qui compte

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

Une trajectoire qui accélère 

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager
  3. Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un AI Builder Director
  4. Un role play AI Adoption Manager (45 / 60’) AI Builder Director ou un AI Builder Partner
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Manager Product Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 75 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 8 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

descriptionHtml:
Présentation département

L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon.

Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement.

Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement.

Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs.

Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR

Présentation de la ou les thématiques :

Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. Il implique plusieurs laboratoires du CNRS (INL, TIMA, IRISA, IETR, LIP6, LIRMM, LAMIH, IMS, Lab Hubert Curien, Lab-STICC…), le CEA-LIST, ainsi que de nombreux partenaires académiques et industriels.

Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) ingénieur(e) informatique / EDA chargé(e) de la qualification des outils, modèles et blocs IP utilisés et développés au sein de PHOENIX, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche, les doctorants et les partenaires industriels.

Description de la ou les missions / les activités

- Mettre en place, maintenir et faire évoluer l’environnement logiciel de conception (flow EDA) pour les partenaires du consortium PHOENIX (CAO, simulation, caractérisation, PDK, IP).
- Qualifier les outils EDA (commercials et open source), modèles de dispositifs et blocs IP : définition de bancs de tests, métriques de performance, protocoles d’évaluation et rapports de validation.
- Participer à l’intégration et à l’évaluation de méthodes d’EDA augmentées par l’IA (optimisation de flows, génération de modèles, analyse automatique de résultats, etc.).
- Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, interface avec les fournisseurs d’outils et les équipes IT locales).
- Contribuer à la rédaction de livrables techniques du projet : documents de spécification, rapports de qualification, guides d’utilisation des outils et IP.
- Mettre en place de bonnes pratiques pour la gestion de versions, la traçabilité des résultats, l’automatisation des flows (scripts, CI/CD, conteneurisation).
- Participer à la veille technologique sur les outils EDA, les librairies IP, les technologies de calcul avancées et proposer des évolutions du parc logiciel.



Profil recherché / Compétences attendues________________________________

Diplômes : Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master 2 ou doctorat en informatique, microélectronique ou domaine proche.
Expérience : Débutant accepté

Compétences opérationnelles :

- Solides compétences en EDA (front-end et/ou back-end) : RTL, synthèse, P&R, extraction, simulation (SPICE, mixed-signal, etc.), PDK, caractérisation.
- Maîtrise de scripts et automatisation (Python, Shell, Make, ou équivalent) et aisance avec les environnements Linux.
- Connaissance souhaitée des architectures matérielles pour l’IA, des technologies émergentes ou de la conception de chiplets.
- Intérêt marqué pour la qualité logicielle et la validation : tests, métriques, reproductibilité, documentation.
- Excellent sens de la communication et du travail en équipe dans un environnement multi-sites et pluridisciplinaire.
- Maîtrise du français et bonne pratique de l’anglais technique (échanges avec partenaires et fournisseurs, rédaction de rapports).

title: Clinical AI Research Lead
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

  • Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud environments, including managed Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) so all environments are reproducible and version-controlled.

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure and application builds, testing, and deployment.

  • Manage container platforms and orchestration, including Kubernetes cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, and workload scheduling.

  • Set up and maintain observability (metrics, logging, alerting) to detect and resolve issues before they affect engineering or operations.

  • Enforce security and compliance best practices, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and vulnerability patching.

  • Support audits and compliance evidence collection for SecNumCloud and other applicable frameworks.

  • Define backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies for critical data and services.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable infrastructure solutions.

What we would love to see from you

  • 3+ years of experience in a cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering role.

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS or GCP, including compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

  • Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and version control workflows.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts: VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, DNS, and VPNs.

  • Working knowledge of containers and orchestration, ideally Kubernetes.

  • Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Willingness to learn sovereign and high-assurance cloud security requirements, and to apply them to cloud environments. Prior exposure is a plus but not required.

  • A security-first mindset with practical knowledge of IAM, secrets management, encryption, and compliance frameworks.

  • Fluent English. Working knowledge of French is not required but is considered an advantage.

  • Ability to work effectively in a multilingual team.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the aerospace, defense, or mission-critical systems domain.

  • Experience with multi-region or disaster recovery architectures.

  • Experience with hybrid or multi-cloud architectures across AWS and sovereign cloud providers.

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer - Professional) or equivalent.

  • Exposure to ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or other security certification environments.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

title: Communications Lead
descriptionHtml:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

Our Marketing team shapes how the world sees and experiences Attio. We think strategically, move fast, and obsess over quality — from acquisition to brand to product marketing. We experiment constantly, craft clear narratives, and focus relentlessly on what drives growth.

CRM is entering a new era. AI is changing how companies go to market, and Attio is building the platform at the centre of that shift.

We’re looking for a Communications Lead to shape how Attio tells that story — defining the narratives, ideas, and perspectives that build our position as the category evolves.

Your primary focus will be shaping Attio’s narrative and building the communications strategy that brings it to life — across our own channels and through the people and platforms that influence how Attio is understood.

You’ll work across the company to uncover what’s interesting, turn complex ideas into compelling stories, and build a communications engine that grows Attio’s influence alongside the business.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional storyteller with strong editorial instincts, a deep understanding of technology and culture, and the ambition to help define how a new generation thinks about CRM.

What you’ll do

Narrative & positioning: Own Attio’s company narrative and the stories, ideas, and perspectives we want to be known for.

Content: Turn our narrative into distinctive content and programs across Attio’s owned channels.

Founder & executive communications: Shape the voices and external presence of our founders and leadership team across social, content, media, and events.

PR & earned media: Build relationships with journalists and media, creating opportunities for others to tell Attio’s story.

Employee & internal comms: Help our team understand and tell Attio’s story through internal communications, employer brand, and employee advocacy.

Company announcements: Lead communications for major moments including fundraising, company news, launches, and other key milestones.

What you’ll bring

Communications experience: 7+ years across communications, content, editorial, PR, or brand, ideally within high-growth startups.

Exceptional storytelling: You can turn complex ideas into simple, distinctive, and compelling narratives.

Editorial judgement: You have strong instincts for what makes a great story, what audiences will care about, and where it should be told.

Executive partnership: You’re comfortable working directly with founders and senior leaders to shape their voice and external presence.

Media understanding: You understand the modern communications landscape across press, social, creators, podcasts, events, and emerging channels.

Strategic judgement: You can move between long-term narrative building and high-stakes, fast-moving communications with confidence.

Builder mindset: You’re comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work — from developing the narrative to writing the final copy.

Eye for quality: You hold a high bar for everything Attio puts into the world and know what great communications looks like.

title: Complaints Handler
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

Complaints are where things get real - the customer is already frustrated or in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences.

As a Complaints Handler, you'll own a caseload of customer complaints from acknowledgement through to final response. You'll investigate thoroughly, reach fair outcomes, and explain them clearly, all in line with DISP and Consumer Duty - and you'll take pride in getting it right for the customer first time.

You'll report to the Complaints Team Leader and work closely with teams across Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to get to the right answer and fix the root cause.

Case Handling

  • Own and resolve a caseload of customer complaints following initial acknowledgement

  • Investigate each complaint thoroughly, analysing all the facts and related documentation

  • Gather the information you need from internal teams and external partners

  • Draft Final Response Letters that are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation

  • Keep customers informed throughout and manage expectations along the way

  • Stay in control of your workload by actively monitoring and updating case management systems

Quality & Compliance

  • Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales

  • Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across every case

  • Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to your Team Leader promptly

  • Support complaints reporting to management, senior leaders, QA assessors, and Compliance

Collaboration

  • Work with Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to resolve complaints and address root causes

  • Contribute to feedback sessions, process improvement discussions, and complaint trend insight

What you will need to be successful

Essential

  • Proven experience handling complaints end to end within an FCA-regulated environment, ideally motor insurance.

  • Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling.

  • Clear, concise written communication, and the emotional intelligence to handle difficult conversations well.

  • An analytical, organised approach - you can balance multiple priorities and deliver within SLAs.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

Desirable

  • Experience of ShareDo or equivalent case management systems.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Creative Strategist & Producer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:

Why praxipal? The shortage of skilled professionals is the biggest challenge in our healthcare systems. Tens of thousands of positions remain unfilled each year, and demographic shifts are only making things worse. Medical practices rely on our AI receptionist Luna to reduce staff workload and keep care accessible for everyone. We’re growing at record speed and closed a $6.7M seed round with HV Capital.

We are a tech-driven company that deliberately relies on a small, talent-dense team. What defines us is the speed and intensity with which we work, but just as important to us is our team spirit. That’s why we come into the office every day: to connect, learn from one another, and grow together.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience producing content for paid social, ideally performance ads for Meta, at a startup, an agency or as a freelancer

  • Hooks, angles and conversions matter more to you than likes, and you know why an ad works or doesn’t

  • A feel for what makes organic content work on Instagram and LinkedIn, and how it differs from ads

What You’ll Do

descriptionHtml:

We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Step into the world of Customer Onboarding, a place where seamless onboarding experiences are crafted to bring delight to customers and businesses alike. As a Pleo Customer Onboarding Manager, you hold the key to unlocking the full potential of our cutting-edge solutions for businesses across Europe & the UK. Your mission is to oversee and execute the onboarding process with precision and finesse, collaborating seamlessly with both customers and internal teams to ensure a smooth and memorable journey from start to finish.


Picture yourself as the bridge between technology and human connection, understanding each customer's unique requirements, and configuring Pleo to match their needs perfectly. You'll be the go-to expert for technical queries, providing consultation, sharing best practices, and conducting training to drive user adoption that allows our customers to take their business to new levels. Your role goes beyond just technical prowess – it's about building strong relationships and ensuring customer success becomes a powerful reference point for the world to see. Your genuine curiosity and exceptional problem-solving skills will shine through as you navigate multiple onboarding projects with ease, all while staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends.


Some of the fun you will have

  • In short, after our customers have signed up to Pleo, you'll be in charge of their Onboarding

  • Provide 'hyper care', conduct final review calls, facilitate handover to the dedicate Customer Success Manager.

  • Maintain strong relationships, gather feedback and CES scores

And internally facing:

  • You'll enjoy sharing knowledge with the team, collaborating on training and enablement

  • The opportunity to work and add your voice to our continuous process improvement projects

  • Accurately track efforts for revenue recognition and resource allocation

  • Provide feedback and insights to product, development, and marketing teams

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, share updates, address risks

  • Ensure onboarding timeline and customer satisfaction

  • Share success stories, encourage testimonials, showcase experiences

 

You will thrive in this role if you have

  • Successful customer facing experience (at least 2-3 years), ideally in Customer Onboarding, or in Customer Success.

  • Some knowledge of accounting principles and financial workflows is desirable.

  • Genuine curiosity for understanding and fulfilment of customer needs.

  • Strong and proven commitment to customer satisfaction and building relationships.

  • Excellent planning, prioritisation, and risk management abilities for simultaneous onboarding projects.

  • Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive success. Can you really break down a customer problem and explain it to a data analyst, designer, or engineer?

title: Customer Service Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Lendable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support. You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our Chatham office, joining the team on-site three days a week. You’ll work two weekends a month, but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional support for a designated Lendable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.

  • Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.

  • Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options.

  • Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Feedback

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them.

  • Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo.

Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.

Our Interview Process
We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

title: Customer Success Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

  • Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

  • Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

  • A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

  • Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

  • Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

  • Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

In All Cases, You Will Have:

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote.
