title: Customer Success Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

About the Role

The Customer Success Manager II is responsible for growing, supporting, and renewing customer adoption of Demandbase solutions. This is accomplished by partnering with the client to achieve their objectives, driving customer adoption, accelerating time to live and value, and providing B2B digital business expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Own the customer relationship across the full lifecycle, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to senior marketing stakeholders

  • Drive adoption and value realization of the Demandbase platform, measured through usage, customer outcomes, and goal attainment

  • Partner with customers to deliver proactive ABM best practices, strategies, and use cases, addressing critical success issues and executive priorities

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities within the customer base in partnership with new business teams

  • Lead customer onboarding, project manage ongoing initiatives, and ensure timely resolution of issues through cross-functional coordination

  • Advocate for customers internally while maintaining deep expertise in Demandbase products, industry trends, and the competitive landscape

  • Develop customer success stories, case studies, and references that demonstrate measurable impact

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic account management, customer success, or similar roles supporting SaaS customers

  • Demonstrated success driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell motions, in partnership with sales teams

  • Strong experience coordinating cross-functional teams and leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives

  • Deep familiarity with Sales and Marketing technology ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, intent, predictive analytics, and revenue management tools

  • Proven ability to lead technical or process-driven implementations, identify gaps in customer workflows, and deliver measurable business impact and ROI

Benefits

Our benefits include options for up to 100% paid Medical and Vision premiums for employees, a flexible PTO policy, paid holidays, and access to mental health and wellness resources. We also provide a 401(k) with pre-tax, after tax, and roth options, as well as short-term/long-term disability, life insurance, and other great benefits.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

title: Customer Success Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
About 3E:

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

At 3E, we're seeking a Customer Success Manager who can transform customer relationships into lasting partnerships and help clients fully leverage our evolving portfolio of solutions.

This role offers the chance to make a meaningful impact by engaging with customers, providing product education, and offering consultative problem-solving. You'll partner closely with two Account Managers, becoming a trusted advisor to their customers as you guide them through complex solutions, highlight valuable features, and support them in achieving their business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping the customer experience, from building their confidence in our products to identifying opportunities for greater adoption, and proactively addressing challenges that could impact retention. Throughout this process, you'll collaborate with teams across Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product to connect customers with the expertise and resources they need.

If you're passionate about helping customers explore new possibilities, building relationships, simplifying complex technology, and taking ownership to maximize the value of their technology, this is your opportunity to make a tangible difference through your work. We want to hear from you!

Location & Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote position supporting customers and internal partners across EMEA.The role requires 10–20% travel.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build relationships that last. Develop trusted partnerships with customer stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and help them realize ongoing value from 3E solutions.

  • Turn product knowledge into customer success. Guide customers through product capabilities, deliver training, and help them confidently adopt new features and workflows that support their goals.

  • Drive meaningful engagement and adoption. Create and execute customer success plans, lead proactive outreach, and identify opportunities to increase product usage and engagement.

  • Partner to support retention and growth. Collaborate closely with two Account Managers to strengthen customer relationships, identify opportunities to expand value, and contribute to renewal success.

  • Get ahead of customer challenges. Monitor engagement, product usage, and customer feedback to recognize potential risks early, set clear expectations, and coordinate solutions before issues escalate.

  • Connect customers with the right expertise. Work across Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product to address customer needs, coordinate resources, and ensure timely follow-through.

  • Be a voice for the customer. Share insights, feedback, and emerging needs with internal teams to help improve products, processes, and the overall customer experience.

  • Grow your expertise across our solutions. Build knowledge of 3E's product portfolio, including Protect and Insight, and help customers discover capabilities that make their work easier and more effective.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You're someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers succeed. You know how to build trust, communicate clearly, and translate product capabilities into practical value. You're comfortable taking initiative, collaborating across teams, and navigating situations where the answer isn't always straightforward.

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client services, software training, or a related customer-facing role in a SaaS, technology, information services, or a similar environment.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage confidently and empathetically with different customer stakeholders.

  • Experience helping customers learn software, adopt new capabilities, and achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex information in an approachable, practical way.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate customer meetings, manage competing priorities, and follow through on commitments.

  • Confidence navigating challenging conversations, setting realistic expectations, and collaborating constructively with internal partners.

  • Curiosity and adaptability, with an interest in learning multiple products and finding solutions in an evolving environment.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn new systems and tools.

  • Ability to travel 10-20% of the time to customer locations or 3E events as needed.

Even better if you bring:

  • Experience supporting customer renewals, retention, or expansion in a recurring-revenue business.

  • Fluent in French or German.

  • Familiarity with customer success measures such as net revenue retention (NRR), product adoption, and customer engagement.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, or similar CRM and customer engagement platforms.

  • Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical, or other complex B2B software solutions.

  • Experience supporting mid-market or enterprise customers across different locations.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and an interest in exploring how emerging technology can improve customer experiences and workflows.

Disclosures:

3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us Candidate Privacy Notice

Agencies: 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means.

title: Customer Support / Support Technique B2B – Nantes (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Rejoignez l’équipe Product Support de Doctolib à Nantes

Vous aimez aider les utilisateurs, comprendre leurs problématiques et trouver des solutions ? Rejoignez l’équipe Customer Support de Doctolib à Nantes et accompagnez les professionnels de santé dans l’utilisation de nos solutions logicielles.

 

En tant que Customer Support, vous êtes leur premier point de contact lorsqu’ils rencontrent une question ou une difficulté. Vous analysez leur situation, les accompagnez dans la résolution de leur problème et leur apportez une réponse claire, efficace et pédagogique.

 

Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être expert du secteur de la santé : nous vous formons à nos produits. Ce qui compte pour nous, c’est votre goût pour la relation client, votre curiosité pour les outils numériques et votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes.

Vos missions

Au quotidien, vous serez amené à :

  • Répondre aux appels et aux emails des professionnels de santé.

  • Les accompagner dans l’utilisation de nos solutions et répondre à leurs questions techniques.

  • Diagnostiquer les problèmes rencontrés sur nos produits : agenda, dossier patient, téléconsultation, e-prescription, suivi de patientèle, etc.

  • Identifier l’origine des difficultés et proposer des solutions adaptées.

  • Guider les utilisateurs pas à pas, avec pédagogie et clarté.

  • Assurer le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution.

  • Coordonner les situations nécessitant l’intervention d’équipes spécialisées.

  • Développer progressivement une expertise sur les produits Doctolib.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos réponses, outils et procédures.

  • Garantir une expérience client de qualité à chaque interaction.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Vous pourriez réussir dans ce rôle si :

  • Vous avez une première expérience en relation client, assistance utilisateurs, support ou environnement à flux.

  • Vous aimez comprendre un problème avant de proposer une solution.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et apprenez rapidement.

  • Vous possédez une bonne capacité d’analyse et faites preuve de rigueur.

  • Vous savez expliquer simplement une solution à une personne qui n’est pas technique.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

  • Vous disposez d’un excellent relationnel et d’une bonne capacité d’écoute.

  • Vous savez rester calme, structuré et empathique dans une situation complexe.

  • Vous avez envie d’apprendre et de développer votre expertise produit.

Une expérience en support logiciel, SaaS, helpdesk, assistance utilisateurs, télécoms, banque-assurance ou service client technique est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable.

Votre formation initiale importe moins que votre potentiel, votre curiosité et votre envie d’aider les utilisateurs.

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète à nos produits et à notre métier via la Doctolib Academy.

  • Des possibilités d’évolution vers des fonctions d’expertise, de qualité, de formation ou de management.

  • Des bureaux situés sur l’Île de Nantes.

  • Un restaurant d’entreprise.

  • Des événements et activités d’équipe.

  • Une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib.

title: Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients.

You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. You will design the processes, integrations and reporting that connect these questions, lead complex customer engagements and help other consultants deliver the service. You will advise on hardening and help clients establish ownership, remediation targets and a process that fits their IT operations.

You will also shape what we build next. Starting from our existing Vulnerability Management capabilities, you will develop the technical roadmap towards Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and assess where Attack Surface analysis, exposure validation and Quantum Readiness belong in the offering. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance;
  • Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work;
  • Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality;
  • Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions;
  • Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management;
  • Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible;
  • Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions;
  • Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping;
  • Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience;
  • Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements;
  • Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls;
  • Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality;
  • Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear;
  • Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. Familiarity with ITSM and remediation platforms is expected; scripting and API skills are an advantage;
  • Ability to design a solution across several tools and processes, explain the technical choices and guide colleagues through implementation. Experience developing a consulting service is an advantage;
  • Interest in developing CTEM and Quantum Readiness services and testing AI applications in security operations. Experience evaluating AI or agentic solutions is an advantage. Experience with Attack Surface analysis, Crypto Agility or Post Quantum Cryptography is welcome; you do not need to be an expert in every area on day one;
  • Fluent business English and professional fluency in the relevant local language(s).

Benefits

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;
  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 70.000 EUR p.a. – 100.000 EUR p.a.;
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;
  • 30 holidays;
  • Company Pension Scheme;
  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

  • Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.
  • The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable.
  • Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted.
  • Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools.

We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input.

The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants.

title: Data Engineer, Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role 

As a Data Engineer within Engelhart's Finance department, you will build and operate reliable data pipelines connecting the data warehouse and CTRM platform with brokers and Futures Commission Merchants (FCMs), margin and collateral processes, and the wider Finance technology stack. You will help automate manual Finance workflows into tested, monitored jobs, with robust reconciliations and controls that give stakeholders confidence in the completeness and accuracy of financial data. 

This will be a full-time role based in our London office and owning the following responsibilities: 

  • Build, operate and maintain data pipelines between the data warehouse, CTRM platform, brokers and FCMs, margin and collateral processes, and Finance systems. 
  • Integrate data from the Finance stack, including P&L and F+, SAP General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, and bank statements. 
  • Automate manual Finance processes by developing reliable, tested and monitored jobs that can be operated and supported effectively. 
  • Implement reconciliations and data controls to identify missing or incomplete records, duplicates and breaks, and produce clear exception and break reporting. 
  • Ingest and process external files and feeds, including data received over SFTP and in formats such as CSV and XML. 
  • Investigate data and reconciliation issues, trace discrepancies through source systems and pipelines, and explain P&L or cash breaks to relevant Finance stakeholders. 
  • Develop and maintain serverless ETL solutions on AWS, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices to support consistent, controlled releases. 
  • Apply strong SQL and Python-based data processing to transform, validate and reconcile data accurately and efficiently. 
  • Work with Finance and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, improve existing workflows and deliver maintainable solutions with appropriate controls. 
  • Contribute to improving the reliability, observability and quality of Finance data flows as the business and its systems evolve. 

About You 

You will be a practical, analytical data engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with an understanding of Finance processes and controls. You can work with varied data sources, investigate discrepancies and explain the cause of a P&L or cash break clearly. You take ownership of the reliability of the jobs you build and look for opportunities to simplify and automate manual processes. 

As a result, we believe the following experiences and skills are essential for application: 

  • Strong Python development skills, including experience with Pandas and/or Polars, NumPy, and automated testing with pytest. 
  • Hands-on experience building AWS serverless ETL pipelines, using services such as Lambda, EventBridge, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB, CloudWatch and S3. 
  • Experience with AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Experience building APIs using Python frameworks, preferably FastAPI. 
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query, transform, validate and reconcile data. 
  • Experience ingesting external files and data feeds, including SFTP transfers and formats such as CSV and XML. 
  • Good understanding of Finance processes and data, with the analytical skills to investigate and clearly explain a P&L or cash break. 
  • A disciplined approach to testing, monitoring, reconciliation and control design, including checks for completeness, duplicates and exceptions. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to trace issues across systems and data pipelines. 
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Finance and technical stakeholders. 

The following experience is not required, but highly desirable for this role: 

  • Experience using Kafka from Python. 
  • Experience integrating with SAP or treasury systems. 
  • Exposure to trading data, including positions and P&L. 
  • Familiarity with dbt and/or Airflow. 

What we offer 

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.  
  • 25 days of annual holiday entitlement, excluding UK public holidays. 
  • Robust benefits package such as medical, dental, life insurance, generous pension contribution, and supplemental benefits partially subsidised by the Company.   
  • Eligibility to receive external and internal training in accordance with our Training & Development Policy. 

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

title: Data Platform Engineer – Data Operations (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.

YOUR MISSION

Data is the fuel of STARK’s AI stack - you build the engine that makes it usable. You own the software backbone of our data platform: the metadata systems, ETL pipelines, data contracts, catalogs, databases, and internal tools that let engineers find, understand, validate, and reuse terabytes of multi-sensor field data in minutes, not days. You treat data context as a product: structured, searchable, version-aware, documented, and traceable from raw recording to processed asset, annotation delivery, dataset, and downstream ML workflow. Success in this role requires seamless cross-functional collaboration—acting as the central hub between the teams collecting data in the field, our external annotation vendors, and the ML engineers training the models. Your job is to design the automated workflows and data tooling that unify these groups, transforming raw operational data into reliable, high-quality systems at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build the Data Backbone: Design, write, and maintain robust Python software and ETL pipelines that ingest, process, and merge complex field recordings (flight data, rosbags, video) and external deliveries into our GCP cloud storage.
  • Create Data Tooling: Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.
  • Database & Metadata Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.
  • Data Operations & Labeling Workflows: Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.
  • Internal Tooling & APIs: Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Generalist Problem Solving: Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong Software Engineering in Python: You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.
  • Data Engineering & ETL: Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.
  • Database Mastery: Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.
  • Unix/Linux Environments: Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.
  • Pragmatic & Adaptable: You know how to balance a quick, scrappy fix with a long-term architectural solution, and you are highly comfortable with the changing priorities of a startup environment.
  • Communicator & Coordinator: You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with external vendors and non-technical stakeholders to drive data labeling and curation efforts.
  • Automation Mindset: You aren't allergic to jumping in to do support tasks, but you have the technical chops to automate them away so you never have to do them twice.

NICE TO HAVE

  • GenAI / Synthetic Data: Experience with synthetic data generation or GenAI-assisted workflows (auto-labeling, data augmentation, foundation-model-based curation).
  • Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, FiftyOne), computer vision annotation formats (e.g., COCO), or large-scale data curation workflows.
  • Advanced GCP: Experience with GCP services beyond basic storage (BigQuery, Cloud Run, IAM).
  • Robotics / Complex Data: Exposure to robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP, PX4 logs) or handling heavy, multi-modal data streams (video, lidar).

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Data Steward - People Platforms
descriptionHtml:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

Operational reporting and team support

  • Provide first-line support for master data issues raised by downstream consumers and business users.
  • Contribute to operational reporting on stewardship volumes, exception trends, match rates, and resolution times.

Support data migration and reconciliation activities during source system onboarding and platform changes.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in a data stewardship, data administration, or master data management role.
  • Practical understanding of MDM concepts including golden records, matching, survivorship, and entity resolution.
  • Familiarity with enterprise master data management and data governance solutions (e.g. Informatica MDM, Informatica Data Governance) or equivalent platforms is desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data investigation, validation, and reporting.
  • Understanding of data governance principles including data classification, ownership, and stewardship workflows.
  • Willingness to work with AI and machine learning tools as part of day-to-day stewardship operations, including reviewing AI-suggested matches, classifications, and enrichments.
  • Experience working with ERP or HCM data (Workday, SAP, Dynamics, or similar) is an advantage.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies methodically.

Wat ga je doen als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement?

Als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement ondersteun je een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer en de ontwikkeling van data- en informatieproducten. Je houdt je voornamelijk bezig met geografische data, maar werkt ook met Business Intelligence (BI) en gestructureerde datasets. Je analyseert gegevens, bewaakt de kwaliteit en denkt mee over hoe data slimmer kan worden ingezet. Daarbij werk je samen met verschillende collega's en adviseer je over oplossingen die aansluiten bij de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie.

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel een expert te zijn. Het is vooral belangrijk dat je een brede interesse in datamanagement hebt, analytisch kunt denken en het leuk vindt om verschillende soorten datavraagstukken op te pakken. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis in de praktijk in te zetten en verder te ontwikkelen.

Via The Trainee Company combineer je werken, leren en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Binnen het traineeship Data & Analytics ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte Data-professional. Je doet direct praktijkervaring op, volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die je de rest van je carrière kunt gebruiken. Denk hierbij aan PowerBI, Python, SQL en Azure.

In het eerste jaar van het traineeship leg je een sterke basis in data, systemen, processen en communicatie. Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding van jouw people manager en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen tijdens je opdracht. Zo leer je niet alleen in de praktijk, maar werk je ook gericht aan je technische én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.


· Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en een relevante opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van Geo, Datamanagement, Business Intelligence, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

· Je hebt affiniteit met ETL-tooling en Business Intelligence, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft Azure en Power BI;

· Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

· Je bent analytisch, nauwkeurig en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen;

· Je kunt goed samenwerken en communiceert helder met verschillende betrokkenen;

· Ervaring met datamanagement, bij voorkeur binnen een overheidsorganisatie, is een pré.

title: Datenschutzkoordinator / IT-Sicherheitskoordinator (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als Datenschutz- und IT-Sicherheitskoordinator (w/m/d) koordinierst Du Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit bei Stackfuel in Deutschland und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem Compliance Team um. Du bist der Brückenkopf zur Datenschutzbeauftragten (DPO) und zum CISO in UK und sorgst dafür, dass DSGVO und Kundenanforderungen pragmatisch und effizient umgesetzt werden. So minimierst Du Risiken und ermöglichst den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz moderner Technologien.

Du kommst in einer entscheidenden Phase unserer Wachstumsgeschichte zu uns und verstehst Compliance als Enabler: Teams arbeiten schnell und sicher, Kund:innen vertrauen uns. Du berichtest an den Head of Product Compliance.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle

1. Datenschutzkoordination

  • Pflege von Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, TOM-Dokumentation, Löschkonzepten, Datenschutzhinweisen und Einwilligungsprozessen

  • Prüfung von Auftragsverarbeitungsverträgen sowie neuen Tools und Dienstleistern

  • Bearbeitung von Betroffenenanfragen, Vorbereitung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen

  • Behandlung von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorfällen inkl. Meldeprozessen

2. Informationssicherheit

  • Koordination von Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines schlanken ISMS inkl. Risikoanalysen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien, abgestimmt mit dem DE- und UK-Compliance- und Security-Team

  • Steuerung technischer und organisatorischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen mit IT-Abteilung und UK-Sicherheitsteam, inkl. Notfallvorsorge und Incident Response

3. Awareness & Schulung

  • Schulung und Sensibilisierung der Mitarbeitenden

4. Regulatorik & Lieferkette

  • Beobachtung und Bewertung von NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und AI Act

  • Lieferantenbewertung inkl. Sicherheitsfragebögen, Beantwortung von Kundenanforderungen und Unterstützung bei Audits

  • Regelmäßige Abstimmung mit DPO und CISO in UK

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. (Wirtschafts-)Informatik) oder IT-Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung in Informationssicherheit

  • 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Datenschutz und IT-Sicherheit

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in DSGVO und BDSG (Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, Auftragsverarbeitung, DSFA, Betroffenenrechte)

  • Kenntnisse in Informationssicherheit und Risikomanagement (Risikoanalyse, Richtlinien, Incident Response)

  • Grundverständnis von IT-Infrastruktur, Cloud und Netzwerken; Kenntnisse in Identitäts- und Berechtigungsmanagement (MFA, SSO), Endpoint-Schutz, Backup sowie Patch- und Schwachstellenmanagement

  • Kommunikationsstärke, didaktisches Geschick (auch gegenüber Nicht-Techniker:innen) und Durchsetzungsvermögen

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit Dokumentationsdisziplin, Pragmatismus, Priorisierungsfähigkeit, Integrität und Diskretion

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch (mind. C1)

  • Zertifizierung als Datenschutzbeauftragte/r bzw. -koordinator/in oder Bereitschaft, diese im ersten Jahr zu erwerben; Bereitschaft zur Weiterbildung

Von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Weiterentwicklung eines ISMS; Kenntnis von ISO 27001 oder BSI IT-Grundschutz und eine entsprechende Zertifizierung (oder Bereitschaft dazu)

  • Kenntnisse zu NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und AI Act

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenaudits und Lieferantenbewertungen

  • Kenntnisse in Logging und Monitoring sowie Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.


About the role

As a delivery manager, you’ll own the end-to-end success of high-impact AI projects for our retail and consumer clients. You act as the crucial link between our customers and technical teams - we’ll look to you to balance technical possibility with feasibility, ensure we maximise value for our clients, and cultivate strong external relationships which position Faculty as the partner of choice for future projects.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the end-to-end delivery of customer projects, from initial scoping to final implementation

  • Collaborating with technical teams, and customers, to design innovative AI solutions that solve their challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Managing project development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the customer

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers; acting as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle

  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and contributing to new business pitches and proposals

  • Developing and mentoring your peers; taking a proactive role in building good processes and practices

     

Who we're looking for:

  • You have previous experience in 0-1 AI/Digital transformation projects in the retail and consumer facing sectors (which also includes comms/telco, media/entertainment and consumer goods)

  • You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption

  • You're currently client-facing - trusted to help them navigate ambiguous situations, complex technical information and unexpected challenges

  • You are a clear communicator, with outstanding written and verbal skills, using these to instil confidence, bring clarity, and influence senior stakeholders

  • You are comfortable working with technical teams and have experience delivering technical projects

  • You know how to gauge possibility, and feasibility, and how to lead a team to balance vision and pragmatism

  • You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential issues and proactively implementing solutions

 

Our interview process:

  1. Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

  4. Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Fast, no fluff. We'll give you clear feedback at every step.

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

Cross-Functional Support & Training

title: Director of Engineering, Communications
descriptionHtml:
The Communications Tribe

The Communications Tribe is part of HelloFresh's Growth Alliance. Our mission is to enable a highly personalised, automated CRM communication ecosystem that prioritises user-centric engagement across our owned channels: email, push, SMS, in-app and embedded.

The problems we are solving:

  • How anyone with a good reason to speak to customers can do it safely and in minutes.
  • How we make sure every customer gets the right message, at the right moment, through the right channel, so that our communication is truly personal.
  • How we move to an autonomous, self-optimising system that continuously learns from every past interaction and gets better with each send.
  • How we make sure we can reach our customers in their preferred channels.

Our vision is to decentralise how HelloFresh talks to people across the whole relationship with us: prospects, subscribers and those who have left. Setting up and steering communications stops being the job of a small group of specialists and becomes something teams across the business can do safely, on top of tools and an intelligence layer that we build and that learn from every send. That loop reaches beyond CRM, so the customer experience is coherent from the first ad someone sees to the communication that converts and retains them.

As Director of Engineering, Communications, you will lead the engineering organisation that makes this real. You will set technical direction, hold the bar for reliability and operational excellence, and partner with Product, Marketing and CRM teams to turn the vision into working systems.

What you'll do

  • Lead the Communications engineering organisation through a layer of Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers, across Berlin and Warsaw.

What you'll bring

title: Drone System Reliability Technician and Pilot
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot, you will be at the front line of our quality, safety, and reliability efforts. Your primary mission is to ensure that our defense-grade products meet rigorous operational standards before they are cleared for active duty.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. By logging massive operating hours, you will actively hunt for rare, hard-to-replicate system bugs and edge-case anomalies. We are looking for operators who combine rigorous testing discipline with the hands-on piloting expertise required to accurately assess and validate nominal drone behavior in flight. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

 

Responsibilities

  • Intensive Flight Testing: Conduct high-volume flight testing of newly assembled interceptors to log hours, validate systems, and actively hunt for rare, intermittent flight anomalies.

  • Aviation Performance Assessment: Manually operate, stress-test, and critically evaluate the flight dynamics of various platforms (multirotors, fixed-wing, flying wings, and RC planes) to ensure they handle exactly as designed.

  • Field Deployment: Lead and execute demanding on-site flight missions, sometimes lasting several weeks, under diverse weather and environmental conditions.

  • Mission Safety & Logs: Rigorously follow test checklists, maintain safety protocols during high-throughput flight operations, and accurately report flight observations to the engineering, production and industrialisation teams.

Candidate Requirements

  • Good RC/UAV Piloting Skills: You have extensive hands-on experience piloting RC planes, flying wings, or multirotor UAVs. Manual piloting dexterity and a deep instinct for flight mechanics are the absolute priorities for this role.

  • Rigor & Endurance: Strong discipline to run repetitive, structured test cycles with consistent attention to detail and unwavering focus on safety.

  • Adaptable Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, lean startup environments where initiative, quick decision-making, and teamwork are valued over rigid hierarchy.

  • Field-Ready & Mobile: You possess a valid driver’s license (Permis B) and are ready to drive team vehicles, transport flight gear/drones. You are looking for a highly active, hands-on role where you will be out in the field on a daily basis, all year round.

  • Technical background: Any technical degree or professional experience in electronics, RC modeling, mechanics, or aeronautics is a great plus, but passionate self-taught pilots are highly encouraged to apply.

  • Basic Technical English: Capable of understanding technical guidelines and writing flight reports in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications & FPV: Official drone pilot certifications, instructor ratings, or solid FPV (First Person View) racing/freestyle experience.

  • Military or Field Background: Past experience in specialized military units or demanding field-oriented professions.

  • Basic data/technical literacy: a basic grasp of autopilot systems, telemetry or flight-log reading, to help bridge the field and R&D. This is what turns an operator into a genuine validator, and is worth probing even if not required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Embedded Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.    
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability. As a Embedded Staff Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance. This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices. You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (10+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Prime team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux 

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components 

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies 

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments 

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks 

  • Lead technical design principles for embedded teams and align with our embedded architects on fit within overall architecture

  • Ensure quality solutions by leading the definition and adherence to technical design and coding guidelines

  • Promote craftmanship, quality gates and responsible AI practices across our embedded engineering community

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM) 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) 


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) 

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) 

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles 

  • Experience with multi threading, concurrency, and performance optimization 

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems 

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial 

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) 

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions 

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills 

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems 

  • Familiarity with (industrial) control systems

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

What you get  
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values 
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 
 
Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. 
 
We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. 
 
Apply 
Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to get to know you!

title: EMEA Sales Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, with London and Dubai opening later this year.

Why this role

European customers are not evaluating us out of curiosity. Workforce compliance has turned into a board-level risk and there are deadlines attached to it. The demand is already here. What we don't have is coverage, or an enterprise motion that repeats.

You are the first commercial hire in Europe and you build the team around you. It is a player-coach role and it stays that way, because we are not going to put someone in charge of coaching a European motion; they have never run against European buyers themselves. You carry a quota while you hire. A Solutions Consultant joins alongside you, SDRs come after that, and how the pod fits together is your call.

None of this starts from zero. The North American playbook holds up on qualification, pricing, security review and technical validation. Your job is to work out which parts of it survive European procurement, works councils and regulators, rebuild the rest, and turn the result into the thing every rep in the region runs.

What you'll do

  • Own enterprise revenue across EMEA, and carry your own deals from first meeting through to signature

  • Build and qualify pipeline in staffing, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing and retail

  • Turn the North American motion into a European playbook other people can run

  • Hire the pod. SDRs, account executives, and with the CEO, the first five people on the team

  • Forecast well enough that the exec team can plan the company against it

  • Get what you hear in the field back to product while it still matters

What we're looking for

  • Seven or more years selling complex enterprise software, with six and seven figure closes you can talk us through in detail

  • Time selling into staffing, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing and/or retail

  • Deals across more than one European market, so you know how procurement, works councils and regulators change the shape of a cycle

  • Experience hiring and managing reps while still carrying your own number

  • The ability to hold a room with a Head of Compliance and a CTO in it at the same time

  • A territory run on tooling rather than headcount. AI for account mapping, call prep, proposals and pipeline hygiene, and we will ask to see the stack

If you have built a commercial team once and think the second one would be better, we should talk.

descriptionHtml:

AI is rewriting the rules of consulting. Most advisory firms are waiting to see what happens. We decided to be the ones making it happen.

We are a small, senior team that moves fast, sets a high bar and genuinely enjoys building Riplo together. Every person here shapes what Riplo becomes.

You will have the autonomy of a founder, the exposure of a partner, and the tools of an AI-native firm. Your work will show up directly in investment decisions, in our product and in how Riplo grows.

 

What you'll do

Deliver diligence

  • Lead day-to-day execution of CDD and AI DD projects for PE clients, from kick-off to final report.

  • Structure the key questions, build the workplan and own core workstreams: market sizing, competitive landscape, customer research, business plan review and AI/tech assessment.

  • Turn analysis into a clear, investment-grade storyline and co-present findings directly to deal teams.

  • Deliver projects on time and to a high standard.

Build the practice

  • Help scope and write proposals, and support pitches to new and existing funds.

  • Use AI tools at every step: research, data analysis, interview synthesis, modelling and slide production.

  • Work with our engineers to improve Riplo's platform and diligence workflows.

  • Build reusable assets that make each project faster than the last.

What you'll bring

  • 6–7 years in diligence consulting.

  • Strong commercial due diligence track record for PE clients, ideally at a transaction advisory firm or broader management consulting experience with a focus on technology, software or AI.

  • Sharp commercial acumen: you quickly get to what drives a business and what matters for the investment case.

  • Proven execution: you have run workstreams and teams and delivered under tight deal timelines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including senior client and investor audiences.

  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools daily and can show how they make your work faster and better.

Who you are

  • Founder mindset: this is your business to own and grow. You treat Riplo's success as your own

  • Proactive: you see what needs doing and do it before being asked.

  • Driven: you set a high bar for yourself and the work you deliver, and want to build something.

  • Ownership mindset: you take initiatives from idea to delivery and drive them forward. You own outcomes, not just tasks

  • AI-first: you look for the AI-enabled way to do every step, and keep refining it.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you thrive in a small, fast-moving team without rigid structure.

Why Riplo

  • Build something from the ground up: join early and help define what AI-native diligence looks like for the industry.

  • Real impact, fast: your work feeds directly into investment decisions made by leading PE funds.

  • Senior from day one: sit in front of deal teams, shape proposals and own client relationships.

  • Work at the frontier: collaborate with our own AI engineers and platform, not just talk about AI.

  • Grow with the firm: a clear path to take on more as Riplo scales.

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

About the Team

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most.

AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped.

For this role, you'll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you'll own the team's strategy and delivery end to end.

What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar.
  • Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery.
  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs.
  • Connect engineering decisions to business impact. Understand how your domain contributes to customer value, retention and revenue, and use that to guide trade-offs on scope, investment and technical debt.
  • Own your teams' flow of work from start to finish. Track and act on delivery and quality signals (such as cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time), clear bottlenecks across planning, review, testing and release, and keep cognitive load sustainable.
  • Lead your teams' move to AI-native engineering across the SDLC. Embed AI tools and agentic workflows, measure their real effect on speed, quality and how engineers experience their work, and adapt team practices so faster delivery never costs reliability or maintainability.
  • Champion operational excellence. Drive reliability and quality practices, own the health of the services your teams run and step in as Incident Commander when needed.
  • Own your teams' delivery: set quarterly plans, track progress against the product roadmap and help shape department-wide planning and strategy.

What You Must Have

  • 3+ years of recent experience as an Engineering Manager leading software engineering teams, ideally in SaaS product companies.
  • A strong software engineering background, and you're still hands-on today. You can review code and designs credibly, dig into technical issues and contribute to architecture decisions.
  • Proven people leadership: hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management and helping engineers grow into their next role.
  • A strong product engineering mindset. You've partnered with Product and Design on discovery, worked directly with customers and measured success by customer and business outcomes rather than output.
  • Business acumen. You understand the commercial context, can explain trade-offs in terms of impact and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience using engineering metrics and flow practices (such as DORA metrics, cycle time or WIP limits) to find bottlenecks and improve delivery, quality and team health, without turning metrics into targets.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and agentic tools, both in your own work and across a team. You have a clear view of how AI changes delivery speed, code quality, review practices and cognitive load.
  • Experience planning and delivering complex initiatives across several teams predictably, including managing dependencies, risks and incidents.

It's a Plus If You Have

None of these are required, and we're happy to support you as you learn them on the job.

  • Experience in the localization industry or with translation workflows.
  • Experience leading engineering teams at a product company during a scale-up phase.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered product features, such as LLM-based features, to customers.
  • Experience managing fully remote, distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with developer experience or productivity frameworks, such as SPACE or DevEx.
