title: Integrity Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.

You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.

This role will be based in the U.K. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.

Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.

  • Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.

  • Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.

  • Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.

  • Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.

  • Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.

  • Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.

  • Are comfortable reviewing potentially distressing content, including material relating to child exploitation, sexual or physical violence, suicide and self-harm, while approaching this work with care and professionalism.

  • Communicate clearly and compassionately in writing and verbally, particularly when supporting vulnerable individuals or navigating sensitive situations.

  • Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your work, and maintain an agile mindset as priorities, cases, and operational needs evolve.

  • Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language in addition to English is welcomed but not required.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

title: International Expansion - Netherlands
descriptionHtml:

Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

descriptionHtml:

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

About the Role

As a Junior Data Platform Engineer, you'll work alongside senior team members to tackle complex challenges, while taking ownership of your own areas of the problem, in a fast-paced environment where no two days look the same. The role is fundamentally about problem solving: understanding business challenges, breaking them down, and delivering pragmatic, scalable solutions.

You’ll work closely with product, analytics, and engineering teams, operating with a high degree of autonomy. That means proactively gathering context, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring work lands effectively.

Data Platform sits at the centre of the business, with a real opportunity to shape how teams interact with data. The focus is on enabling fast, iterative analytics, moving from idea to insight quickly, while maintaining strong foundations around reliability, cost, and security.

You’ll work across a broad set of technologies as we evolve the platform. Experience is helpful, but not essential:

What we’re looking for

Strong fundamentals and the ability to apply them pragmatically:

  • Good understanding of software engineering patterns and architectures

  • Experience building data-intensive systems

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform ideally)

  • Familiarity with modern data architectures (Lambda/Kappa)

Just as importantly, how you work:

  • Strong problem solver who focuses on understanding before building

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping direction

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Able to manage multiple streams of work without losing momentum

  • Pragmatic, balancing speed with scalability and reliability

  • Actively looks to improve ways of working, including leveraging AI tooling

title: Junior TechOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no machines, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte's list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy, and we are looking for a junior engineer to join it.

The role

You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.

You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day. You will be coached and supported as you grow, with clear standards, documented processes and experienced engineers around you.

What you'll be doing

  • Monitoring the health of cameras, kiosks and network equipment across 150+ car parks, and acting when something looks wrong.

  • Diagnosing and fixing faults across devices, networks and our backend platform, working through problems methodically.

  • Preparing, configuring and shipping hardware for new sites, and supporting site launches.

  • Keeping inventory, configuration records and documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Managing your tickets in Jira with clear notes, sensible prioritisation and proper follow-through.

  • Learning constantly: from the TechOps team, from our developers, and from the estate itself.

What we're looking for

This is a junior role. We care more about fundamentals, honesty and appetite to learn than years of experience.

  • Around 1–2 years of hands-on experience in IT support, infrastructure or technical operations, or strong fundamentals you can demonstrate from projects, a home lab or study.

  • Networking basics you can explain in plain English: what a switch and a router do, what an IP address is, what a VPN is for.

  • A structured instinct when something goes offline: check power, check the network, check the device, in that order.

  • Some awareness of APIs and SQL. You do not need to be fluent; knowing what they are and wanting to use them is enough.

  • Solid Windows knowledge: event logs, command line, system configuration.

  • Organised, reliable and calm when something breaks on a live site.

What this role isn't

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is looking after a distributed technology estate.

  • A narrow role. You will touch hardware, networking, software and data in the same week.

  • A dead end. The team is growing, the estate is growing, and there is a clear path to more senior TechOps work as you develop.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • 4 days a week in our Croydon office, 1 day from home, with occasional site visits.

  • Free breakfast, lunch, drinks and snacks in the office, excellent transport links, and two friendly office dogs.

  • You will need the right to work in the UK. A full UK driving licence is handy for site visits.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition

  • Übergabe: Stellvertretung der jetzigen Führungskraft und anschließend vollständige Übernahme der Position

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Von Beginn an:

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)

Schrittweise hinzukommen:

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

Was noch fehlt, bauen wir gemeinsam auf

Sie haben noch keine Führungserfahrung oder sehen bei sich selbst noch Entwicklungsbedarf? Kein Problem – genau dafür planen wir die lange Einarbeitung ein. Wir schauen gemeinsam, where Sie stehen, und entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter:

title: Labour AI Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Sona

Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. This role is about getting that tooling to work for a specific site: its trading patterns, its staff, its quirks. You'll work directly with customers to turn Sona's tools into labour models that are used on site and have a huge impact.

You'll derive labour rules from real trading data, spend time on site with customer teams to learn how the business runs, and build the trust with site managers. You'll present the impact and ROI of that work to customer executives and general managers, and act as the subject matter expert for labour optimisation in sales conversations.

You'll also be the person site managers trust enough to change how they staff, and the person customer executives and General Managers trust enough to back the changes you're proposing. You'll need as much influence as analysis to make that work. You'll report back to customer leadership on the impact, in numbers they can take to their own board.

You'll adapt the same underlying labour model across different business types, from QSR to premium dining to retail.

Responsibilities

  • Derive labour rules from real trading data using Sona's tooling and your own operational knowledge

  • Spend time on site with customer teams, learning practical realities like stock deliveries and close-down procedures

  • Build trust with site managers so workload models actually get followed

  • Present impact and ROI to customer executives and general managers, winning buy-in for operational change

  • Act as the labour optimisation subject matter expert in sales conversations

  • Work across the full portfolio of live customer projects, picking up work as priorities shift between accounts

Requirements

  • An operational background in hospitality, retail, or a similar hourly-workforce, fluctuating-demand business. You understand how the business runs day to day, not just how to analyse it from the outside

  • Confident presenting to and winning buy-in from customer executives, general managers and boards, and comfortable holding your own with competing agendas in the room

  • Comfortable with technology and confident picking up new tools quickly, including using AI tools in your own workflow

  • Able to look into the data yourself and make decisions from what you find

  • Comfortable operating without a fixed playbook

  • Excited about using AI in your day-to-day work to 10x your output

  • Bonus: a retail or workforce-management background where the underlying concepts transfer to hospitality

Bonus: a commercial finance background with genuine credibility in front of operators

We're a hybrid working team you can expect to work 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho), and 2+ days/week on site with customers.

Benefits

  • Salary: £85,000 - £100,000

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

title: Lead Country Commercial Manager for Business Management Software

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team 

The Business Management Software commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners. This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention. 

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Country Commercial Manager to scale revenue growth across our Accounting, Tax and Payroll products (part of our BMS suite, known internally as ‘Admin Services’) and build an indirect distribution channel via Partners & Accountants.

You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams (mainly Marketing, Product, Finance) to understand funnel conversion, campaign(s) performance and product prioritisation, whilst owning competitor and market insight and leading new product go-to-market (GTM) launch plans. Excellent organisation, strategy and communication skills essential.

Key areas of this role:

  • Revenue Ownership & Forecasting: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine commercial projections for the Accounting, Tax & Payroll products ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.
  • Accountants Strategy & GTM planning: Research UK Accountants market and build a clear, concise and financially robust indirect model to help Tide scale their BMS products and others with Accountants.
  • Competitor and Market insight: Regularly analyse key competitor movements and wider industry trends - relevant to Accounting, Tax, Payroll and Accountants - translating insight into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.
  • Analytics-Driven Insight: Analyse (via BI team) member behaviour, segment audiences, subscription cohort performance and create clear recommendations to shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.
  • Product Development: Partner with the Product teams to assess opportunities to shape product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting  successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.
  • Launch Strategy: Support new feature launches across channels and operational teams to deliver best-in-class experiments. 
  • Stakeholder Management: High levels of communication with a wide range of stakeholders, including Tide’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives.
  • Member Obsession: You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.

What we are looking for 

  • Strong commercial acumen:  Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.  Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.
  • Accountancy software experience: Understanding of software and experience scaling software at either an Accountancy software company or with Accountants.
  • 5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.   This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.
  • Strong analytical mindset: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.
  • Proven GTM track record – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns  (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)
  • Exceptional project management skills, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.
  • Creative collaborator: Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.
  • Self-starter attitude: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.

What you’ll get in return

title: Lead Deployment Strategist - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing Deployment Strategist team that helps n8n's enterprise customers turn automation opportunities into measurable business impact. You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

Build & Lead the Deployment Strategist Team

  • Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.

  • Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.

  • Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.

Own & Scale the Deployment Methodology

  • Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.

  • Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.

  • Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.

Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes

  • Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.

  • Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.

  • Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.

Scale Delivery Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the Partner Delivery Manager and Partnerships teams to ensure external delivery partners follow the same engagement methodology and quality standards.

  • Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.

  • Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🤝 Enterprise Customer Experience: You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.

  • 🌟 People Leadership: You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

  • 🚀 0-to-1 Builder Experience: You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.

  • 💼 Executive Stakeholder Management: You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.

  • 🛠️ Technical Fluency: You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.

  • 📊 Operational Excellence: You know how to define success metrics, build scalable methodologies, and turn customer engagement learnings into actionable playbooks.

  • 🎯 Customer Outcome Mindset: You're focused on driving measurable customer adoption and long-term value, rather than simply delivering projects or completing engagements.

Nice-to-haves

  • ⚡ Automation Platforms: You're familiar with n8n or other workflow automation, integration, or low-code platforms.

  • 🔄 Change Management: You have experience helping enterprise organizations drive adoption, navigate organizational change, and embed new technologies into their ways of working.

  • 🤝 Partner Ecosystems: You've worked with systems integrators, consulting firms, or external delivery partners to deliver customer implementations or technical engagements.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a brand-new function at the heart of how we scale enterprise customer adoption. You won't just manage a team — you'll shape how we engage customers, demonstrate the value of automation, and turn high-impact use cases into production workflows that drive lasting business outcomes.

You'll work closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering, with significant visibility and influence over our enterprise growth strategy. As one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, we offer the opportunity to build from the ground up, experiment with new approaches, and create a scalable deployment model that helps customers become independent, successful builders.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, where your impact will be visible from day one.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
A different kind of organisation

  • High trust, transparency, and autonomy
  • Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
  • Radical compensation transparency
  • Sense of ownership in collective success
  • Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

  • Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
  • Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
  • Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
  • Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

  • Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
  • Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence

  • Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
  • Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems  and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align

  • Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
  • Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
  • Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.

You'll thrive here if

  • You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
  • You think in systems, not isolated parts.
  • You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
  • You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
  • You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
  • You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for

  • Demonstrable building software systems in complex environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
  • Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
  • Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

What will you experience in terms of culture at Sahaj?

  • A culture of trust, respect and transparency
  • Opportunity to collaborate with some of the finest minds in the industry
  • Work across multiple domains

What are the benefits of being at Sahaj?

  • Unlimited leaves
  • Life insurance & private health insurance
  • No hierarchy
  • Open Salaries

title: Lead Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo RetailTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes. - Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel. - Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu. - Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet. - Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes. -Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo. - Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Tes perspectives d'évolution : Les voies qui s’ouvrent à toi ensuite : - devenir Group PM et manager les Lead PM d'un grand compte - t’orienter vers un rôle plus commercial sur d’autres grands comptes : Key Account Manager - mettre ton expertise de gestion de projets complexes à profit dans un rôle de COO ou CPO Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, avec plus de 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 4 ans en product management (Senior PM / Lead PM / Head of Product), en startup, ESN ou cabinet de conseil. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle et client : capable de créer une relation de confiance, d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs de top management, et à l’aise dans des contextes grands comptes. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif·ve, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours, d’anticiper les besoins et de gérer des situations sensibles. - Solides compétences en négociation et management : écoute active, questionnement, capacité à challenger, à gérer le conflit et à délivrer des feedbacks exigeants avec calme et clarté, dans une logique de progression collective. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Lead Software Engineer - Data
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

PlayStation Studios is the game development division of Sony PlayStation, and is responsible for developing some of the most recognisable and ambitious console games and franchises on PlayStation, including The Last of Us, Horizon, Spider-Man, God of War, Helldivers and Gran Turismo.

We work with some of the best game studios in the world, and use data to help them make their games even better. We provide end-to-end analytics services for PlayStation Studios and use data to help them in the game development lifecycle. We are looking for talented people to join us in pushing the boundaries of game analytics for PlayStation games.

This role offers a flexible hybrid working arrangement, with most time spent working remotely unless you prefer to come into the office. We attend the office for key moments that matter, such as important team meetings, collaboration sessions and business activities where in-person engagement is beneficial. 

Role Overview: 

As a Lead Software Engineer with experience in data pipelines, you’ll work in our cross-disciplinary Data Platform team to develop integrations and APIs supporting our Data Platform. These will include working with our data pipelines. You’ll work closely with our Game Analytics data engineers, who process this data to gain valuable insights both during game development and post-launch. As a lead, you’ll scale our platform and help us define its technical direction, expand its reach, and help define and build the future of the data platform for PlayStation games.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own integrations with our data platform, including BI tooling, APIs, internal websites and other tooling
  • Drive improvements to achieve our technical and business goals
  • Enable studio self-service on our platform
  • Work closely with the Devops team, our data and frontend engineers, and stakeholders across the studio business group
  • Support our existing tooling, improving quality and documentation
  • Be a technical expert and share than knowledge with your colleagues

What we’re looking for:

  • You have experience building data integrations between different platforms, including APIs and pipelines
  • You are adept at writing code in Go, or write Python with a willingness to learn Go
  • You are experienced in building robust, scalable, and resilient services
  • You can demonstrate measurable impact that you have made in your current and previous roles
  • You enjoy having primary ownership of parts of a platform
  • Experience with AWS services, such as Amazon S3, Lambda, Redshift, Kinesis, Data Firehose, Athena and AWS Glue

Nice to have:

  • Has made use of AI during the development cycle, including use of Claude Code, Codex or other harnesses
  • Experience integrating with with Omni Analytics, or a similar BI tool (Looker, Tableau etc)
  • GitHub and GitHub Actions experience

Joining Legora means three things.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Legal AI is inventing its best practices in real time, and this role sits where that happens. You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. In a year here, you will see and vet more legal AI use cases than most people in the industry see in a career, working directly with some of the best legal engineers in the industry.

This is a judgement role, not a filing one. You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. You'll research and experiment with prompting techniques and applied AI methods, author the exemplar use cases the rest of the function copies, and teach what you learn: delivering technical onboarding for new Legal Engineers in your region and broadcasting best practices to the team worldwide. And because judgement needs grounding, around 30% of your time stays on live client work, chosen for what it teaches.

• Vet the Skills Library and Legal Engineering outputs against the quality bar: review skills, workflows and use cases hands-on before they go live, and quality-control practice-area workflows for consistency.

• Research and experiment with prompting techniques, skill patterns and emerging AI methods, and turn what works into best practices the whole function adopts.

• Author the reference use cases that show what great looks like, published as the exemplars others copy.

• Work closely with the Product team on up-and-coming capabilities: early hands-on testing, the first best practices for new features, and structured feedback from real use.

• Produce materials that would support the technical onboarding and training for new Legal Engineers in your region, such as best practices to create use cases etc.

• Communicate new best practices, exemplars and platform changes to the Legal Engineering team worldwide.

• Support the flagship demos our CEO and C-suite take on stage at the industry’s biggest events: use case preparation, fixtures and rehearsal support.

• Oversee the quality and currency of the use case and skills libraries, including coordination across regions

What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. When you vet, you vet properly: line by line against the source, with the discipline to put the AI down when the job calls for your own eyes.

We're looking for

• A qualified lawyer with solid practice experience at a leading firm or in-house team, or equivalent: enough substantive judgement to vet outputs across practice areas.

• Real technical prowess: comfortable with code or scripting (a bootcamp or self-taught background counts entirely), and fluent in the mechanics of how AI tools actually behave.

• A heavy, habitual user of AI, ideally legal AI, with sharp prompt and use case discernment: able to rank a strong prompt against a mediocre one, articulate exactly why, and improve it.

Where this role can go

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
descriptionHtml:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

  • You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.

Key responsibilities:

Hybrid bioprocess modelling

  • Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.

  • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.

  • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.

  • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.

  • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.

Transfer across organisms and scales

  • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.

  • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.

  • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.

Real-time Model-Predictive Control

  • Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.

  • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).

  • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts

  • Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity.

Qualifications:

  • PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions.

  • Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn).

  • Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches.

  • Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale

  • Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS)

  • Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control

  • Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data

  • Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling

  • Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments

  • Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars)

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines;

  • Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work;

  • A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel

  • eGym WellPass membership

title: Manager, Quantum Applications Software
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

PsiQuantum is building the world’s first useful, fault-tolerant quantum computer. Our applications team focuses on developing algorithms and workflows in the fault-tolerant regime.

We are seeking a Quantum Applications Software Manager to lead a small, high-impact team of Quantum Applications Software Developers. This team builds the software tools and infrastructure that enable the development, evaluation, and deployment of quantum applications for real-world problems.

In this role, you will combine hands-on software engineering with team leadership. You will work closely with quantum algorithm developers and architects to deliver scalable, high-quality tools—such as simulators, resource estimators, and compilation workflows—that are critical to turning quantum algorithms into practical solutions.

Responsibilities:

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Manage, mentor, and support a team of quantum applications software developers.
  • Provide clear direction, set priorities, and ensure alignment with team goals.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and execution-focused team culture.

Drive Execution and Delivery

  • Translate team objectives into actionable plans and deliverables.
  • Own day-to-day execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Identify risks and remove blockers to maintain team momentum.

Contribute Technically

  • Remain hands-on in the design, development, and deployment of quantum applications software.
  • Guide technical decisions and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges.
  • Promote strong software engineering practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.

Build Quantum Applications Tooling

  • Oversee development of core tools such as quantum simulators, resource estimation frameworks, circuit compilation pipelines, and domain-specific application integrations.
  • Support the development of scalable and reliable simulation and compute infrastructure.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner closely with quantum applications architects, algorithm researchers, and other engineering teams to implement software solutions for real-world use cases.
  • Contribute to cross-functional efforts that connect algorithms, software, and hardware.

Enable Quantum Algorithm Development

  • Support analysis and optimization of resource requirements for fault-tolerant quantum computations.
  • Help enable improvements in quantum algorithms through robust and flexible software tooling.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • MSc or PhD in Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in quantum computing, quantum algorithms, or quantum circuit compilation.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production-quality systems (Python, C++, or similar).
  • Experience leading projects and/or mentoring engineers; prior people management experience is a plus.
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or API-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with fault-tolerant quantum computing and resource estimation is desirable.

Key attributes

  • A hands-on leader who enjoys both coding and developing people.
  • Strong execution skills, with the ability to turn objectives into delivered outcomes.
  • Pragmatic problem solver with a focus on impact and quality.
  • Effective collaborator who can work across disciplines and teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

PsiQuantum provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. PsiQuantum does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable laws.

title: Managing Principal – Capital Markets
descriptionHtml:
Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

Nos marqueurs distinctifs

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence
    Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco”
    Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive
    L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  6. Engineering (Delivery)

Descriptif du poste

En tant que Managing Principal au sein de Capco France dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients, Banque de Financement et d’Investissement, Asset Servicers et Asset Managers, en France et à l’international, afin de contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

En collaboration avec les autres partners en charge des comptes clients et nos practices, vous serez en charge d’identifier et de transformer de nouvelles opportunités d’affaires auprès de nos clients.

Dans ce cadre, vous piloterez également l’exécution des projets vendus, qui sont de nature complexe et à forte valeur ajoutée, couvrant l’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants :

  • Transformation organisationnelle et opérationnelle : Redéfinir les modèles opérationnels, organisationnels et l’architecture fonctionnelle pour les départements de marchés de capitaux (Front, Middle, Back-office, Risques), déploiement de processus optimisés et alignés sur les meilleures pratiques du marché.
  • Cadrage et gestion de programmes complexes : superviser, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre, des plans moyen-termes et des projets de transformation à grande échelle (ex : refonte des systèmes, mise en conformité réglementaire, réorganisation…).
  • Accompagnement de projets réglementaires : Accompagner les clients dans la mise en conformité avec les principales réglementations des marchés de capitaux (MiFID 2, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, PRIIPS, SFTR, FATCA…).
  • Transformation Finance & Risques : Refonte des dispositifs de contrôle des risques (marché, contrepartie, crédit, opérationnels), des outils et processus de reporting, pilotage de la performance.
  • Mise en œuvre de technologies et d’innovations : concevoir des architectures fonctionnelles alignées avec les stratégies métiers, superviser l'implémentation de progiciels financiers (ex. : Murex, Calypso, Simcorp…) et de nouvelles technologies innovantes (IA, automatisation des processus, big data, blockchain) pour améliorer la performance des opérations de marché.
  • Stratégie et gouvernance de la donnée : définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de gestion des données, accompagner les enjeux d’exploitation, de confidentialité et de sécurité des données.

Au-delà de vos interventions et des missions que vous superviserez, votre rôle consistera également à assurer :

  • Le développement commercial du cabinet dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux : pilotage de relations clients en direct ou en appui des équipes clients, origination d’opportunités business, contribution à la transformation des opportunités en missions concrètes.
  • Le développement de nos offres et services et la croissance des équipes Marché de Capitaux : développement de contenu, partage de nos visions et convictions, développement des compétences internes (recrutement et formation).

Savoir-Faire et Savoir-être

Les caractéristiques suivantes sont requises :

  • Expérience :
    • 12/15 ans d’expérience minimum dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, dont un minimum de 7/8 ans dans le Conseil.
    • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de programmes et projets de transformation complexes, depuis le cadrage jusqu’au pilotage, et dans des missions métiers (gestion post-trade, finance, risque et conformité) et/ou technologiques.
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Expertise en stratégie d’une banque de financement et d’Investissement, de son architecture fonctionnelle, de son organisation, de ses métiers et processus et de ses enjeux.
    • Maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de programme / projet, en cycle V ou en agile.
    • Connaissance des instruments financiers et des principes de gestion des risques (marché, contrepartie et crédit).
    • Connaissance des progiciels de marché.
    • Connaissance des nouvelles technologies, des progiciels de marché et des systèmes d’informations des BFI, ainsi qu’une expérience dans le cadrage ou la réalisation de projets de transformation IT dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux serait un réel atout pour ce poste.
  • Soft skills :
    • Leadership avéré et capacité à encadrer des équipes seniors.
    • Excellent niveau de communication, grande aisance rédactionnelle.
    • Fortes compétences en gestion de la relation client.
    • Esprit analytique et capacité à structurer des démarches et à résoudre des problématiques complexes.
    • Orienté résultats, avec un sens aigu du client et de ses enjeux métiers et technologiques.
    • Forte autonomie en matière de relation client, de développement commercial, de pilotage de missions et de développement des collaborateurs.
    • Appétence à challenger le statuquo et capacité à s’adapter aux évolutions technologiques
  • Formation et langues
    • Diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieurs ou école de commerce (Bac+5)
    • Maîtrise impérative du français et de l’anglais dans un environnement professionnel.
    • Vous savez évoluer dans un contexte international.


Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work ®.
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles
