title: Marketing Operations
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Your strong communication skills and analytical thinking will be invaluable as we support the daily work of our colleagues and keep our systems operating at the highest standard.

title: New Business Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

And we're only getting started. We currently hold a small share of a large market, which means the opportunity ahead, for the business and for the people who join it now, is huge.

The Role

We're hiring a New Business Sales Executive to help bring new clients to Hozah. You'll find and open the door at landowners, managing agents, hotel groups and multi-site operators that have never worked with us, win their first site, and help grow the account from there.

This is a target-carrying sales role for someone early in their sales career who wants to build it properly. You'll learn the full B2B sales cycle, from first cold call to signed contract, alongside an experienced commercial team, with uncapped commission from day one. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys the hunt and wants to get better at it every week.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on prospecting, selling and learning.

Key responsibilities

  • Work a named list of target organisations and turn them into Hozah clients, from first cold call to signed contract.

  • Run a disciplined outbound routine: daily cold calling, email and LinkedIn sequences, event follow-up and referral asks.

  • Book and run discovery calls and site visits, and build proposals with support from the wider team.

  • Hit your activity and sales targets, with commission on every deal you win.

  • Keep your activity, pipeline and forecast accurate and up to date in the CRM.

  • Hand each new site to the Client Success Manager cleanly, with the commitments made in the sale written down.

  • Look for the next site within the accounts you win, and learn how to grow a client's estate over time.

  • Share what you hear from prospects with the team, so the proposition keeps improving.

Who we're looking for

We'll explore each of these during the interview process, so come ready with specific examples.

  • Some experience in a target-driven sales role, such as SDR, BDR, business development, telesales or field sales, and the numbers to show how you performed against target.

  • Comfort with cold calling as a daily habit, and the resilience to keep going through a run of rejections.

  • Curiosity: you ask good questions and listen properly to the answers.

  • Coachability: you seek out feedback, act on it, and can show how you've improved as a result.

  • Organisation and discipline: a routine for managing your day, your activity and your follow-ups.

  • Clear, confident communication on the phone, in writing and face to face.

  • The ambition to build a career in B2B sales and grow into larger deals and accounts.

  • Willingness to travel to meet prospects and clients in person across the UK.

  • Useful but not essential: experience selling to landowners, managing agents, hotels, retail or leisure operators, or in parking, property services, facilities management or another multi-site B2B service.

What you get in return

We ask a lot of this role, and we give a lot back.

  • Real room to develop your career. We hold only a small percentage of the market, and as the commercial team grows there's a clear opportunity to progress into larger deals and key account roles.

  • The chance to learn from an experienced commercial team, with regular coaching on your calls, meetings and deals.

  • A generous, uncapped commission structure, in a commercial team that already has people earning well above OTE.

  • The pace and energy of a fast-growth tech start-up, where your work is visible and your results directly shape the business.

  • Close exposure to the CEO and senior team, so you see how commercial decisions on pricing, proposition and territory get made.

  • A proven, cash-generative product with strong references and award-winning technology. You are selling something that works.

  • Client Success Managers who run the operational side, so your time goes on selling.

  • A purpose-driven company reshaping how parking and mobility work, a collaborative culture, and friendly office dogs.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

The Ops Manager is a critical role at our depots. As the Ops Manager, you are accountable for site performance during your shift.

Your role will focus on primary sort for our middle mile hub. You will ensure that arrivals are unloaded, sorted and cross docked according to the plan provided to you by the Network team, whilst maintaining high quality and safety levels.

You will lead a team of handlers throughout your shift and be accountable for the results that are delivered. You need to have the highest standards of professionalism and discipline, leading by example in every moment. This is an on-site role embedded in the day-to-day operations. The shifts for this role are a 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern which will require you to work one day on the weekend. Our Operations team is organised into roles at different levels: this is a level 5 role reporting into the site leader.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Lead shift during rotation - managing a variety of team members - to deliver exceptional under the roof performance.

  • Be the Site Lead’s primary support & deliver strong handovers

  • Lead & inspire, & develop and performance manage, team on OM’s shift rotation.

  • You will be responsible for:

    • Labour planning for week-ahead & night.

    • Managing day activities, e.g. sortation as relevant, preparation for sortation.

  • Succession planning for week ahead + 6-week glance for their side of the week, & peaks.

  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives & Develop standards and operating procedures.

What you’ll be accountable for 🤝

  1. Adherence to the plan for the day from the Network team. You will ensure drivers are dispatched on time, and vehicles are loaded with correct volume.

  2. All in-depot day-to-day and planning activities including people (labour pool, engagement, leadership succession planning), safety (auditing and near miss/incident reporting), quality (SLA, set-off/on-time dispatch), and cost (labour planning D+1/W+1/TPH).

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 4-8 years’ experience leading fast-paced dispatch / middle-mile operations.

  • Strong command of driver operations, route execution, and dispatch accuracy.

  • Hands-on shift leadership with ability to manage 10-20+ staff. Ability to lead and coach team.

  • High urgency, strong communication, strong escalation habits.

  • Comfortable solving real-time operational pressure during peak windows.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Competitive market-related salary. Including the opportunity to work overtime when required.

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays. If you're on on 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

  • Cycle to work scheme

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - We leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - kindness requires us to be fair, consistent and work together to move HIVED forward.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started.

  • 💰 We Are Resourceful - Resources are scarce and our business depends on our ability to use resources wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.


🔍 Want to learn more?

  • HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

  • HIVED is B Corporation certified

  • Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

title: Oracle SIOCS Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Oracle SIOCS Solution Architect

Consumer Goods, Retail and Logistics Practice

Principal / Senior Principal

You want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? We are growing and are looking for people to join our team. You'll be part of an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment of 300.000 employees. Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready?

About your role

We are looking for a hands-on Oracle SIOCS solution architect to join the Design Pod of a global luxury retail POS transformation. A standard Oracle Xstore and SIOCS template is being rolled out to boutiques in around 36 countries (2027 to 2030), delivered through a Design Pod, a Base Template Pod and regional EU and APAC PODs, under a standard-first (90/10) principle.

You will own the end-to-end design of Oracle Retail Store Inventory Operations Cloud Service (SIOCS) and its integration with Xstore and the wider landscape, so boutique inventory processes are accurate, standard and scalable across markets and across Fashion and F&B concepts.

You are a trusted advisor to senior business and IT stakeholders, able to say no to unnecessary customisation with a clear rationale, and you document decisions so knowledge is retained. You will be measured on inventory accuracy at go-live, template conformance and on-time design of 3 to 4 work packages a year.

Responsibilities

  • Fit-gap and Adopt-vs-Adapt for store inventory: receiving, transfers, adjustments, counts, returns, reservations, in-store fulfilment
  • Solution designs and FSDs for SIOCS configuration, workflows, reporting and user roles
  • Integration designs for SIOCS with Xstore, ERP and merchandising, order management, e-commerce, warehouse and logistics
  • Inventory data designs: master data, item and location setup, conversions and reconciliation approaches
  • Country and market localisation, including tax, traceability and regulatory requirements affecting inventory
  • Design hand-over packs to delivery PODs that meet Definition of Ready and design-gate criteria
  • Contribution to the Base Template roadmap and cloud release readiness, including impact of Oracle quarterly updates
  • Design reviews, quality gates and root-cause input on design and data defects; coaching of POD engineers

Requirements

  • Have a broad business skill set including stakeholder management with senior business and IT leaders, problem-solving, and resilience
  • Are able to say no to overcommitment and unnecessary customisation with a clear rationale
  • Have experience building and growing the right-skilled team: one team across PODs, vendors and locations
  • Have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C2 proficiency); French is a strong advantage; willingness to travel regularly to boutiques, regional PODs and client sites. Location: France (preferred, Paris)
  • Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with Oracle SIOCS (and its SIM heritage): configuration, workflows, APIs, and how SIOCS and Xstore share stock and transactions
  • Experience working with Oracle Retail Cloud architecture, integration patterns and update management; inventory concepts, shrinkage and cycle counting
  • 15+ years in retail technology and 7+ years designing Oracle Retail inventory solutions incl. SIOCS or SIM (Senior Principal: 18+ years, several global rollouts as lead architect)
  • Have previously led multi-country store systems rollout covering POS and store inventory together
  • Strong luxury, fashion or premium retail background: high-value, low-volume and serialised stock, boutique-to-boutique fulfilment
  • Experience with Oracle product teams on SRs and escalations, and across multiple vendors; Oracle Retail certification is a plus

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

About your team

Our CRL (Consumer Goods, retail & Logistics) practice helps some of the largest global firms and most recognizable local brands solve their biggest challenges in today’s age of constant disruption. With diverse services spanning growth strategy and new product innovation, to omni-channel customer experience, supply chain resiliency and AI-driven new business models, we help clients shape and achieve their growth agenda for a sustainable future. We transform traditional organizations to digitally centric business models and drive new revenue streams.

About Infosys Consulting

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our .

Within Europe, we are recognized as one of the UK’s top firms by the Financial Times and Forbes due to our client innovations, our cultural diversity and dedicated training and career paths. Infosys is on the Germany’s top employers list for 2023. Management Consulting Magazine named us on their list of Best Firms to Work for. Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.

We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal goals. Curious to learn more? We’d love to hear from you.... Apply today!

title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Rennes) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

 

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

title: Partner - Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness, London
descriptionHtml:
Associate Partner/Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness
London, UK

About Ekimetrics

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, scalable and lasting impact. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, we are committed to responsibility and frugality in AI, and to staying loyal to our values and DNA.

The opportunity

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

title: Payments Risk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst II based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction.

 

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

  • Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals.

  • Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information.

  • Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation.

  • Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay.

  • Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up.

  • Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements.

  • Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning.

  • Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems.

  • Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively.

What you need to bring:

We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with:

  • 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline.

  • Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets.

  • Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records.

  • Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge.

  • Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations

  • Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes.

  • Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets

  • Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills

  • Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction.

  • Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information

  • Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s in it for you:

Come live the Lightspeed Experience…

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like

  • Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more.

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office

  • A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

  • Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

  • Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

  • People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

  • Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.

👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

  • At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

  • Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

  • Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

  • Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

  • Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

  • Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

  • Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI

  • Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

  • Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

  • Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

  • Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

  • Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing

🙏 What we offer

  • Location: 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice

  • Base salary: between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year, depending on experience and level

  • Profit-sharing scheme: 10%, in line with Prévenir’s framework

  • Benefits: daily transport costs covered, company restaurant, RTT days and regular team events

title: Permitting and Regulatory Compliance Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable, and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

You will own Focused Energy's permitting and regulatory pathway across our regulated technical facilities, from early feasibility through construction, commissioning, and handover to Operations. You will build and run the integrated permitting strategy under the direction of the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and act as our primary contact with competent German authorities. Your work will ensure regulatory requirements shape design, procurement, and construction decisions, with a particular focus on the Biblis site transition and the evolving German fusion regulatory framework.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain the integrated permitting strategy, including authority mapping, submission schedules, permit and conditions registers, and regulatory-risk forecasts.

  • Lead coordinated engagement with municipal, district, Hessian state, and federal authorities, aligning submissions and commitments with the approved project strategy.

  • Own permitting coordination for the Biblis nuclear-site transition, including RWE decommissioning interfaces, existing licences, radiation-protection arrangements, and handover evidence.

  • Coordinate application readiness with Engineering, architects, fire-safety and structural specialists, and the Prüfstatiker, and track reviews to closure.

  • Monitor the German fusion legal framework and translate permit conditions and regulatory changes into project requirements, schedules, and risk responses.

  • Escalate material risks and options to the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and hand ongoing permit obligations to Operations.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Strong experience in German construction and public permitting, including building applications, authority consultations, and partial approvals.

  • Working knowledge of Hessian procedures and the Hessische Bauordnung.

  • Working knowledge of radiation-protection licensing and nuclear-site interfaces.

  • Experience coordinating fire-safety and structural-checking processes with specialists and consultants.

  • Ability to explain regulatory risk and options clearly to non-specialists, including project managers and agency counterparts.

  • Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Tritium or comparable regulated-facility experience.

  • Experience with multi-agency permitting for novel or regulated technical facilities.

  • Experience building reusable permitting playbooks or standards across projects.

  • Experience working alongside RWE, licence holders, or other site owners on decommissioning or site handover.

  • Familiarity with EU or German energy and nuclear regulatory frameworks.

  • Mentoring capability through example and playbook-building, without formal line management.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs - whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Platform Engineer Open Source (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Du baust lieber mit Open Source als mit Lizenzschlüsseln und automatisierst alles, was dir in die Finger kommt?

Dann bist du bei uns richtig! Wir suchen einen Platform Engineer, der Lust auf langfristige Kundenprojekte hat und Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen baut – von Linux und Automatisierung über CI/CD bis zu Containern, egal ob in der Public Cloud, im Rechenzentrum des Kunden oder irgendwo dazwischen. Kurz: einen Generalisten für den ganzen Stack, der auch mal eine gewachsene Anwendung kubernetifiziert.

Wir bei cloudpunks glauben daran, dass wir den Unterschied machen können! Wir konzipieren, implementieren und betreiben Plattform- und Cloud-Lösungen – als Kubernetes Certified Service Provider (KCSP) und CNCF Silver Member.

Du bist Teil unseres Teams und stehst im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kunden & Partnern. In gemeinsamen Projekten modernisieren wir Anwendungen, bauen Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen und sorgen dafür, dass alles automatisiert ausgebracht und betrieben wird. Wir wollen geile Projekte umsetzen – mit cooler Technologie, die dem Kunden wirklich hilft!

Deine Aufgaben!

Das machst du bei uns:

  • Anwendungen kubernetifizieren: Du nimmst Bestandsanwendungen auseinander, schreibst Dockerfiles und Helm Charts und bringst sie sauber auf Kubernetes – von der Java-Monolithen-Altlast bis zum frischen Microservice.

  • Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen: Aufbau von Kubernetes-Plattformen mit dem, was das CNCF-Ökosystem hergibt: Ingress-Controller, cert-manager, Harbor als Registry, Keycloak für Identity, Vault oder OpenBao für Secrets. Cloud-agnostisch, On-Premises oder hybrid.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform bzw. OpenTofu, Ansible, Helm und Kustomize – du automatisierst alles, was automatisiert werden kann, und gießt jede Komponente in versionierten Code.

  • CI/CD & GitOps: Aufbau und Optimierung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions. GitOps-Workflows mit ArgoCD oder Flux.

  • Security & Policies: Policies mit Kyverno oder OPA/Gatekeeper, Image-Scanning mit Trivy, Runtime-Security mit Falco. Du baust sichere Baselines ab Tag 1.

  • Observability: Aufbau von Monitoring-Stacks mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki und OpenTelemetry – du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden wissen, was auf ihrer Plattform passiert. Mit OpenCost auch, was sie kostet.

  • Backup, Recovery & Lifecycle: Backup- und Restore-Konzepte mit Velero, Cluster- und Komponenten-Upgrades, Lifecycle-Management. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Plattform nicht nur läuft, sondern auch wiederherstellbar und wartbar bleibt – als Code, nicht per Klick.

  • Kundenberatung & Befähigung: Du arbeitest embedded in Kundenteams, nimmst an Standups teil und befähigst Teams, ihre Plattform selbstständig zu betreiben.

Projektbeispiele aus unserem Alltag:

  • Containerisierung gewachsener Java-Anwendungen und Umzug auf Kubernetes für ein Finanzunternehmen

  • On-Premises-Kubernetes-Plattform mit Harbor, Keycloak und ArgoCD für ein Industrieunternehmen

  • Migration von VM-basierten Workloads auf Kubernetes mit Helm und GitLab CI für ein E-Commerce-Unternehmen

  • Secrets-Management mit Vault und Policy-as-Code mit Kyverno für ein Versicherungsunternehmen

  • Observability-Stack mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki und OpenTelemetry für ein Healthcare-Unternehmen

  • Backup- und Restore-Konzept mit Velero für ein Logistikunternehmen



Dein Profil

Must-have (ohne das wird's schwer):

  • Linux & Container: Solide Linux-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Docker bzw. Containern – du weißt, was im Container passiert und warum.

  • Kubernetes: Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, egal ob Vanilla, in der Cloud oder On-Premises.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Erfahrung mit Terraform/OpenTofu oder Ansible sowie Helm und/oder Kustomize.

  • CI/CD: Erfahrung mit mindestens einem CI/CD-Tool (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) für automatisierte Deployments.

  • Networking: Verständnis von DNS, TLS, Load Balancing und Container-Networking.

Nice-to-have (macht dich noch interessanter):

  • GitOps: Erfahrung mit ArgoCD oder Flux.

  • Security: Erfahrung mit Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, Trivy, Falco oder Vault.

  • Observability: Erfahrung mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki oder OpenTelemetry.

  • Identity & Registry: Erfahrung mit Keycloak und Harbor.

  • Cloud-Provider: Erste Erfahrung mit AWS oder Azure schadet nicht – ist aber kein Muss.

  • Zertifizierungen: CKA, CKAD, CKS, LFCS oder andere CNCF-Zertifizierungen.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Kommunikation: Du kannst technische Konzepte verständlich erklären – auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Arbeit.

  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne embedded in Kundenteams und bist ein Teamplayer.

  • Lernbereitschaft: Du bleibst am Ball und lernst kontinuierlich neue Technologien.

title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
