title: Pricing Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

 

Pricing at Marshmallow

This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?

We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.

We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.

We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.

All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.

  • Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.

  • Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.

  • Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.

  • Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.

  • Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.

  • Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.

  • Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.

Who are you?

  • Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities

  • Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models

  • Commercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact

  • Curious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further

  • Owner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area

  • Opinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way

  • Explainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts

  • Networker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business

What skills are we looking for from you?

  • Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R

  • Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R

  • Experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role (quant, credit, fraud etc)

 

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Combined Past Experience & Technical interview (90 mins)

  • Onsite Culture interviews (90 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Principal Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Application Modernization Platform (“AMP”) is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer’s legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.  

AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.

AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.

Work as a software developer in an Agile environment delivering solutions for customers focused on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. During each project, successful candidates will be required to innovate on potential new GenAI-based solutions for specific challenges in addition to applying existing playbooks and tooling for migration.

This role will be based remotely in France.

Position Expectations

  • Shape architecture and technology strategy across AMP modernization projects and workstreams, making complex technical decisions with limited supervision and connecting engineering choices to customer and business outcomes
  • Lead the assessment and modernization of legacy Java applications by uncovering dependencies, embedded business logic, integration points, and operational constraints; recommend fit-for-purpose modernization paths rather than defaulting to lift-and-shift
  • Design, implement, and review production-quality solutions using Java and Spring Boot, including APIs, integrations, monolith decomposition, relational-to-document data modeling, stored-procedure transformation, schema evolution, and MongoDB operational practices
  • Establish safe, incremental delivery practices through explicit acceptance criteria, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and rollback, dual-run, or other risk-control strategies; identify quality, security, performance, and reliability risks and guide teams to resolve them
  • Serve as a senior technical partner to customers, application owners, and account and project stakeholders by explaining complex topics clearly, aligning priorities, navigating disagreement, communicating trade-offs, and maintaining trust through high-risk change
  • Multiply the effectiveness of engineers by mentoring, raising engineering standards, creating reusable migration playbooks and documentation, applying GenAI advancements responsibly where valuable, and influencing project direction without relying on formal authority

Requirements

  • Professional fluency in French is required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 8+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and delivering Java applications, including significant experience leading complex application modernization initiatives
  • Expert understanding of Java fundamentals, object-oriented design, concurrency, error handling, performance considerations, and maintainable software architecture; able to review code and guide design decisions across teams
  • Deep production experience with Spring Boot and related patterns for building resilient services, APIs, integrations, and testable distributed applications
  • Demonstrated ability to assess legacy estates, decompose monoliths, uncover dependencies and embedded business logic, and define practical modernization strategies with clear trade-offs
  • Strong experience with relational databases and SQL, including stored procedures, data dependencies, data migration, schema evolution, and relational-to-document modeling for MongoDB or comparable document databases
  • Proven history of delivering high-cadence modern applications using Agile methodologies, test-first development, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, observability, and reliability practices; demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical outcomes across teams

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience in building REST APIs with Spring Boot
  • Experience in performance and memory optimization of JAVA applications
  • Familiarity with tools like Postman, IntelliJ IDEA, and Maven/Gradle
  • Exposure to other languages or technologies like JavaScript, .Net
  • Understanding of ORM tools like Hibernate, Spring Data  or JPA (even through coursework or self-study)
  • Experience in nascent GenAI technologies and approaches, such as using OpenAI/Anthropic API not purely through chat interfaces
  • Experience with AI-powered development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar code assistants
  • Good experience of using MongoDB

Successful candidates will engage with customer systems and may be exposed to highly confidential customer data, including but not limited to non-public information. For this reason, and due to the nature of the highly regulated industry in which our customers operate, successful candidates may be subject to enhanced background checks, security screenings, and possible constraints around the trading of securities. Successful candidates will understand these requirements and be willing to participate in enhanced screenings and constraints as required by MongoDB and its customers in connection with this role. 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner.

You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model.

Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams.

What You'll Do

Risk & Governance

  • Map Vibe's risk model across every major system.

  • Set the security roadmap with clear priorities.

Security Engineering

  • Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set.

  • Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one.

  • Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers.

  • Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you.

Detection & Response

  • Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure.

  • Own security incident response from detection through resolution.

  • Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own.

  • Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program.

Trust & Compliance

  • Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification.

  • Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements.

  • Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you.

Security Culture

  • Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day.

  • Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar.

What You Need

  • Built a security function as a company's first security hire.

  • Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience.

  • Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

  • Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day.

Nice to Haves

  • Ran a private bug bounty program.

  • Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment.

  • Navigated security through a company acquisition.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €127,000-€171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, technical background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Assessment — 90 minutes. A deeper technical conversation covering core engineering skills, problem-solving, and a technical use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

À propos de Vinci

Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

Responsabilités

  • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

  • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

  • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

  • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

  • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

  • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique.

Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

  • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

  • Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.

What you will build and lead

As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. 

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

  • access to care, search and booking;

  • patient messaging and teleconsultation;

  • the Patient Health Record and patient context;

  • the app homepage and daily health experience;

  • health content and prevention;

  • recommendations, reminders and care plans;

  • new patient services and subscription experiences;

  • conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.

Your mandate

You will:

  • Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.

  • Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.

  • Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.

  • Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.

  • Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.

  • Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.

  • Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.

  • Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.

  • Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.

  • Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will have:

  • established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;

  • raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;

  • helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;

  • strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;

  • developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;

  • helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

What we are looking for

You are likely to bring:

  • Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..

  • Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.

  • A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.

  • Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.

  • Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.

  • Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.

  • A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.

  • Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.

  • The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.

  • A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.

  • Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.

  • A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.

Why Doctolib, why now?

Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.

The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.

You will join at a defining moment:

  • Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.

  • AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.

  • The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.

  • The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.

  • The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.

This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.

 

Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)


Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

Insurance companies use Akur8 to decide the price of millions of policies. We are looking for a talented Product Engineer to build the features they rely on to do it.

You will join the Pricing team, which builds the part of the Akur8 platform that Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners use to design, test and deploy their rates. Your mission is to scope, design and implement features that automate the rating process at insurance companies, from the first discussion of a client need to the feature running in production.

Much of the work is deciding what to build, not only building it. You will work with Product Managers, Designers, Actuaries and other Engineers to understand how insurers price risk, why they work the way they do, and where software can make them faster and more accurate. A good understanding of modelling, maths and logic is needed for this.

At its core, this is a hands-on software engineering role. You will spend significant time writing code, designing data models, building backend and frontend services, and ensuring the systems you ship are scalable, tested, and maintainable.

With AI being a reliable support for implementation, your main value will come from understanding the business context, the architecture and the data models as these will determine the quality of your deliveries. Our platform runs on AWS with Rust, Java, Python, and Angular. Prior experience with them is a plus.

You will work on the core of the platform from your first weeks and see the impact of your work on real clients.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product features end to end: clarify the need with the product team, scope it, design the solution, build it and follow it in production.

  • Turn requests from Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners into a clear scope, and challenge a requirement when a simpler solution meets the need.

  • Work in an AI native-engineering team: delegate implementation to deliver quickly, reviewing, test and own responsibility for everything you ship.

  • Balance delivery speed and robustness according to the client’s priorities.


Your work will help insurers price risk faster and more accurately, and will expand what Akur8 can offer its clients.

We’re looking for someone driven by outcomes: things done fast, done well, and useful to our clients.

  • You have completed or are finishing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or another quantitative field. No professional experience is required.

  • You have written code during your research and want to grow in software engineering practices such as testing, code review and system design, using AI coding assistants as part of your daily work.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it and move it forward without waiting for a step-by-step brief.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to writing code: you care about solving the actual problem rather than chasing perfection, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices.

  • You care about results more than about technology: you want to understand why a feature matters to the end user before deciding how to build it.

Prior experience with our tech stack (Rust, Java, Python, Angular, AWS) or the insurance space is welcome, but not required. We invest heavily in onboarding; what matters most is your curiosity and appetite to learn.

Important: You must possess an employment status: French or Schengen area nationality or a ‘carte de séjour’ that will allow you to work from our Paris office. We are equally open to the visa sponsorship of non-EU candidates as long as they are already in possession of their final diploma / attestation of their final academic results.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

But it’s not all work, you’ll also be part of a dynamic team that enjoys spending time together and having fun, including karaoke, team lunches, playing sports as well as the occasional ‘happy hour’.

title: Product Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.

That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You'll ship every week and lead the team's biggest technical work — and as the team grows, you'll grow into managing it.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory


Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.


What you'll actually do in the first 3 months

This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:

Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. By the end of the month, the team should be bringing you their hardest technical questions — because you've earned it, not because of the title.

Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start pairing and doing technical 1:1s with two or three engineers, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.

Month 3: Own technical hiring. Take over the technical interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.


What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?

After the first quarter, the job is the technical decisions — and, as the team grows, management. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — you'll run the technical side of it.

Most of your time stays in the code: you ship every week and own the specs, architecture, and reviews on our biggest projects. As the team grows, you'll take on 1:1s, growth conversations, and eventually managing the team.

Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:

  • Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

  • Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

  • Team and hiring. Technical interviews and mentoring now; 1:1s, growth conversations, and the EM role as we grow.

  • AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff.

What success looks like

At 6 months: You've led at least 2-3 major projects from spec to production. The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality.

At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've taken over 1:1s as the team grew, and you're ready to step into the EM role.


How we work

We've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture.

  • Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.

    To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:

  • Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.

  • AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it here.

  • Zero-bugs. We take this seriously - this helps us to gain customer trust faster. Especially serious customer-facing problems don't sit in a backlog competing with roadmap work. Critical issues get fixed immediately. High-severity within 48 hours. Every bug has an owner. Weekly quality review as part of Monday planning. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product.

  • We build what customers need, not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us.

This role is for you if:

  • You've led a team technically and made it ship faster. You've set its technical direction, run its design reviews, and interviewed for it — and you can point to where cycle time dropped because of you.

  • You know what great engineers look like. You've thought deeply about what makes them productive, what holds them back, and how to move them forward — and you can spot one in a single interview.

  • You have an exceptional IC track record. You're a senior or staff engineer whose code and designs others build on — and you want to grow into managing, not escape coding.

  • You have product taste. You notice when a feature ships on time but isn't good enough, and you say so.

  • You hold people to a high standard. You're comfortable giving direct feedback and having hard conversations in code reviews and design discussions.

  • You're hands-on with AI-assisted development. You've used Cursor and Claude Code in real production work, not just toy projects. You have opinions about how AI changes the engineering workflow from ideation to release, and you want to push a team to keep getting faster.

  • You've worked in startups. You know what it feels like when there's low process, and the answer is "figure it out and ship it."

  • You think engineering culture can stay startup-like at scale. You're optimistic that a small, high-performing team can stay that way as it grows, with little process.

  • You communicate proactively in writing. In a remote team, written communication is how decisions get made and context gets shared. But you're not scared of jumping into a pair programming session either.


What we're looking for

Required

  • 8+ years as a software engineer at senior or staff level, including 1+ years as a tech lead (formal or de facto) for a team of 3+

  • You've shipped AI features to production — retrieval, RAG, agentic workflows — and you know the difference between a demo that works and one that holds up on real customer data

  • Product taste: a keen sense for what makes a product feel great, and the habit of saying so when it doesn't

  • You've built and shipped with Claude Code and Cursor in real production work, and you have opinions about where AI helps and where it quietly creates debt

  • You lead system design, not just contribute to it: you write the spec, own the architecture, and drive it to production

  • Strong OOP fundamentals; Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, or equivalent

  • Relational database design and SQL optimisation

  • Experience interviewing engineering candidates

  • You've built something zero to one at a startup, or scaled a team through the messy middle. You know what it feels like when there's no playbook

  • Able to work in European timezone (CET/CEST). EMEA-based, ideally Germany or UK

Nice to have

  • Some people management and technical interviewing experience

  • Designed a technical interview process from scratch

  • Previous experience at a fully remote company

Interview process

We want to see how you think, build, and lead — not test you on algorithms. Here's the process:

  • 30 min — Intro call with our talent team

  • 45 min — Interview with Grigory

  • 60 min — Technical interview

  • 1.5 hr — AI-assisted build session: system design for a real feature, then building part of it with AI

  • 2 hr — Leadership session with the founders

Then you’ll get the offer! If we don't make an offer, we'll tell you why.


What Secfix gives you

  • Remote: 100% remote with a real virtual office in Gather

  • Salary: Competitive, benchmarked to European market rates (we'll share specifics once we talk)

  • Equity: Generous package — we're all owners here

  • Development budget: €1,000/year — yours to spend on whatever makes you better

  • Workspace: Remote workspace support + co-working access

  • Holidays: 26 days + local public holidays

  • Health insurance: Comprehensive coverage

  • Annual retreat: Last time we went to Alicante 🇪🇸 — before that, the Austrian Alps, Portugal, Italy, and the Spanish Islands

  • Tech: MacBook, monitors, headphones — the latest

Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.


Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Product Manager - Post Booking
descriptionHtml:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.


Your Mission

As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey.

You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace.

You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders.


Your Responsibilities
  • Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap: Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution.
  • Improve the post-booking passenger experience: Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities.
  • Optimize CRT contact rate: Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant.
  • Use insights to guide decisions: Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs.
  • Build alignment across teams: Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders.

    • Your Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years in Product Management, ideally in a consumer marketplace, travel, mobility or another complex transactional product. Experience building products across markets, platforms or service types is a plus.
  • Customer problem-solving: A track record of simplifying complex journeys and helping customers make confident decisions.
  • Analytical approach: Comfortable combining product data, customer feedback and operational insights to identify problems, set priorities and measure results.
  • Cross-functional influence: Able to bring Product, Engineering, Design, Operations and business stakeholders together around clear decisions and outcomes.
  • Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory.
    • If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!
    What we have to offer
  • 2 to 3 days at the office per week
  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
  • Financial support for home office equipment
  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year
  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

    • Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.
  • A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.
  • A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.
  • A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.
  • A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation.
