Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

  • Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüssen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschliesslich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

title: Generalist (Operations)
descriptionHtml:
Take on the business and back-end operations that keep Kairos running: finances, payments, HR, compliance, and systems, plus support for our programs and Pathfinder groups.

Note: This role description is a first draft. Scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve as our plans develop over the coming weeks, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply.

 

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from METR, Redwood Research, AI Futures Project, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a Generalist (Operations) to do the wide range of things that keep Kairos running in the background. The bulk of the role is core business and back-end operations: paying vendors, supervising accountants, supporting bookkeeping and our audit, figuring out how to employ and onboard people, and keeping us compliant. Alongside that, you’ll support our Pathfinder groups, process grants, build internal systems and automations, and pitch in on program ops.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build systems and automations. Spot the operational work that shouldn’t be done by hand and automate it, so you and the team can spend time on the things that actually need judgment.

  • Run our finances and back-end operations. Pay vendors and contractors, supervise accountants, support bookkeeping and our annual audit, handle the logistics of employing people (payroll, benefits, onboarding and offboarding), and help keep us compliant. You won’t need to be an expert on day one, but you’ll learn to own these functions.

  • Process grants and payments. Run grant processing across Pathfinder and our other programs, make payments to individuals and organizations, and manage expense processing.

  • Pitch in on program ops and whatever else needs doing. Inbox triage, problem-solving on program logistics, and the occasional program-ops crunch where we need the hands.

 

Who You Are

  • Smart, agentic, and able to figure things out. A lot of this role is picking up unfamiliar processes (a new accounting task, a compliance requirement, a group’s odd request) and just working out how to do them well. We care about this more than about specific prior experience.

  • Great at automation and tooling. You instinctively reach for a better system rather than resigning yourself to doing things by hand, and you use AI and automation tools to get more done, complementing rather than replacing your own judgment. The best person in this role makes much of the repetitive work disappear.

  • Eager to help, and able to be assertive. You like unblocking people and improving their experience. You can be gentle but honest with a rejected applicant, and politely firm with an overly demanding one.

  • Organized and on top of things. You keep careful track of to-dos and information. When you drop a ball, it’s on purpose.

  • Strong writer and communicator. You’re clear and concise, and you think through your messaging from the reader’s perspective.

  • Mission-aligned. You care about making advanced AI go well, and you’re comfortable operating in the AI safety ecosystem and its culture.

While not required, we especially value:

  • Some experience in finance, accounting, HR, nonprofit compliance, event planning, or other business operations or nonprofit administration (but we’re glad to have you learn these on the job)

  • Strong automation and AI-tooling chops

  • Context on AI safety and the broader ecosystem

 

Why Work With Us

  • You’ll be working toward reducing risks from advanced AI, potentially the most important challenge of our time. The programs you’ll support influence hundreds of future AI safety and policy professionals.

  • Few ops roles are this broad. You’ll touch grants, finance, compliance, systems, and programs, and build unusually wide operating experience fast.

  • You’ll get to shape the role around your interests, with a say in which skills you build and which functions you take on.

  • We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, and CEA who share your commitment to impact.

  • Collaborate regularly with leading AI safety researchers, policy professionals, funders, and organizers.

 

What We Offer

  • Base salary: $95,000–$190,000, depending on experience and location, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates

  • Location: Access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston; optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses.

  • Benefits: Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget

  • Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture.

 

Logistics

  • Remote, with expected travel 3-6 times a year for conferences and events, predominantly in the US

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
  • The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

title: Senior Finance Manager
descriptionHtml:
About GRI

Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) is the independent nonprofit organization that is the architect of the common global language to assess and report on environmental, social, and economic impacts. GRI provides standards, tools, and training that empower organizations of all sizes to create sustainable, long-term value and unlock positive change in the world.

For over 25 years, GRI has led a global multi-stakeholder process to develop and refine rigorous yet practical approaches to sustainability reporting, which meet the needs of all stakeholders. The  GRI Standards, the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards, provide the building blocks for transparent reporting on impacts. Working at GRI, you will be part of unlocking positive change in the world. 

About the role

The Senior Manager Finance owns budgeting and financial analysis to support the CFO and budget holders in business decision-making. The role also oversees day-to-day finance operations, financial controls and external reporting, and provides line management and guidance to a finance colleague.

Driving automation and process improvement is a central part of the role, using digital tools and AI where appropriate to streamline workflows, automate reporting and reduce manual work. Initially focused on finance, this remit may expand to other processes across GRI in the longer term.

Experience supporting budgeting and forecasting and maintaining robust financial controls.

Knowledge and abilities

Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application to finance and administration; experience developing AI agents is a strong advantage.

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Senior level

Senior Software Engineer. You own a product area: its architecture, how it is staged, its quality bar, and working out with customers what is needed. You may be the only engineer on a new product area, so you need to be able to work alone for weeks at a time and keep quality high without a peer reviewer. Other engineers will come to you for design review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

  • Own the architecture and staging of a product area, and the quality bar for it.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Fully remote within the UK, or our London office next to East Croydon Station

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be Hozah’s first Site Reliability Engineer, and the person who owns how our platform runs. Our parking and payments systems take money from motorists (pay by web, Autopay, kiosks) and pay it on to landowners, and our ANPR enforcement runs around the clock. Those paths have to stay up and stay correct. You own the platform they run on: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform for our Google Cloud organisation and projects, SOPS-encrypted secrets, the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines, Temporal for the ANPR workflows, and Postgres. You also own the reliability practice around it: uptime targets, alerting, on-call, incident response and the cost of running it all.

Product engineers keep ownership of the code in their services. You own the ground it runs on, and you make it easy for them to ship safely. Our engineers use AI coding tools every day, which means more code reaches production each week, so release safety and observability matter more than ever.

This is a new role. We are hiring a senior engineer to own cloud cost, uptime and on-call, set up a proper incident process, and make the platform something engineers trust. You’ll support all of Hozah’s engineering teams, and you’ll work daily with their engineers. The data engineer owns the data warehouse; you’ll work with them, and infrastructure for data still goes through engineering. This is a newly created role with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the production platform: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Postgres, Temporal and the environments (staging and production) and how a change is promoted between them.

  • Own uptime and reliability. Agree service level objectives for the money-moving and enforcement paths with the engineers and the business, and alert a named owner when they are at risk.

  • Own on-call: the rota, the runbooks and the incident process, including postmortems that lead to changes rather than reports.

  • Own observability across Cloud Monitoring, Logging and Trace, so the team finds problems before motorists and clients do.

  • Own our infrastructure as code. Everything changes through Terraform and CI, with no console click-ops, including our SOPS-encrypted secrets.

  • Own the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines and safe release: rollbacks, progressive rollout and promotion between environments.

  • Own cloud cost. Know what we spend and why, reduce it with measured results, and keep it down as volume grows.

  • Work with product engineers as a partner and not a ticket queue: help them design for reliability, and review changes that affect production.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve owned production reliability for a Kubernetes-based platform (GKE, EKS or AKS) in the last 12 to 24 months, as the person who gets called when it breaks. You can say exactly what you were accountable for and what you personally changed.

  • You write and maintain infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and you’ve built CI/CD pipelines with safe release: rollbacks and promotion between environments. You can walk through a change of yours that went wrong, what it affected and what you changed afterwards.

  • You’ve cut cloud cost with a measured result and kept it down. You can say what you spent before and after, what you changed, and what you checked before you changed it.

  • You’ve set up or rebuilt on-call and incident response in a small team: the rota, the runbooks and the postmortems. You can describe the last real incident you handled and what changed because of it.

  • You’ve built observability and service level objectives that changed what got fixed, not just dashboards that nobody opened.

  • You work with product engineers without becoming a ticket queue. You can describe how you got engineers to take on reliability work themselves.

  • You use AI tools sensibly for operations work, and you know where not to. You can describe real recent use and a time you did not trust the output.

  • You’re comfortable setting your own priorities in a fast-moving SME, and you’re happy being the only SRE in the company.

Experience of Google Cloud itself, Temporal, Semaphore or SOPS is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working within the UK, or a London office next to East Croydon Station if you prefer to be in.

  • Sole ownership of the platform and reliability practice, reporting directly to the CTO.

  • The chance to build Hozah’s reliability function from a working base as we scale.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station, open to you whenever you want it (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici;

  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten;

  • Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten;

  • Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;

  • Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn;

  • Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen;

  • Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen.

Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd.


Wat neem je mee?

Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

  • Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider;

  • Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling;

  • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren;

  • Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling;

  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen.

Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Waar ga je het doen?

Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. We werken aan uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen de utiliteit en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.Bij Campus houden we van korte lijnen, duidelijke afspraken en een praktische aanpak. We zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Hierdoor kunnen onze monteurs zich richten op hun vak en kunnen projecten efficiënt worden uitgevoerd.

Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten.

Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf.

Interesse?

Zie jij jezelf al werken als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties bij Campus Installatietechniek? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Caen
descriptionHtml:

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
descriptionHtml:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (London)
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based remotely out of London, UK.

 

Regional Expectations

  • Based in London with strong overlap to customer business hours.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

  • Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

  • Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

  • Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

  • Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

  • Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

  • Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

  • Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

  • Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

  • SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

  • Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

  • Intégrité et performance du système : Maintenir des standards élevés en matière de qualité des données et de santé du système, en faisant de la plateforme une « source de vérité » que les équipes GTM adoptent réellement et en laquelle elles ont confiance.
  • Résolution proactive des problèmes : Identifier et éliminer les points de friction au sein de l'écosystème Salesforce, en allant au-delà de la simple maintenance pour porter une démarche d'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Requirements

  • Approfondie en administration Salesforce, avec un historique démontré dans la gestion d'organisations complexes.
  • Expérience démontrable avec Salesforce CPQ
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises SaaS B2B ou à modèle d'abonnement
  • Solide compréhension des processus de vente, de la gestion du pipeline et du cycle de vie client
  • Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations ou intégrations CRM est fortement appréciée
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, RevOps, Finance et Succès Client

  • Construire des produits à impact réel : Nous résolvons des problèmes complexes du quotidien pour des milliers d'entreprises à travers l'Europe, en remplaçant des opérations de flotte manuelles et fragmentées par des solutions intelligentes et basées sur les données sur lesquelles les gens comptent vraiment.

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform, and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer, as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

title: Sales Manager – SaaS/B2B (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

 

Als Sales Manager (f/m/d) bist du ein zentraler Treiber des Umsatzwachstums bei plancraft. Du arbeitest mit qualifizierten, eingehenden Leads und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.



Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du bearbeitest qualifizierte Leads mit erkennbarem Bedarf.

  • Du führst Produktdemos durch, analysierst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

  • Du berätst potenzielle Kund:innen strukturiert und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess.

  • Du schließt Deals eigenständig ab – vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du behältst deine KPIs im Blick und arbeitest strukturiert mit unserem CRM.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Kundenerfahrung zu schaffen.

Bei plancraft erwarten dich klare und transparente Karrierepfade – z. B. von Junior Sales Manager bis Senior Sales Manager – und du kannst dich bei uns mit klarer Perspektive und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Unsere Gehaltsstruktur ist transparent aufgebaut: Je nach Erfahrungslevel liegt dein On-Target-Earnings (OTE) zwischen 60.000 € und 87.500 €, bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt zwischen 45.000 € und 62.500 € sowie einer variablen Komponente zwischen 15.000 € und 25.000 €.

 

DEIN PROFIL

 

Must-haves

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B- oder SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umgang mit warmen Leads oder Closing.

  • Erfahrung in der Bedarfsanalyse und im Führen strukturierter Verkaufsgespräche.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot, Pipedrive oder Salesforce).

  • Interesse daran, AI zu nutzen, um deinen Sales-Alltag smarter, skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau.

  • Offenheit, regelmäßig in unser Büro in Hamburg zu kommen (hybrid).



Nice-to-Haves

  • Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb.

  • Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus dem Handwerks- oder Baugewerbe.

 

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

  • Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

  • AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen ChatGPT+-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

  • Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst.

  • Flexibilität: Ob remote, hybrid oder im Office: Du arbeitest dort, wo du es am besten kannst. Unser Hamburger Büro am Rödingsmarkt (inkl. Dachterrasse) steht dir jederzeit offen.

  • Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten.

  • Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen.

  • Internationales Umfeld: Wir werden stetig internationaler mit Kolleginnen u. a. in Italien, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und Österreich – und kommunizieren intern auf Englisch.

title: Sales Team Lead (mid-market)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Account Executives and scale some of our Mid-Market segments addressing companies of 30–300 employees.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Account Executives to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Account Executives:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: Scriptwriter intern
descriptionHtml:
La mission de Finary

Notre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Le bon conseil financier a toujours existé, mais il était réservé à ceux qui dépassaient un certain seuil de patrimoine. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun.

Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité.

 

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour accélérer, nous avons levé 40M€ auprès de Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise).

En juillet 2026, l'AMF nous a accordé l'agrément MiCA, qui s'ajoute à notre agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement : nous sommes l'une des très rares plateformes françaises à détenir les deux, avec actions, ETF et crypto réunis sur une seule plateforme régulée, au moment même où l'Europe se consolide autour des acteurs agréés. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre.

 

Ce que nous offrons

Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour.

Découvrez nos valeurs ici.

---

LE POSTE

Finary Media fait la première chaîne YouTube d’éducation financière en France : 880 000 abonnés et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, tout est produit en interne. Chaque vidéo est traitée comme un produit : on mesure, on itère, on améliore.

CE QUE CE STAGE T’APPORTE

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Une pratique avancée de l’IA : au-delà d’un usage conversationnel, tu as déjà conçu des prompts structurés, des workflows ou des automatisations pour produire mieux et plus vite.

ATOUTS APPRÉCIÉS

Entretiens

title: Security Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Level: Engineering Manager (PL1)
Team: Information & Cyber Security, within Platform & Security Engineering
Salary: £70,000 – £87,000 + discretionary bonus
Contract: Permanent
Reporting to: Head of Information Security

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

You’ll join the Information & Cyber Security team, a core part of our Platform & Security Engineering organisation. Security at Kaluza isn’t a silo, so you’ll work closely with colleagues across security engineering, identity and access management, platform engineering and enterprise technical services.

As Security Operations Lead, you’ll own and grow the Security Operations function, leading a team across the UK and Australia. You’ll be the senior escalation point for security incidents, a calm and authoritative presence under pressure, and the person who keeps our operational security evolving to meet new threats, including those that come with being an AI-enabled business.

  • Lead the team: Build, mentor and manage the performance of a Security Operations team across the UK and Australia, creating an environment of continuous learning, clear ownership and psychological safety

  • Evolve incident response: Develop our incident response processes, especially around AI, maintain playbooks and standard operating procedures, and run exercises that build team confidence when it matters most

  • Hunt threats: Proactively hunt for threats before they become incidents, and work with penetration testers, red teams and bug bounty programmes to find weaknesses, then partner with security engineering and technology teams to close gaps

  • Own detection and tooling: Own our security monitoring and detection capability, including SIEM, EDR and threat intelligence platforms, driving the tooling roadmap, tuning detections to cut noise, and championing automation

  • Report on what matters: Define and own Security Operations KPIs and KRIs, and give senior stakeholders clear reporting on the health of the function, including mean time to detect, mean time to respond and coverage trends

  • Support compliance and governance: Make sure our security operations posture supports our regulatory and contractual obligations, acting as a key stakeholder in audits, assessments and customer security reviews, and working closely with Legal, Compliance and Privacy


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience managing and mentoring engineers and/or operations specialists

  • Expertise in incident response, with hands-on experience leading major incidents

  • Experience in threat intelligence and hunting, proactively seeking threats in complex, cloud-native environments

  • A good working understanding of adversarial techniques (MITRE ATT&CK and similar frameworks), and how you keep up to date

  • Genuine curiosity about the security risks introduced by AI systems, such as model abuse, prompt injection and data exfiltration

  • Familiarity with modern security operations tooling

  • Experience automating repeatable processes rather than relying on manual effort

You’ll also be:

  • An experienced leader with a track record of building and developing security operations teams across multiple geographies and time zones, who leads by example and creates clarity in ambiguous situations

  • Someone teams look to when things get difficult: composed, structured and decisive

  • Able to communicate risk clearly and confidently to audiences from engineers to executives

  • Able to show how you’ve built strong relationships across engineering, product and compliance

  • Able to set out a vision and strategy for how security operations will mature, and win buy-in from your team and stakeholders

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements that balance information security and commercial goals

  • Ready to challenge the status quo and find ways to make security more efficient and effective with AI

Skills (SFIA): We use the SFIA framework to assess and develop everyone in security roles. Levels run from 1 to 7.

Essential:

  • Level 5: Incident management, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, security operations, penetration testing, specialist advice

  • Level 4: Performance management

  • Level 3: Information security

Desirable: Vulnerability research (Level 5), information assurance (Level 5), emerging technology monitoring (Level 4), professional development (Level 4)


Our values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday [plus/including bank holidays], plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn, or read our Applicant Data Protection Policy.

descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch.

We are scaling fast. The CDS segment (health centers, ~€20–50k ARR per account) is one of our top priorities, but we still address it in an unstructured way.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €600k ARR in year one in new business on the CDS segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

  • Make your first prospecting calls, demos, and initial sales conversations

  • Open your first multi-stakeholder opportunities

3 months:

  • Improve our call scripts and email sequences

  • Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments

  • Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap
