6-12 months:

  • Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

  • Contribute to structuring our sales playbook

  • Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline

  • Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

  • Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

  • Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle

  • Map accounts and manage multiple stakeholders (center directors, group GMs, practitioners, secretaries) through a considered cycle

  • Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with center decision-makers

  • Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

  • Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments

Make the engine better

  • Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

  • Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the CDS segment

  • Deal size from 15K to 65K (~30K average)

  • 1.5 month sale cycle, multi-stakeholder

  • ICP: health centers (centres de santé)

This role is for you if

The prerequisites:

  • You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets: people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

  • You've run mid-market deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 1 year, on multi-stakeholder cycles (~€30k average basket). You map accounts, listen actively, and you're convincing and assertive in closing.

  • You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with center directors: health centers rewards organized, senior sellers, more structured. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to practitioners and secretaries with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews:

  • Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego: you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

  • Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

  • Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements:

  • 3–6 years of B2B sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience, ideally having done the BDR → AE track

  • Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

  • Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

  • Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

  • Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

  • Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

  • You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only sold by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

  • You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

  1. Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

  3. Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

  4. Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

  • 3D construction scene understanding

  • Construction semantic segmentation

  • Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

  • Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

  • Embedded AI deployment

  • Foundation models for construction understanding

  • Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

  • 🧠 Solve genuinely difficult perception and scene-understanding problems

  • 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

  • 🏗️ See your work applied to some of the world’s most ambitious construction projects

  • 📈 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🔬 Work alongside specialists across Computer Vision, AI, Navigation, Embedded Software and Hardware

  • 💡 Have meaningful influence over technical architecture and the future direction of our perception technology

  • 🌍 Build technology with tangible, real-world impact

If you’re passionate about 3D computer vision and spatial AI, enjoy solving difficult problems at the intersection of research and engineering, and want to see your work move from algorithms into technology being used in the physical world, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About AI Engineering at Rivia

Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform.

The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​

By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence.

 

The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​

You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​

The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain.

 

What excites you

  • Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team.

  • Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials.

  • Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential.

  • Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases.

  • Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value.

  • Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor.

  • Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production.

  • Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful.

  • Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage.

 

What Excites us

  • Product mindset, with a demonstrated ability to translate user workflows into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production

  • Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques.

  • Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains.

  • Strong software engineering skills and comfort owning systems end-to-end, from design to deployment and maintenance.

  • Experience going from 0→1 at a VC-backed startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

 

Hiring Process

Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages:

  1. Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

  2. Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

  3. Coding Interview: 60 mins with the team to assess your coding skills.

  4. Meet the team: 3-4 hours.Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

Verantwortungsvoller Einsatz von KI im Recruiting

Bei CRA verstehen wir Recruiting als eine Tätigkeit, bei der Menschen eine zentrale Rolle spielen. KI und andere digitale Tools unterstützen uns zwar dabei, effizienter zu arbeiten, ersetzen jedoch nicht den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern. Entsprechend erwarten wir auch von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, dass sie sich persönlich mit CRA und ihrer Bewerbung auseinandersetzen und sich auf die Gespräche mit uns vorbereiten. Weitere Informationen zum angemessenen Einsatz von KI im Recruiting bei CRA finden Sie auf unserer Website.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

title: Senior BI Analytics Engineer

Du verantwortest die Entwicklung deiner Kunden und Vertriebschancen eigenständig und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Wachstum von QMH.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit Projektvolumina zwischen 30.000 und 500.000 € sowie die Fähigkeit, bisherige Vertriebserfolge anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zu erläutern

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands von ca. 40–50 %, gelegentliche Reisen nach China sowie Führerschein Klasse B

Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt? Wir freuen uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du relevante Vertriebserfahrung, ein gutes Industrienetzwerk und die Motivation mitbringst, unser Geschäft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

Was dich bei QMH erwartet

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 55.000 und 75.000 € brutto sowie eine leistungsabhängige Provision ohne Deckelung

  • Firmenwagen: Ein Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

Deine ersten Monate bei QMH

In deinen ersten Wochen lernst du unser Leistungsportfolio, unsere Kundenstrukturen und unsere internen Vertriebsprozesse kennen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung, dem Vertriebsinnendienst und unseren erfahrenen Senior-Beratern zusammen.

Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist, dass du eigenständig Kundenbeziehungen entwickelst, neue Projekte gewinnst und den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts in Deutschland und an der Schnittstelle zu China aktiv vorantreibst.

title: Senior Client Engineer - Stumble Guys!
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Client Engineer to join our Stumble Guys Team in a hybrid set up at our Dundee office. 

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — both through our work environment and through the strong connections we build with our player communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of players worldwide daily.

Stumble Guys is one of our most recent hits, with millions of fans joining the party every day and keeping the game at the top of the charts in more than 50 countries. Our ambition is to build a beloved franchise that players enjoy for many years to come.

What You Will Do

  • Ship production-grade mobile games used by millions of gamers
  • Drive the implementation of game mechanics and system processes using Unity and C#
  • Drive the development of big and complex new features or improvements to existing ones
  • Ensure technical performance (crash rates, FPS, startup times, CPU usage, etc) is healthy throughout the development
  • Collaborate and communicate with cross-functional departments including game design, product management, marketing, etc.
  • Think about and propose solutions to the challenging problems of game development

What We're Looking For

  • Strong knowledge of C# and/or C++, or other relevant game-programming language
  • Extensive experience and knowledge of game engines, in particular Unity or a similar technology (like Unreal Engine)
  • Knowledge of Photon Quantum is a plus
  • Strong understanding of the basics of software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, game framework architecture at scale, maintainability over time, robust API design, etc.
  • Solid understanding of mobile networking best practices: request limiting, request caching, batching, content aggregation, minification, integrating with rest and TCP/UDP services, etc.
  • Experience with asynchronous, multi-threaded, parallel programming paradigms and other techniques to maximize UI responsiveness and do operations in background
  • Experience and understanding around client-side testing, like unit, functional or integration testing
  • Strong knowledge of game programming fundamentals, common patterns, how systems work together and various common architectural approaches
  • Strong mobile experience (iOS and Android): ability to debug native device issues, strong understanding of hardware and platform limitations, performance metrics, etc.
  • Good understanding of tooling around game development, like Git, Jenkins for build automation, etc.
  • Enjoy solving complex technical problems, especially in large systems

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

title: Senior Cloud Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you’ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!

About the Reconciliation team

Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world's largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.

As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role. 

What we are looking for

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform.You'll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.

What you'll do:

  • Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform. 
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.
  • Establish infrastructure standards and patterns for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.
  • Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.

What you'll bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 3+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.
  • Deep expertise with AWS & Kubernetes. Minimum 3+ years experience with each.
  • Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.
  • Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.
  • A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.

About you:

  • You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you're energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.
  • You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.

This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led — we're looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. 

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. 

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. title: Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.

Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt.
  • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.
  • Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können.
  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.
  • Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen.
  • AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Masterabschluss in einem technischen Fach (z. B. Informatik, Geoinformationssysteme, Geoinformatik, Physik, Mathematik).
  • Erfahrung: Mindestens vier Jahre Praxis- oder Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Promotion, wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit) im Bereich (urbane) 3D-Rekonstruktion, Computer Vision und Photogrammetrie, inklusive der Entwicklung funktionierender Produkte oder Prototypen.
  • Photogrammetrie: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Photogrammetrie und Fernerkundung: Sensor- und Kameramodelle, Kalibrierung sowie innere und äußere Orientierung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, Airborne-LiDAR und Luftbilder zu metrisch belastbaren, georeferenzierten Daten zu kombinieren.
  • Computer Vision: Starker Hintergrund in geometrischer und 3D-Computer-Vision: Structure-from-Motion, Dense Multi-View Stereo und Punktwolkenverarbeitung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, aus Punktwolken und Bildern Gebäudemodelle zu erzeugen.
  • Tech-Stack: Sicherer Umgang mit Python, insbesondere mit den relevanten Bibliotheken (NumPy, SciPy, PDAL, GDAL, OGR etc.).
  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest gern im Team und hast Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung (Git).
  • Interesse an der Domäne: Du hast Lust, in den anspruchsvollen PropTech-Bereich einzutauchen. Erfahrung in PropTech, Architektur oder Immobilienwirtschaft ist ein Plus.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du willst in einem schnell wachsenden Startup schnell wachsen, echten Impact haben und technologisch vorne bleiben, besonders bei Cloud-Technologien und KI.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. C1 Niveau).

Cherry on top

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien, idealerweise Google Cloud Platform.
  • Deutsche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster oder deutschlandweit remote

Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.
    • BusinessBike: Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen.

title: Senior Consulting Engineer
descriptionHtml:

  • Explore AI tools and workflows to improve creative speed and efficiency  

What You’ll Bring 

  • 8+ years of experience in brand, social creative, content strategy, or similar roles

What This Role Is Not 

A community or social media management role  

A pure performance marketing or media buying role  

A traditional brand campaign role focused only on large launches  

An agency coordination role without creative ownership 

A culture of growth    

With over 50 nationalities represented, we’re proud to welcome people of all backgrounds to our growing community, and we’re always finding new ways to help people feel welcomed and included. Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.    

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.

With 50M+ platform downloads, we're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, data-driven decisions, and the chance to grow by solving challenging problems, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.
  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.
  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.
  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

As a Senior Data Scientist in Credit Risk Modelling, you'll own credit risk and CLtV projects end to end – from spotting where the models hold the business back to getting the change live. The work ranges from keeping today's models accurate as conditions change, through incremental improvements, to research that could replace them.

You'll decide which problems to take on and how to solve them. With AI making prototyping cheap, more of the role now goes on research. You'll review other data scientists' modelling choices and coach newer members of the team.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Estimating the causal effect of amount, duration, and price on customer outcomes.

  • Unifying automated and manual models. Finding a principled way to put the two model families, which optimise slightly different objectives, on a common cost function.

  • IFRS accounting model. Developing a multi-stage model where recovery predictions feed back to improve the upfront loss estimates that International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) require.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Exploring whether a single, more general model could replace the separate credit and CLtV models.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Applied statistics. You have a background in statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar. You've applied it to commercial problems for several years, and chosen the methods yourself. You know when the data breaks a method's assumptions, and what that does to your answer.

  • Probabilistic reasoning. You quantify the uncertainty in each estimate, and treat calibration as a first-order concern.

  • Production ML. You've built supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere.

  • Project leadership. You've led modelling projects you spotted yourself, from framing the question to a decision the business acted on. Some of that work changed how a team models a problem.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it, and built tools or workflows your colleagues now use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You've worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Coaching. You've helped other data scientists improve their work, through review or mentoring.

  • Non-linear methods. You can think in terms of the cost function and inductive biases of your models.

  • Bayesian methods. You've used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You've modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £130,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £90K – £130K

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact AI projects and shape the technical direction of bespoke solutions. This role requires hands-on technical excellence combined with crucial team leadership.


You will define data science approaches, design robust software architectures, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure delivery rigour across projects all while building deep client relationships and solidifying our reputation as a leader in practical, measurable AI.

#LI-PRIO

  • Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.

  • Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

Our Interview Process

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling.

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL)
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: Senior Economist
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

Marketplace Highlights

  • Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

  • A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

  • Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Economist at Relay, you'll:

  • Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

  • Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

  • Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

  • Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

  • Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

  • Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

  • Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

  • Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

  • Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk. With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK.


As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite.


If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!


A bit about you…

  • You have 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales.

  • Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience in either Challenger, Gap Selling or PClub sales methodology, MEDDIC qualification methodology, forecasting, and ABM/ABS strategies.

  • Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close high-value deals.

  • Consultative sales approach, able to understand business challenges and position tailored solutions.

  • Resilience, confidence, and presence - you can hold the room, drive conversations, and articulate value effectively.

  • A team player mindset, working collaboratively across departments to drive success.

  • Coachability, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead in enterprise sales best practices.

 


Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Senior Enterprise Account Executive at Street Group

  • Executing ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting key accounts with a structured approach.

  • Prospecting and outbound outreach, using cold calling, email, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.

  • Managing and optimising CRM data, ensuring accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and progress.

  • Conducting research on industries, prospects, and competitors to craft personalised outreach.

  • Handling objections with confidence, positioning value-driven solutions tailored to client needs.

  • Collaborating with our Technical Pre-Sales team to map prospect workflows and demonstrate how Street transforms the way their agency operates end to end.

  • Developing strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within a business to drive engagement.

  • Becoming a product expert, understanding how our solutions solve industry challenges.

  • Refining sales processes and methodologies, working closely with leadership to enhance effectiveness.

  • Collaborating with sales, marketing, and a Strategic SDR to ensure seamless lead handoff, targeted outreach, and effective nurture strategies.

  • Continuously improving performance, embracing feedback, and adapting to new strategies and insights.


You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You need a fully qualified pipeline handed to you. Prospecting and pipeline generation are core to the role.

  • You're expecting a job where you can coast on existing relationships. We're hunting for new business into accounts we don't yet own.

  • You're looking for a fully remote role. We need you in the Manchester office a minimum of three days per week, every other week, and out with customers the rest of the time.

  • You think your product knowledge matters more than your ability to sell. We'll teach you the product; your commercial acumen is what we're hiring.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!


Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Why join Street Group?
