title: Senior Executive Assistant to the CEO (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

This is the most senior executive support role at Focused Energy. You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will take ownership of the operational infrastructure supporting the CEO, including diary and calendar management, travel coordination, executive administration and stakeholder logistics. The Chief of Staff leads strategic priorities, substantive briefings, executive alignment and follow-through on key decisions. You ensure the practical arrangements and information flow support those priorities effectively.

When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

You will exercise sound judgment and make day-to-day decisions independently within agreed parameters, knowing when to escalate strategic conflicts or sensitive matters. You will help establish reliable, efficient ways of working as the CEO Office develops.

You represent the CEO Office to investors, ministries, partner companies and board members. As the most experienced EA in the company, you also help shape how executive support works across Focused Energy.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and coordinate the CEO’s domestic and international travel, including complex delegations, conferences and investor or government engagements.

  • Own itineraries, participants, visas, invitations, registrations, protocol requirements, ground logistics, contingency arrangements and live coordination during trips.

  • Be willing to accompany the CEO internationally when needed, independently or alongside the Chief of Staff, while providing effective remote support on trips you do not attend.

  • Maintain a clear overview of upcoming commitments and what each requires. Anticipate conflicts, preparation needs and logistical dependencies, and act early.

  • Coordinate the timely preparation, collation and distribution of briefing materials, working with the Chief of Staff and relevant content owners.

  • Maintain clear administrative follow-up and ensure decisions, commitments and emerging priorities are promptly communicated to the Chief of Staff for strategic follow-through.

  • Build trusted relationships with investors, ministries, agencies, partner companies, board members and their offices.

  • Keep the CEO Office running effectively, including expenses, approvals, signatures, tools, records and contact management.

  • Help develop shared standards for calendar management, travel, tools and confidentiality, supporting collaboration and teamwork across the EA team, both locally and internationally.

Who You Are

  • You bring ten or more years of experience in executive support, including several years supporting a CEO, founder or managing director in an international business with extensive travel and calendar management. Experience in a growing company or investor environment is a plus.

  • You have supported highly driven, fast-moving executives and can bring structure to changing or incomplete requests.

  • You have managed complex delegation trips involving multiple participants, countries and official meetings.

  • You combine strong organisation, judgment and emotional intelligence with a calm, adaptable style and are comfortable partnering with a Chief of Staff while maintaining a direct, trusted relationship with the CEO.

  • You understand competing priorities and can make confident decisions within your remit.

  • You protect an executive’s time with diplomacy and build constructive relationships with the people seeking it.

  • You are comfortable working with board members, investors, ministries and senior executives, as well as the teams supporting them.

  • You work proactively, identifying scheduling conflicts, travel requirements and preparation needs before they become urgent.

  • You stay composed when plans change, communicate clearly and know when to bring others into a decision.

  • You handle sensitive board, investor, M&A and personnel matters with discretion.

  • You use modern scheduling and collaboration tools confidently and are interested in using AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work.

  • You are fluent in English and German.

  • You are based in Berlin, or willing to relocate, and comfortable travelling with the CEO when needed.

A Word On Pace

This is a demanding role, with a strong emphasis on complex calendar management, exceptional attention to detail and the delivery of high-level, hands-on executive support to the CEO of a rapidly growing international company. Priorities can shift quickly and some trips or commitments require flexibility at short notice. It calls for someone who enjoys responsibility, stays calm under pressure and communicates clearly about priorities and capacity.

In return, you can expect meaningful ownership, a close working partnership with the CEO and Chief of Staff, and the opportunity to help shape how the CEO Office operates. You will be trusted to exercise judgment within agreed responsibilities and escalation parameters.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

descriptionHtml:
About Assembled

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

The Role

We’re hiring our first marketer in London. Europe is our next growth market, and right now we’ve got a tight-knit, quota-focused sales team with big goals and not much regional marketing behind them—yet.

 

You’ll change that. Field events are the engine — dinners, roadshows, conferences, executive gatherings that put our team in front of the CX and Workforce Management leaders running Europe’s most complex operations. But this isn’t a role that stops at the event calendar. You’ll be the person who figures out what the European market needs from marketing and then goes and does it.

 

We’re starting in the UK with plans to expand across the region. You’ll work closely with our global events lead on moments where EMEA shows up inside the worldwide program, and with our growth team on campaigns that need European flair.

 

We work together in person five days a week from our London office in King’s Cross.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the EMEA field calendar and the budget behind it — decide which events, dinners, and roadshows are worth doing, and which ones we skip

  • Run field as a pipeline channel: pre-event targeting through opportunity creation and deal acceleration, with named accounts attached to every program

  • Build account-based programs sized to the deal, whether that's one account, a handful, or a roomful, in lockstep with the London sales team

  • Build our EMEA partner and channel motion — joint events, co-marketing, and the relationships that get us in front of buyers we can't reach on our own

  • Be the voice of the European market inside Assembled: what needs localizing, which content doesn't land, where our story has to change by country, and what customer stories to bring to life

  • Foster community efforts. Get to know the European CX/WFM community by genuinely contributing and building relationships across a wide variety of stakeholders

  • Bring EU-specific campaign ideas to the team and make sure Europe is designed into campaigns rather than translated at the end

  • Build AI workflows that let one marketer cover multiple countries — invite list enrichment, event pages, personalized follow-up at volume, post-event analysis

 

What You Bring

  • 6–9 years in field, events, or regional marketing at B2B companies selling into enterprise, including time owning UK or EMEA programs rather than supporting someone else's

  • Startup, get sh*t done mindset. The region is new and our team there is small and scrappy. You know how to spot the highest-leverage opportunities and collaborate cross-functionally to make magic happen

  • You've been early somewhere — the first marketer in a region or on a small team, where no playbook existed and you wrote one

  • Event judgment with receipts. Tell us about an event you cut and why, not only the ones that worked

  • Nice to have: experience in European markets beyond the UK, with an understanding of how programs need to differ by market

  • A close working relationship with sales. You've sat in pipeline reviews, you know what an AE needs from a dinner, and you can hold your own on account strategy

  • AI systems you've built and use, with an example you can walk through. One marketer covering this much ground without AI is a headcount request, not a plan

  • A bias to go first. You'd rather run a twelve-person dinner next month than spend the quarter planning a conference booth for next year

 

Our UK benefits

  • Quarterly credits for professional development, wellness, and commuting

  • Budget for AI tools and experimentation, giving you room to test new ideas, build workflows, and rethink how you work

  • Paid parental leave

  • Onsite work model with catered lunches everyday (M-F)

 

The estimated base salary range for this role is £80,000 - £105,000 per year. The base pay offered may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options are provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.

descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

Your mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.

At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. Your report directly to our VP of Finance and collaborating closely with Risk Management, Product, Compliance, among others, making sure our Finance function is set up for long-term operational excellence and scalability. This is your opportunity to have an impact, not just on the Finance department, but also on the product, to help launch a compliant investment product.

You will:

  • Manage and optimize various Finance processes, especially within Accounting, but also Regulatory Reporting or Planning and Controlling, by leveraging your knowledge and expertise.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Finance on special and strategic projects, helping transition processes into scalable, best-in-class workflows.

  • Be a point of contact for our external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of high quality documentation by various teams.

  • Work together closely with the Management Team and build, monitor and refine our annual financial plan and timelines.

  • Support on product work, defining and documenting functional requirements, establishing test concepts and testing/documentation and associated implications.

  • Cultivate a culture of knowledge-sharing as you work closely with our Product Development team, bridging the gap between finance and innovation for strategic product advancements.

You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have a strong background in Finance and regulated financial services. You have at least five years of experience in a finance function at a bank, FinTech, or another regulated institution, or with a Big Four or other leading audit firm. You have strong knowledge of German GAAP under HGB, including RechKredV or RechVersV. Knowledge of IFRS is a plus, as is experience with group accounting and consolidation.

  • You are proficient in Excel. You are comfortable using Excel to analyse financial information, prepare reports, and support finance processes. Experience with financial modelling is a plus.

  • You understand regulated financial environments. Experience in the regulated finance industry is required, and exposure to regulatory frameworks such as IFR or CRR would be particularly valuable.

  • You are willing to support in shaping the function. You are a hands-on player, willing to put high-quality processes in place from the beginning while remaining pragmatic with more complex solutions.

  • You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to deliver value by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.

  • Communication and collaboration come naturally to you. You are able to communicate well with diverse audiences and explain requirements and technical topics clearly, while effectively communicating the risks and opportunities you identify.

  • You understand what working in a startup or similar lean organisation is like. You can move quickly and focus on what is truly important.

  • Growing investing opportunities excites you. Our mission resonates with you because you have worked in the financial sector, such as brokerage or banking, or in the technology sector, such as FinTech or API-first companies.

  • You are fluent in German, or comfortable working in a German-speaking regulatory environment. Fluency in German is a plus.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Frontend Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role — our Frontend team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them

  • Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency

  • React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces

  • Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols

  • Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years)

  • Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols)

  • Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs

  • Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced

  • You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team

title: Senior Global Marketing Manager: Managed Service Providers
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Senior Marketing Manager to lead our marketing efforts across the Managed Service Provider (MSP) ecosystem. In this role, you will design and execute global "to-partner" and "through-partner" marketing programs that drive awareness, enablement, and demand generation. As a key bridge between Product Marketing, Global Campaign teams, and Channel Sales, you will own the marketing strategy that empowers MSPs to successfully scale their business using the Everpure platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Global Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Develop and execute the comprehensive global MSP marketing strategy and roadmap aligned with corporate revenue and channel growth objectives.
  • Lead MSP-exclusive initiatives such as nurture campaigns, webinars, events, and value-driven programs in collaboration with Product Marketing and Content Marketing.
  • Design, execute, and measure comprehensive demand generation strategies to drive engagement and acquisition across the MSP partner lifecycle.
  • Create and manage end-to-end "through-partner" demand generation campaigns (e.g., webinars, digital kits, event templates) that MSPs can easily white-label to acquire end-customers.

Partner Enablement & Content Creation

  • Build, launch, and maintain a world-class MSP enablement toolkit, including pitch decks, battlecards, data sheets, and value-proposition messaging frameworks.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate complex technical features into business outcomes that align with an MSP’s business model (e.g., recurring revenue, operational efficiency).
  • Own the marketing content strategy for the Partner Portal, ensuring assets are localized, up-to-date, and intuitive.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Alignment

  • Partner closely with Channel Sales and MSP Sales Team Members to align marketing initiatives with pipeline goals.

Metrics, Analytics & Optimization

  • Establish, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as partner In quarter created pipeline contribution (IQC), marketing-generated leads (MQLs), Marketing Influenced Pipeline (MIP), partner portal engagement, and program ROI.
  • Continually optimize campaign performance based on data insights, partner feedback, and regional sales inputs.

  • MarTech Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CRM and Marketing Automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, AppSheet) and Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Agility & Autonomy: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed tech environment with minimal day-to-day oversight.
  • Influence Without Authority: Strong interpersonal skills to drive alignment across Product, Sales, and Corporate Marketing teams.

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.
  • Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok en Snapchat werken en houdt hun innovaties bij.
  • Je bent creatief, maar werkt ook gestructureerd en gecoördineerd.

title: Senior Influencer Planning Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

The Senior Influencer Planning Manager is a hands-on strategic planner responsible for translating PlayStation's global influencer approach into clear, actionable plans across priority games, hardware, services, sponsorships, brand campaigns, and cultural moments. 

This role will support portfolio prioritisation, audience and creator plans, global/local processes, measurement, and investment recommendations that enable the broader Influencer Partnerships team to execute with greater clarity, consistency, and impact. 

Working closely with Influencer Partnerships, Brand, Media, Studios, Social, PR/Communications, Insights & Analytics, agencies, and local market teams, this role connects the planning approach to execution through strong briefs, planning tools, recommendations, and cross-functional coordination.

What you'll be doing:

Influencer Planning 

  • Develop planning documents, campaign frameworks, and recommendations for priority initiatives, translating audience objectives, business priorities, and cultural opportunities into actionable influencer plans. 
  • Maintain planning calendars, portfolio roadmaps, intake inputs, and decision materials across influencer workstreams. 
  • Partner with internal insights teams, agency partners, local teams, and activation leads to synthesise research into clear planning implications. 

Portfolio Prioritisation & Investment Strategy 

  • Support assessment of the appropriate influencer support model by initiative, including full-service, lighter-touch, locally led, agency-supported, or playbook-enabled approaches. 
  • Build planning inputs for investment and resource recommendations, balancing business impact, cultural opportunity, audience reach, market needs, and historical learnings. 

Global / Local Planning Model 

  • Coordinate early local market inputs, creator recommendations, market nuances, and feedback loops, translating them into clear global planning outputs. 
  • Maintain shared ways of working, planning templates, and governance that drive global consistency while supporting local relevance. 

Measurement, Learning & Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Maintain KPI, reporting, and learning frameworks and translate campaign performance into actionable recommendations for future planning. 
  • Build and maintain planning tools, playbooks, and knowledge resources that improve speed, clarity, and consistency. 
  • Create concise stakeholder updates and leadership readouts, partnering cross-functionally to resolve planning needs and improve execution readiness.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator strategy, brand planning, social strategy, entertainment marketing, digital marketing, or integrated campaign planning. 
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 
  • Strong understanding of the creator landscape, social platforms, gaming communities, entertainment culture, youth audiences, and emerging platform behaviours. 
  • Experience translating audience insights, cultural signals, creator trends, and business priorities into clear campaign strategies and planning recommendations. 
  • Experience supporting portfolio prioritisation, investment planning, measurement, and global/local ways of working in a complex or matrixed organisation. 
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and synthesise complex information into clear presentations and recommendations. 
  • Comfort working with KPIs and campaign performance data and translating results into practical planning implications. 
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to build trust across activation teams, local markets, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • AI fluency or willingness to rapidly adopt AI-enabled tools for research, trend scanning, reporting, knowledge management, and planning efficiency. 
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and high-visibility initiatives. 
  • Genuine passion for PlayStation, gaming, creators, entertainment, sports, youth culture, and the broader cultural landscape.

Benefits:

  • Discretionary bonus opportunity
  • Hybrid working model (FlexModes)
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Dental Scheme
  • 25 days holiday per year
  • On Site Gym
  • Subsidised Café
  • Free soft drinks
  • On site bar
  • Access to cycle garage and showers

title: Senior Information Security Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology"

Senior Information Security Consultant (m/w/d)

  • ISMS und BCMS: Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und nachhaltigen Verankerung von Informationssicherheits- und Business-Continuity-Managementsystemen, beispielsweise nach ISO 27001, TISAX® oder BSI IT-Grundschutz

  • Praxisnahe Informationssicherheit: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationssicherheit bei unseren Kunden nicht nur auf dem Papier existiert. Gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Ansprechpartnern entwickelst Du praxistaugliche Vorgaben und begleitest deren nachhaltige Umsetzung

  • Projektverantwortung: Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle und komplexe Kundenprojekte. Dabei steuerst Du die Projektbeteiligten, behältst Ziele, Qualität und Termine im Blick und sorgst für eine strukturierte Umsetzung

  • Portfolioentwicklung: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres ISMS- und BCMS-Beratungsportfolios und bringst Deine fachliche Erfahrung gezielt in neue Methoden, Leistungen und Beratungsansätze ein

  • Audit-Vorbereitung: Du bereitest unsere Kunden auf interne und externe Audits vor, coachst sie im Umgang mit Auditoren und vermittelst praxisnahe Tipps für eine erfolgreiche Zertifizierung

  • Dokumentation: Du erstellst und überarbeitest Auditunterlagen, Berichte, Sicherheitskonzepte und Maßnahmenpläne professionell und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Methoden & Standards: Du entwickelst Best Practices, Methoden und interne Standards kontinuierlich weiter und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Teams ein

  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt weniger erfahrene Kollegen bei fachlichen Fragestellungen, teilst Dein Wissen und gibst konstruktives Feedback

Das bringst Du mit

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der ISMS- oder BCMS-Beratung mit und hast bereits anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte eigenständig begleitet und fachlich gesteuert

  • Standards: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und regulatorischer Anforderungen, insbesondere ISO 2700x, BSI IT-Grundschutz, VDA ISA / TISAX® und KRITIS

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick

  • Kommunikation: Du trittst gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern sicher auf und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln, vom Fachexperten bis zum Management

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich und überzeugst durch einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Qualifikation: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder relevante Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen IT, Informationssicherheit oder Risikomanagement

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Kundentermine innerhalb der DACH-Region zu reisen. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei etwa 30 %

  • Weitere Expertise: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrung in der BCM-Beratung, einschlägige Zertifizierungen sowie Kenntnisse der Anforderungen aus NIS2 oder KRITIS

Was erwartet Dich noch?

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an.

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Team Management
    • Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.
  • Formal Training & Growth
    • Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.
  • Recruitment & Retention
    • Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.
  • Culture of Learning
    • Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Strategic & Operational Management

  • Budget & Capacity Planning
    • Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.
  • Risk & Contingency
    • Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.
  • Procedure & Frameworks
    • Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.
  • Prioritisation
    • Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.

Technical Support & Oversight

  • Performance Optimisation
    • Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.
  • Visual Documentation
    • Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.
  • Hybrid Estate Management
    • Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.
  • Unblocking Issues
    • Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover.

General Duties

On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations.

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

Leadership & Management Competencies

  • Proven Management Experience
    • Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc).
  • Project Management
    • Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment.
  • Communication
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members.
  • Goal Oriented
    • You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met.
  • ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma
    • Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts.

Technical Environment & Team Capabilities

Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions.

For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration.

Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation.

  • Innovation & Debt Management
    • A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt.
  • Advanced Containerization
    • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems.
  • Observability
    • Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana).
  • Data Streaming
    • Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid.
  • Web & Storage
    • Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster.
  • Tooling
    • Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.
  • Version Control
    • strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.

Why This Role?

If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business

This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical Insurance through Vitality
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Eye Care Vouchers
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure

title: Senior Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions.

  • Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions.

  • Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solvethe hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements.

  • Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1.

  • You are not afraid of different physics domains. You feel comfortable navigating the different physics regimes of a Stellarator - from waves propagating in a plasma to cryogenic properties of steel.

  • You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse.

  • You build consensus. You are a low-ego high-clarity communicator who works effectively with multiple technical leads, to bring integration challenges and system-level tradeoffs to a clear decision.

  • You commit to a concrete outcome. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at L3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: (Senior) Key Account Success Manager (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:

Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Kund:innen – auf Augenhöhe mit Entscheider:innen – und entwickelst Accounts strategisch weiter. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Sales, Deployment und Technical Project Management zusammen, um Deinen Kund:innen den bestmöglichen Erfolg mit Doctolib zu ermöglichen.

Deine Aufgaben

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Affinität für AI-Themen und Interesse daran, Potenziale für Kund:innen und interne Prozesse zu erkennen

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

You will work with our team of applied research engineers at the intersection of computer vision,  gameplay agents, natural language processing, and machine learning to create state-of-the-art tools to support game developers in our ecosystem with a focus on bots (trained gameplay agents, intelligent NPCs, companions, world modeling), as well as automation of a number key areas (including moderation, security, and QA testing). You will be responsible for the design, implementation and deployment of production-ready machine learning models that can be integrated in our ecosystem.

In this role, you will

  • Create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality machine learning models and associated algorithms that can make actions in game environments
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap
  • Methodically understand and assess the effectiveness of new data channels and support collection/creation of new ones

What we're looking for

    • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience 
    • Experience creating / applying machine learning algorithms for action modeling of bots behavior, vision-based or language-instructed, and deploying them as production-level systems in-game
    • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
      • Deep learning, incl. but not limited to applications in the gaming industry
      • Foundational models and vision and/or language, especially  vision-language-action models, reinforcement learning agents, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
      • Reinforcement learning, incl. experience with agentic systems, reward design, policy optimisation, evaluation, and building scalable training environments for agents
      • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
    • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible/agile/lean approach

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits except for PMI (for dependents). Our current benefits package includes pension, private medical insurance, health care cash plan, dental insurance, disability and life insurance, critical illness, cycle to work scheme, flu shots, health checks, and meals. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Messaging Platform
descriptionHtml:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.

The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.

We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.


What You'll Do

title: Senior People Partner - Content
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups)

  • Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner

  • A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels

  • Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment

  • Proactive and collaborative approach

  • A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture

Compensation & Benefits

Finance & Insurance

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped)

  • Private health insurance with dental and vision

Time Off

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months per year

  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company-wide events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

descriptionHtml:

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.
