title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be the primary software point of contact for the Laser team and provide technical leadership across software, hardware, and experimental-system interfaces. You will help define the architecture and technology direction for a greenfield laser-software platform while remaining hands-on in developing reliable tools for calibration, operation, human-machine interaction, and experimental data processing.

This role offers the opportunity to work across software, hardware, and experimental-system boundaries while contributing to a strong engineering culture within the Darmstadt Software Department. You will help shape technical direction, establish the foundations of a new software platform, and grow toward a broader technical leadership role. The position does not initially include direct people-management responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the primary software partner for the Laser team and coordinate software activities across laser projects.

  • Provide technical leadership for software initiatives, including planning, technical alignment, risk identification, and coordination with laser physicists, engineers, and systems-integration partners.

  • Help define the architecture, technology choices, development practices, and interfaces for a new laser-software platform in a greenfield environment.

  • Design and implement reliable software for critical laser projects, from system-level interfaces to user-facing applications.

  • Develop and maintain automated calibration software that improves repeatability, reduces manual effort, and supports reliable laser operation.

  • Design and build clear, dependable human-machine interfaces, dashboards, and operational tools for monitoring and operating laser systems.

  • Develop software that interfaces with laser devices, diagnostic systems, cameras, and experimental equipment to support data acquisition, system monitoring, operational control, and visualization.

  • Develop data-processing pipelines and data-storage solutions for experimental and operational data, including diagnostic and camera data where appropriate.

  • Define robust interfaces between software, hardware, cameras, and experimental systems in an environment where requirements and technologies are still evolving.

  • Work with networked device and system interfaces, potentially including TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable communication technologies.

  • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and operational guidance to support long-term maintainability and safe, reliable operation.

  • Identify and address reliability, performance, integration, debugging, and maintenance risks in software that interacts with real-world systems.

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the Software Department.

  • Mentor engineers and help establish engineering practices as the software team grows.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous technical problems and building systems from the ground up.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of technical direction while collaborating closely with software specialists, laser physicists, experimental experts, and systems-integration partners.

  • You can move effectively between technical leadership, project coordination, architecture, and hands-on implementation.

  • You take ownership of the quality, reliability, testability, and long-term maintainability of the systems you build.

  • You communicate clearly with both software specialists and technical partners from adjacent disciplines.

  • You apply sound technical judgment when making design, implementation, and technology-selection decisions in an evolving environment.

  • You are curious, adaptable, and motivated to understand how software interacts with hardware, cameras, diagnostics, and experimental systems.

  • You are experienced in debugging and testing complex software and understand their importance in senior-level engineering work.

  • You value constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other engineers.

  • You are interested in developing toward technical leadership and project ownership. Formal people-management responsibility is not required at the outset.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Python, or comparable programming languages.

  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

  • Knowledge of software architecture, code review practices, automated testing, technical documentation, and engineering best practices.

  • Experience with greenfield development, platform or architecture definition, and making technology choices where requirements are still evolving.

  • Experience with automated calibration, control-adjacent software, laboratory systems, automation, or physical-device interfaces.

  • Experience developing human-machine interfaces, dashboards, or software for operating technical equipment.

  • Experience with camera integration, image processing, diagnostic data, or experimental data-processing pipelines.

  • Experience developing data-storage solutions for high-volume, time-series, experimental, or operational data.

  • Familiarity with software-hardware integration and working across experimental-system boundaries.

  • Experience with networked device communication or system interfaces, such as TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with control systems or optics is beneficial, but not required; the ability to learn and collaborate across these disciplines is more important.

  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

You will join an engineering squad in our Berlin office working on distributed systems and platform infrastructure. Our products serve analytics engineers and business teams across the company, but this is primarily a systems engineering role (roughly 75% core software systems engineering, 25% data architecture). We value engineering depth: we build internal distributed solutions and understand the runtimes underneath, rather than only orchestrating managed tools.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will shape the architecture of our low-level infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and storage engines. You will lead technical design, resolve systemic bottlenecks in compute and streaming layers, and mentor engineers across squads, working with colleagues in Berlin, the US and Latin America.

What you will do

  • Design and build core low-level services and distributed runtimes for Nubank’s global data platform, with high fault tolerance, elastic scale and sub-second event availability.

  • Lead the design of compute orchestration frameworks on large Kubernetes clusters, improving scheduling throughput and resource utilization for complex data pipelines.

  • Design and optimize high-throughput streaming and storage architectures using Apache Kafka and distributed database internals for mission-critical financial workloads.

  • Find and remove performance, network and storage bottlenecks across the infrastructure stack to reduce latency.

  • Work with Analytics Engineering leads and platform users to define internal APIs, developer toolchains and data modeling practices that speed up developers company-wide.

  • Set standards for resilience testing, automated failover, observability and architectural documentation.

What you bring

  • Substantial experience designing, scaling and operating mission-critical distributed systems and backend architectures in high-throughput production environments.

  • Strong practical knowledge of container orchestration and systems management at scale, ideally Kubernetes internals and custom controllers or operators.

  • Advanced proficiency in a systems-oriented language such as Go, Java, Scala, Rust or C++.

  • Experience with database system architecture (storage engines, indexing, replication) and/or event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.

  • A track record of technical leadership: writing design proposals, aligning teams on complex technical decisions, and mentoring engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building internal developer platforms, custom compute engines or low-level database products.

  • Experience with data platforms or compute runtimes that support production AI/ML training and inference.

  • Familiarity with multi-region AWS networking, security, IAM and compute.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

This team spends most of its time working on customer focused features that improve the user experience, from content discovery and search to Roku pay and subscription to embedded software and firmware, and much more. Our product roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide. Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media.

What is the role?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the OS UI/SDK team, you will design, develop, and deliver engaging platform features — including screensavers, static and dynamic wallpapers, trivia, featured experiences, and AI-driven content initiatives — that reach millions of Roku users worldwide. You will leverage AI and machine learning technologies to develop new capabilities that enhance user experiences across the Roku platform. This role requires a proactive, ownership-driven approach where you will create proof-of-concept prototypes in a startup-minded environment and then adapt those prototypes for production-grade deployment. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in UI/UX design, product management, backend engineering, and business leadership to translate ideas into impactful solutions. You will investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain high-quality, commercially viable products. This is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming entertainment through innovation and a deep commitment to engineering excellence.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Design and develop features for new experiences on the Roku platform, including screensavers, wallpapers, trivia, and featured experiences
  • Build proof-of-concept prototypes to validate ideas rapidly, working with a startup mindset to iterate quickly and deliver solutions
  • Collaborate with UI/UX design, backend engineering, and product management teams to create and implement new user experiences
  • Adapt proof-of-concept solutions into production-ready, scalable implementations
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and large language model technologies to develop innovative platform features
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain commercially viable solutions
  • Contribute to API design decisions, understanding considerations and trade-offs
  • Work across cloud development, content management, and UI development to deliver end-to-end feature solutions

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • Extensive experience in a software engineering environment
  • Demonstrated project work using AI/ML and LLM technologies
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React Native, Python, BrightScript, or related technologies
  • Experience working in an embedded environment
  • Experience in productionising solutions, including content management, UI development, cloud development, and cloud backend integration
  • Knowledge of core OS concepts such as memory management and multi-threading
  • Experience in API design, with an understanding of considerations and trade-offs
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Consumer electronics experience in media, content, or ad product development is a plus
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
#LI-AM3

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Processor Software Stack)
descriptionHtml:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team members come from some of the best universities in the world and left some of the largest tech companies to build something truly remarkable.

Tasks

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is at home across our processor software from ported libraries and the compiler down to bare-metal and operating systems. Your team will: develop our software stack, including compiler, mapping tools, low-level tooling, simulation and debug infrastructure; write bare-metal, firmware and OS-level software for our RISC-V SoC; implement and optimise signal-processing and inference kernels under real-time constraints; bring up, test and port software on pre-silicon platforms and on silicon, including low-level hardware tests; and work in a close feedback loop with our hardware designers.

Requirements

  • Strong C, modern C++ (C++17/20, STL, Boost) and Python.
  • A solid foundation in algorithms and in hardware/software system architecture.
  • Experience working close to the hardware, with a good understanding of system-on-a-chip design, processor architecture and microarchitecture, and some familiarity with RTL and hardware design.
  • Experience with agentic programming.
  • You know your way around all of these fields, and go deep in at least one: i ) compiler development and code generation; ii) low-level tooling, simulation and performance analysis; iii) low-level embedded or systems software, operating systems and real-time; iv) signal processing, numerical computation and ML inference

title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

At Roku, the UI team builds the foundational frameworks, tooling, and high-performance UI components that power experiences across millions of devices. We own the middleware and UI layers that enable smooth navigation, responsive interactions, rich animations, and consistent developer workflows across the platform.

Our work spans graphics rendering, layout and animation systems, performance optimization, and developer APIs that make it easy to create reliable, visually compelling applications at scale. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment and partner closely with firmware, platform, and product teams to ensure the end-to-end experience is fast, robust, and future-ready.

What is the role?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the UI team, you'll design, implement, and optimize systems that underpin Roku's user experience and developer platform. You'll work on performance-critical code paths across graphics rendering, animation, layout, and UI frameworks, ensuring smooth visuals and highly responsive interactions across a wide range of devices.

At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course. You'll play a key role in shaping core architecture, working across the stack with hardware, firmware, and application teams, and delivering solutions that directly impact tens of millions of users. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy deep technical problem-solving, care about performance at a systems level, want to build the foundational layers that power great user experiences — and are energized by the shift to agentic engineering. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Build and scale UI frameworks and features optimized for millions of users
  • Design and implement performance-critical systems across rendering pipelines, layout engines, and animation frameworks using C++
  • Drive work through agentic coding tools — setting context, planning, and verifying agent-generated output across the full SDLC
  • Develop and maintain developer-facing tools and UI layers
  • Lead technical investigations and architect solutions across middleware and UI infrastructure
  • Integrate AI/ML and generative AI capabilities into developer workflows and platform features
  • Establish verification practices — testing, review, and quality gates — that let the team operate confidently on AI-assisted work
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver platform features with measurable gains in performance, reliability, and scalability
  • Create tooling, frameworks, and automation that improve developer efficiency and code quality
  • Mentor junior engineers through design reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance — including how to effectively drive and verify AI agents
  • Stay current with advancements in graphics, UI systems, and AI, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on UI frameworks, systems, or application development
  • Strong proficiency in C++ for performance-critical systems and rendering pipelines
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript for building UI layers and developer-facing tooling
  • Experience with JavaScript/BrightScript or similar scripting languages
  • Proficiency in Python for tooling, automation, or AI workflows
  • Demonstrated fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks — with projects where you've shipped real work using these tools
  • The ability to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you
  • A working understanding of common AI failure modes and the habits to catch them before they ship
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML and generative AI tools into development workflows or product features
  • Solid understanding of graphics systems, rendering, or UI performance optimization
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills
  • Clear and effective technical communication skills
  • You can describe specific examples where you used AI tools, agents, or workflow automation to move faster, raise quality, or scale your impact. You frame problems well, guide AI-assisted work, verify results, and ramp quickly in unfamiliar domains
  • Above all: curiosity, adaptability, good judgment, and a genuine willingness to learn new ways of working alongside AI
#LI-NM1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

ABOUT TIDE

At Tide we help SMEs save time (and money) in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market with over 1.8 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data-driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save both time (and money) so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Tide is hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the architecture of our agentic platform. You will shape the shared capabilities that allow AI systems to operate safely, reliably, and at scale across Tide. That includes context, orchestration, tool execution, trust controls, observability, and evaluation. You will participate in key build versus buy decisions, integrate external components where they accelerate us, and ensure we own the parts that matter most for Tide’s trust, data advantage, and long-term platform leverage.

As a Senior Staff Engineer you’ll: 

  • Define the architecture for Tide’s agentic platform
  • Drive the design of shared services such as context APIs, tool layers, policy controls, and auditability 
  • Partner with product, data, security, and engineering teams to turn use cases into reusable platform capabilities
  • Set standards for reliability, safety, scalability, and developer experience
  • Provide technical leadership across teams and unblock critical decisions
  • Implement cost-management and routing logic to optimize LLM spend across different providers
  • Design and build automated evaluation pipelines to measure agent reasoning accuracy and safety trajectories 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • Deep experience building platform or infrastructure systems at scale
  • Strong judgement across APIs, distributed systems, data, and cloud-native architecture
  • Track record of leading complex cross-team technical problems
  • Experience integrating third-party platforms without losing control of core architecture
  • Strong understanding of reliability, security, and observability
  • Experience with AI platform components is valuable, but not essential
  • Experience in highly regulated industries (Fintech, Healthtech, etc.) where safety and compliance are core to the product is highly desirable 

Our Tech Stack:

  • Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
  • Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
  • Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
  • Docker, Terraform, EKS used by the Cloud team to run the platform
  • DataDog and Rollbar to keep it running
  • GitHub with Sonarcloud, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks
  • Angular 2+ with ngrx on Web, Flutter for the Mobile App
  • Fivetran/Snowflake/Looker for the BI insights and Python/Faust/Flask/Tecton + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. 

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.

You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.

Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.

You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.

The team and culture

The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.

We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.

You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.

One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.

What we're looking for

  • Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.
  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.
  • Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
  • Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

If you want to explore how complex AI systems really behave, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Systems Engineering team.

title: (Senior) Team Lead Sales B2C (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Jetzt bauen wir unser nächstes Kernprodukt auf: Klimaanlagen. Greenfield. Enpals nächste Marktführerschaft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unseren Inside-Sales-Vertrieb from scratch aufbaut und führt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du bist die erste Sales-Führungskraft der neuen Unit. Du startest mit 3 bis 5 Sales Managern und skalierst das Team auf 8 bis 12 und prägst es dabei mit deinen Prozessen, deinem Leitfaden und deiner Handschrift. Das Recruiting verantwortest du gemeinsam mit Talent Acquisition, vom Anforderungsprofil bis zur Einstellungsentscheidung.

  • Sales Playbook: Du entwickelst unseren Sales-Leitfaden für Klimaanlagen, von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Einwandbehandlung bis zum Closing, und optimierst ihn kontinuierlich auf Basis von Daten und Gesprächsanalysen.

  • Prozesse, Tools & Markt: Du führst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Produkt und Operations CRM, Tools, Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Planung und Installation weiter. Dabei beobachtest du Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Impulse für Angebot, Pricing und Verkaufsstrategie.

  • Ramp-up & Coaching: Du onboardest neue Sales Manager strukturiert und bringst sie schnell auf Ziel-Performance. Dafür nutzt du einen klaren Einarbeitungsplan, Shadowing, Zertifizierung und definierte Ramp-up-KPIs. Anschließend entwickelst du jedes Teammitglied durch regelmäßige 1:1s, Call-Reviews und Side-by-Side-Coaching individuell weiter und gibst dabei klares, konstruktives Feedback.

  • Performance-Steuerung: Du etablierst ein transparentes KPI-System (z. B. Erreichbarkeit, Termine, Conversion, Umsatz pro Kopf) und steuerst damit Kapazitäten und Performance des gesamten Teams: von Lead-Verteilung und Schichtplanung inkl. saisonaler Peaks bis zu Conversion Rates entlang des gesamten Funnels. Du erstellst Forecasts, leitest Maßnahmen ab, setzt sie konsequent um und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung.

  • Leading by Example: Du bist nah am Kunden, führst insbesondere in der Pilotphase selbst Verkaufsgespräche und prägst eine leistungsorientierte, wertschätzende Teamkultur.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im B2C mit, idealerweise im Inside Sales (Telefon/Video) mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, z. B. in Energie, PV, Wärmepumpe oder Haustechnik. Außerdem hast du eine Affinität zu Energie, Gebäuden und Haustechnik.

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Sales-Teams. Für das Senior-Level sind es 4+ Jahre bzw. die Führung von 8+ Personen.

  • Nachweisbarer Track Record: Du hast selbst überdurchschnittlich verkauft und Teams messbar zur Zielerreichung geführt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Onboarding und Coaching von Sales Manager:innen sowie im Aufbau von Gesprächsleitfäden und Sales-Playbooks.

  • Datengetriebener Steuerungsansatz: Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPI-Dashboards und erkennst Hebel im Funnel schnell.

  • Aufbau-Mentalität: Du gehst gern in Greenfield-Situationen, packst selbst mit an und übernimmst volle Ownership.

  • Du kommunizierst stark und überzeugend, begeisterst Menschen und führst sie zu Spitzenleistungen.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit -Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost -29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

  • Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Senior Trading Manager (UK) -  Myprotein
descriptionHtml:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Role: Senior Trading Manager

Brand: Myprotein

Reporting to: Ecommerce Director 

Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (Fully Office Based) 

As Senior Trading Manager for the UK, you will own the commercial performance of Myprotein's UK website, driving profitable growth through effective ecommerce trading, customer experience and onsite optimisation.

You will set the UK ecommerce strategy, translating commercial objectives and customer insight into clear trading priorities. Combining strong commercial judgement with data-led decision-making, you will identify opportunities, drive performance and lead cross-functional teams to deliver growth.

The Details

  • Own UK website performance across revenue, traffic, conversion, AOV, margin and profitability.
  • Set and deliver the UK ecommerce trading strategy, translating business targets into clear priorities and action plans.
  • Drive onsite trading and optimisation across merchandising, navigation, search, landing pages and promotional activity.
  • Manage pricing and promotional investment, balancing revenue growth, margin and customer experience.
  • Lead forecasting and performance reviews, identifying risks, opportunities and actions to maximise trading performance.
  • Use customer insight, competitor activity and market trends to inform commercial decisions and identify growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Marketing, CRM, Brand, Product, UX, Technology, Supply Chain and Finance to deliver the UK growth agenda.
  • Drive improvements across the customer journey, increasing conversion, basket size, retention and customer lifetime value.
  • Lead testing and optimisation initiatives, using clear hypotheses and measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Champion AI, automation and analytics to improve decision-making, efficiency and trading effectiveness.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering commercial priorities.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant experience in ecommerce, digital trading or online retail, ideally within a fast-paced DTC or consumer business.
  • Proven track record of owning website performance and delivering profitable commercial growth.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce trading metrics, including revenue, conversion, AOV, margin and customer lifetime value.
  • Experience developing and executing trading strategies and onsite optimisation plans.
  • Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to balance growth, profitability and customer experience.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, able to turn insight into clear commercial actions.
  • Proactive and autonomous, with a strong bias for action and personal accountability.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in testing, optimisation and continuous improvement.
  • Confident using BI and ecommerce analytics tools, with an interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve performance.
  • Clear communicator, comfortable challenging thinking and driving decisions at pace.

What’s in It for Me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes designed by our in-house Learning & Development team.

  • Develop your expertise through our upskilling programme, delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Enjoy your birthday off, on us!

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.

  • Up to 10 days’ compassionate leave.

  • Option to buy up to 3 additional days of annual leave each year.

  • Unlock 2 days of volunteer leave after 12 months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.

  • Access our 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme, provided by Bupa.

  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.

  • Access to our on-site physiotherapist.

Other Perks

  • Save up to 12% on personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.

  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.

  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

  • On-site staff shop and barber.

  • Refer someone to THG and receive up to £1,000 when they pass their probation.

  • Anniversary gifts when you reach 5 and 10 years of service.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

title: Senior Value Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The UK Value Engineering team is responsible for our largest Fortune500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with Data and AI. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis data & AI platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments. 

The Role:

As a Senior Value Engineer you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers by owning their end-to-end value journey. You are their trusted technology & business advisor, helping organisations achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, helping organisations understand where Celonis fits into their IT landscape and AI strategy, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements. Your skillset combines a strong understanding of technology at both strategic and practical levels with consulting skills around strategic thinking and program management. 


The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Advise organisations on how Celonis’ platform fits into their existing IT landscape and AI strategy
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Use hands-on tech skills (SQL/Python) to build out (AI) prototypes to bring the Celonis platform to life for new audiences
  • Communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives.

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), Hands-on SQL and/or Python skills,, experience in collaborating with IT teams, experience developing dashboards and automations in tools like PowerBI or RPA, knowledge of and experience with AI-powered solutions.

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics or a comparable technical degree

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

title: (Senior ) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our (Senior) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d), you build and run the verification process that proves our safety controller and the safety software on our robots do what the safety requirements say, release after release. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one. You work daily with the safety (software) engineers and with TÜV to define what must be verified. Early on, you set up and prove the verification system for the current system, and you then carry it into the certification of the new controller.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the verification of our new safety controller end to end, from the verification plan to the certification evidence (target PL d per ISO 13849-1:2023 and SIL 2 per IEC 61508)

  • Build the complete verification catalog and set up the verification process and structure from scratch

  • Verify the safety software at unit and integration level with automated tests including fault and robustness cases, structural coverage, static analysis, and code and requirement reviews

  • Automate verification so that it runs on every change

  • Verify the controller and its safety functions as part of the robot arm against ISO 10218-1:2025

  • Keep traceability from risk assessment to test results and write reports that hold up in an audit

  • Work closely with the safety (software) engineers and TÜV to define what must be verified

  • Review the verification work of your colleagues and share your practices with the team

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A degree in a technical field such as software, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of experience verifying or testing safety-critical embedded systems in industrial automation, automotive, rail, aerospace or medical devices

  • Enough embedded C to write white-box tests and to find defects in a code review

  • Working knowledge of IEC 61508-3 or its industry counterpart (ISO 26262-6, EN 50716, DO-178C) and the verification evidence it requires

  • Hands-on lab skills with oscilloscope, logic analyser and debugger, including measuring a reaction time you can defend

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with EtherCAT and Safety over EtherCAT (FSoE) or another safety protocol such as PROFIsafe or CIP Safety is a plus

    • Experience with ISO 10218-1:2025, ISO 13849-1:2023 or IEC 62061, HIL tooling, coverage and static analysis tools (e.g. VectorCAST, TESSY, LDRA, Polyspace), MISRA C, robot kinematics, or working with a certification body such as TÜV is a plus

    • Clear technical writing and fluent English (C1+); German is a plus

How you'll make an impact

  • You drive complex, ambiguous work to clear outcomes and raise the quality of your colleagues' work through review and mentorship.

  • You translate goals into plans independently, identify improvements to processes and tooling, and make most decisions in your area.

  • You bring specialized expertise and cross-functional knowledge, and solve complex problems with strong analytical and contextual judgment.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. We have partnered with some fantastic restaurants such as Wagamama, Starbucks, Pho and Gourmet Burger Company to help further connect them with hungry customers.

Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. The Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners.

Benefits

  • 25 days holiday, increases with length of service

  • Free food and LOTS of it

We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
