title: Staff Engineer - Search
descriptionHtml:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

As a Staff Engineer on the Search team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: making every employee able to find what they need, and get a trustworthy answer, across Staffbase and the tools around it. Today search spans people, posts, pages, files and connected integrations, and it increasingly feeds AI-generated answers. You'll define how retrieval, ranking and grounded answers work at that scale.

Your north star is a search platform that finds the right thing, fast, for the right person. It must respect permissions on every query, work in every language our customers use, and give answers that cite their sources. You'll build the core, set the quality bar, and decide where we use proven techniques and where we experiment, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.

This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver. You'll shape the direction of an open-ended problem, and you'll measure your work with real relevance data, not gut feeling.

Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Java, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, MongoDB, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, plus LLM and embedding services for retrieval, reranking and summarisation.

The Team

The Search team sits at the heart of how employees find information at Staffbase. We own the full path from query to result: indexing and embeddings, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, ranking and reranking, typeahead, and the AI summaries that answer questions with citations. Search is also a core source of knowledge for Navigator, our AI assistant, and the main way it grounds its answers in company content.

That means two big things. First, we make results relevant: understanding the query, retrieving the right candidates, ranking them well, and doing it in the user's language. Second, we make search safe and fast: every result respects the user's access rights, every tenant stays isolated, and the fast path stays fast. We don't ship relevance changes on a hunch. We run offline evaluations, golden query sets and online signals, and we change one thing at a time.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it

What you'll be doing

  • Define and drive the search and retrieval strategy: hybrid (BM25 + vector) retrieval, reranking, query understanding and rewriting, chunking and embedding choices
  • Build and evolve the core ingestion and query pipeline, from sync and indexing to ranked results and AI summaries with citations
  • Own search quality: build evaluation tooling and golden sets (including unanswerable and permission-varying queries), define relevance metrics, and turn them into decisions
  • Protect the non-negotiables at scale: permission-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, multilingual handling, and graceful degradation when a dependency is slow or down
  • Balance latency, quality and cost, for example what runs on the fast path versus what is allowed on the slow path
  • Make search observable: tracing, relevance dashboards, and a clear way to debug why a result did or did not appear
  • Lead technical strategy and architecture, and document key decisions so others can build on them
  • Take ownership of major technical decisions, proactively addressing bottlenecks and ensuring product quality
  • Work with Product and Design to turn user problems into measurable search improvements
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps with engineering leadership, and coordinate with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)
  • Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, design discussions and experiment reviews
  • Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)

What you need to be successful

  • Proven track record as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead with strong leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience building production search or retrieval systems (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr or similar), including relevance tuning, analyzers, and index design
  • Hands-on experience with modern retrieval: vector/kNN search, hybrid fusion (e.g. RRF), cross-encoder reranking, chunking and embeddings; ideally RAG or LLM-grounded answers
  • A measurement mindset: you've built or used relevance evaluation (recall, MRR, nDCG, golden sets, LLM-as-judge with human checks) and can tell a real improvement from noise
  • Strong understanding of multi-tenant architecture and permission-aware retrieval, with good judgment on security and isolation in search
  • Experience with latency-sensitive systems: budgets, timeouts, caching, fallbacks and degradation
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin/Java (or Go) on the backend; comfortable with React/TypeScript on the frontend
  • Knowledge of architecture and design patterns, and the judgment to make trade-offs and weigh their long-term impact
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain relevance and ranking trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with Product and Design leaders to deliver customer value in an Agile environment
  • Passion for building high-quality software
  • Passion for diversity and inclusion, and the ability to foster a culture where everyone's voice is heard

Nice to have

  • Multilingual search (analyzers, language detection, cross-language retrieval)
  • Query understanding: rewriting, expansion, typeahead and spell correction
  • Prompt-injection and data-poisoning awareness in RAG systems
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support-we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day- you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

title: Staff Hardware Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM), you will serve as the central technical liaison driving joint vehicle programs between our engineering teams and Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche. Based out of our Berlin hub, you will bridge the gap between our US-based core engineering teams and our European brand partners, aligning complex hardware requirements, program roadmaps, and architectural decisions.

Rather than managing tier-level supply chains, your focus is entirely collaborative and strategic: orchestrating alignment across brand engineering groups, manufacturing plants, and internal hardware teams to turn ambitious vehicle programs into production reality.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the hardware integration partner for VW, Audi, and Porsche in parallel, keeping alignment across the three brands on requirements, schedules, and decisions.

  • Own hardware integration schedules, milestones, and readiness gates across assigned vehicle programs, from prototype builds (EVT, DVT) through production validation.

  • Drive engineering change management, including Program Change Requests (PCRs), impact assessments, and approval through partner boards.

  • Coordinate with internal hardware development and validation teams, and bridge the time difference between the US home base and European partners.

  • Track and close hardware issues and open action items, with clear owners and due dates.

  • Lead cost-reduction initiatives on hardware platforms, including proposal reviews and status reporting.

  • Represent hardware integration in program reviews, quality boards, and steering meetings, preparing decisions and clear status updates for leadership.

  • Maintain the Brand Technical Responsible (BTV) interface, collecting partner feedback and turning it into prioritized actions.

  • Help build and grow the European partnering team over time, including hiring and onboarding as the program scales.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong background in hardware development and/or hardware validation, with enough technical depth to challenge engineering decisions and follow test results.

  • Generalist profile: comfortable moving between hardware design, validation, program management, and partner alignment.

title: Staff Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 4, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 4 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.

In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python, with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings. 

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.

At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas.  They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems.  They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.

  • Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.
  • Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.
  • Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.
  • Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.
  • Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.
  • An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.
  • Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.

Bonus Points For:

  • You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.
  • Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation
  • Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams
  • Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration
  • Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the compensation range for this role is EUR 113,000 - EUR 141,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Stage Bouw
descriptionHtml:
Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor!

Dit wordt jouw stage

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is!

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen.

Hier zit je goed!

Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie.

Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen.

Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie.


Dit breng je mee

  • Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde);

  • Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij!

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

Meer weten?

Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens.

Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Vos missions :

Vous contribuerez à la préparation des documents techniques, à la standardisation des outils d'ingénierie et au suivi des projets en pré-construction, en collaboration avec l'équipe EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction).

  • Analyser, avec les ingénieurs concernés et les équipes EPC, les contraintes des projets et explorer les solutions techniques d’hybridation adaptées.

2. Conception électrique

  • Echanger avec les fournisseurs sur les offres techniques en fonction des besoins et des caractéristiques de chaque projet.

3. Études de mise à la terre et solutions de conformité au réseau

  • Réaliser des études de mise à la terre à l’aide du logiciel XGSLab, sous la supervision de l’équipe d’ingénierie électrique.
  • Développer des modèles et des trames de calcul standardisés, adaptables aux différentes configurations de projets.
  • Analyser les exigences de raccordement et de conformité au réseau applicables aux turbines éoliennes reconditionnées.

title: Stage – Ingénieur(e) Production & Industrialisation
descriptionHtml:
Isembard est une scale-up industrielle « software-first » qui reconstruit un réseau européen et souverain de fabrication de précision. Nous fabriquons des pièces usinées complexes (tournage, fraisage 5 axes) pour la défense, le spatial, les drones et l’aéronautique. Nous travaillons l’aluminium, l’acier inoxydable, le titane et d’autres alliages aéronautiques.

Notre première usine française, à Wissous, monte rapidement en cadence, avec de nouvelles machines, de nouveaux clients et de nouveaux process. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire ingénieur(e) pour rejoindre l’équipe fondatrice. Vous travaillerez directement avec notre Ingénieur Production fondateur.

Vos missions

  • Gestion de production : appuyer le suivi quotidien de la production et la planification. Vous contribuerez aussi au respect des délais de livraison des commandes clients.

  • Standardisation des process : rédiger et déployer avec l’équipe des instructions de travail. Elles couvriront la réception des marchandises et des matières, les expéditions, le référencement fournisseurs, ainsi que la gestion des RFQ et des documents.

  • Management de la qualité : contribuer à la construction de notre système qualité ISO 9001 et EN 9100. Cela comprend la traçabilité matière, les certificats, le processus de non-conformités (NCR) et l’inspection premier article (FAI).

  • Capacité industrielle : aider à identifier, évaluer et intégrer des sous-traitants en usinage pour étendre nos capacités et notre savoir-faire.

  • Lean & performance : animer et soutenir les démarches 5S en atelier.

  • Équipements & digital : participer à la mise en service des nouvelles machines et au déploiement de nos logiciels d’usine développés en interne (ERP, stocks, traçabilité).

  • Projets : porter un ou deux projets d’amélioration de bout en bout, du problème jusqu’à la solution déployée.

  • Vos idées : si vous identifiez un sujet où vous pouvez contribuer au succès d’Isembard, proposez-le et nous le concrétiserons ensemble.

Votre profil

  • Étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur (dernière année ou césure), en génie mécanique ou génie industriel.

  • Intérêt pour l’usinage, les procédés de fabrication et la qualité. Savoir lire des plans techniques et le GD&T (cotation ISO GPS) est un plus.

  • Structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), tout en étant à l’aise pour avancer vite dans une petite équipe sans management intermédiaire.

  • Concret(e) et sur le terrain : vous aimez passer du temps en atelier, pas seulement derrière un écran.

  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais, car nous échangeons chaque semaine avec notre siège à Londres.

  • Bonus : des bases en Lean / Six Sigma.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • De vraies responsabilités dès la première semaine, dans une usine en pleine construction.

  • Une exposition directe à des clients de la défense, du spatial et de l’aéronautique et à leurs exigences qualité.

  • Le mentorat d’un ingénieur production et supply chain expérimenté (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, CPIM).

  • Une scale-up en forte croissance, bien financée, avec une présence européenne.

title: Stage R&D - conception d'un banc d'essai automatisé
descriptionHtml:
Aerophile développe une technologie de filtration électrostatique (précipitateurs
électrostatiques – ESP) capable d’éliminer jusqu’à 95 % des particules fines.

Pour qualifier, caractériser et faire progresser ces filtres l’équipe R&D souhaite
se doter d’un banc d’essai autonome et polyvalent. Ce banc devra reproduire des
conditions climatiques contrôlées (température, humidité, taux de particules,
gaz si besoin) et des conditions de fonctionnement variables, tout en mesurant
automatiquement les performances du filtre (efficacité de filtration,
concentrations particulaires amont/aval, perte de charge, débit …).

Vous aurez donc pour mission de concevoir et mettre en œuvre l’automatisation
du banc d’essai, de l’acquisition des mesures jusqu’au pilotage des conditions
d’essai permettant de caractériser et de qualifier les performances des filtres
électrostatiques de manière autonome.

Vos missions

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de conception et de réalisation d’un
banc d’essai automatisé, avec un rôle central dans la conception de son système
de régulation, de pilotage et d’acquisition. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec
les différents pôles de l’entreprise, de la conception à la mise en service du
système.

En particulier :

  • Conception de la chaîne d’asservissement du débit et des conditions d’essai
    (régulation, actionneurs, boucles de contrôle). Dimensionnement aéraulique
    (mécanique des fluides) ;
  • Conception/choix et intégration des systèmes de génération et de régulation
    des conditions climatiques (température, humidité, génération de particules
    PM calibrées, injection de gaz si besoin) ;
  • Sélection et intégration des capteurs de mesure (compteurs/granulomètres
    de particules amont/aval, capteurs de pression différentielle, débitmètres,
    capteurs environnementaux, ...) ;
  • Conception de cartes électroniques (PCB) dédiées au pilotage et à
    l’acquisition si besoin ;
  • Développement de la chaîne d’acquisition, de traitement et de visualisation
    des données (firmware embarqué, communication, base de données) ;
  • Participation à la conception mécanique du banc d’essai à l’aide d’un logiciel
    de CAO ;
  • Participation au sourcing, consultation de fournisseurs et commande de
    composants et pièces ;
  • Fabrication, montage mécanique, électronique et intégration informatique
    du banc ;
  • Mise en service, calibration et validation métrologique du banc ;
  • Réalisation de campagnes de validation de l’automatisation sur des filtres
    électrostatiques.

Vos compétences

Étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur (Bac+5), avec une formation
orientée vers la mécatronique, l’électronique, le génie électrique, l’automatisme
ou l’instrumentation.
Un profil pluridisciplinaire, avec des connaissances en génie physique, mesures
physiques ou mécanique des fluides, est particulièrement adapté au projet.

  • Programmation embarquée et traitement de données
  • Asservissement et régulation (boucles PID, instrumentation de contrôle)
  • Électronique (conception de cartes PCB, capteurs, interfaçage numérique :
    I²C, RS485, etc.)
  • Physique expérimentale et métrologie (incertitudes de mesure, calibration de
    capteurs)
  • Notions de mécanique des fluides (pertes de charge, dimensionnement de
    ventilateurs et de gaines)
  • Notions de conception mécanique et prototypage (CAO, conception et
    réalisation de prototypes)
  • Connaissance ou appétence pour la qualité de l’air appréciée

Avantages

Au sein d’une PME innovante, vous intégrerez une petite équipe R&D dynamique
et enthousiaste et aurez l’opportunité de concevoir, de A à Z, un outil clé pour le
développement de nos technologies de qualité de l’air. Vous bénéficierez d’une
réelle liberté dans vos choix techniques et travaillerez sur un projet concret, à fort
impact environnemental, au sein d’une structure à taille humaine où vous
contribuerez directement aux futurs développements de l’entreprise.

title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
descriptionHtml:

Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure.

  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites

title: Stagiair Strategy & Operations (meewerkstage)
descriptionHtml:
31-38.75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Ben je nieuwsgierig naar hoe bedrijven en organisaties in de Nederlandse industrie zijn georganiseerd? Wil je bijdragen aan de verbetering en vernieuwing van toonaangevende bedrijven? Wil je samen met een team consultants bijdragen aan complexe vraagstukken, het ontwikkelen van slimme inzichten en deze vertalen naar strategische oplossingen? Dan is deze stage bij Berenschot iets voor jou.

In deze meewerkstage help je mee aan het oplossen van strategische en operationele vraagstukken van klanten uit de industrie: je bekijkt hun grootste uitdagingen op het gebied van strategische positionering, product- en marktkeuzes,, procesoptimalisatie en digitalisering.

Dit ga je doen

Je gaat meewerken aan diverse opdrachten voor klanten uit de industrie en het bredere bedrijfsleven, zoals het ontwikkelen van een nieuwe strategie, het in beeld brengen van een markt of sector, het verbeteren van de operationele processen, het implementeren van technologische innovaties en het organiseren van transformaties voor groei en prestatieverbetering. Bij ‘industrie’ denken we onder meer aan de maakindustrie, defensie-industrie, voedselverwerkende industrie en hightechindustrie.

Je komt te werken in een platte organisatie die altijd openstaat voor nieuwe en innovatieve ideeën, waar je veel vrijheid krijgt om te leren én om mee te denken.

Voorbeelden van projecten waaraan jij meehelpt:

  • Begeleiding van strategische workshops om de strategie van de organisatie te herijken.

  • Doen van marktonderzoek voor een servicepartner in scheepsmotoren.

  • Verbeteren van de kwaliteit en doorlooptijd van het productieproces bij een fabrikant van auto-onderdelen door toepassing van Lean Six Sigma.

  • Optimaliseren van productieprocessen door gebruik van data van een producent van verzorgingsproducten.

  • Realiseren van bedrijfsbrede performanceverbetering en kostenbesparing bij een offshore-organisatie.

Daarnaast help je mee aan het schrijven van offertes en het maken van pitchdecks van nieuwe opdrachten en het verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Het is mogelijk om een stageonderzoek parallel te doen aan je periode bij Berenschot zolang er ook voldoende tijd beschikbaar blijft om te helpen met klantopdrachten en je daarin te ontwikkelen.

Quote

‘Bij Berenschot bepaal je vaak zelf wat je wilt leren en als stagiair werk je meteen mee aan echte projecten bij onze klanten.’ — Nick Fierloos, junior consultant (voormalig stagiair)

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je gaat werken in het team Strategy & Operations, onderdeel van de adviesgroep Transformatie van Organisaties. Het team bestaat uit zeventien slimme en enthousiaste adviseurs die werken in verschillende sectoren. Zij combineren hun kennis van de markt, strategie en operationele bedrijfsprocessen om scherpe analyses en adviezen te maken. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke collegiale band waarbij hard werken, teamwork, het beste uit jezelf en elkaar te halen, impact en plezier maken hand in hand gaan. Met slimme en gedreven Berenschotters om je heen werk je samen aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken iemand die:

  • ervaring heeft met Microsoft Office (PowerPoint en Excel)

  • gevoel heeft voor rapporteren en visuele presentatie van informatie

  • basiskennis heeft van strategie, organisatiestructuren en bedrijfsprocessen

  • passie heeft voor innovatie, leergierig is en goed kan samenwerken

  • proactief is en opdrachten zelfstandig oppakt

  • uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft

  • bij voorkeur 12 maanden beschikbaar is, maar minimaal 6 maanden bij ons komt.

Eerdere werkervaring is niet nodig, maar kan een pre zijn. Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en waar niet alleen economische winst, maar ook maatschappelijke winst een uitgangspunt is. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei.

Daarnaast bieden we:

  • een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis)

  • de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan trainingen in het stageplusprogramma

  • een laptop

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • begeleiding door twee adviseurs op het gebied van strategie en operations

  • een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng

  • de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven

  • mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Jelle van Pijkeren beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Neem contact op met Jelle via WhatsApp (06 82 39 55 98) of per e-mail ().

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous intégrerez l’équipe Référencement et Certification du Domaine Régulation et Conformité, au sein de la Direction Expertise, Innovation et International (DEII). L’ANS évalue la conformité des solutions numériques en santé aux exigences d’interopérabilité, de sécurité et d’éthique, à partir des preuves déposées par les entreprises sur la plateforme Convergence. À la suite d’un premier prototype ayant démontré la faisabilité d’une automatisation partielle sur données fictives, le stage vise à confronter les résultats à des données réelles, à qualifier les solutions d’IA et de RPA et à étudier les conditions d’intégration dans l’environnement existant, en tenant compte des exigences de sécurité et de fiabilité.

🎯 Missions principales

Concevoir et tester une solution d’automatisation

  • Analyser les travaux existants et les processus de vérification de conformité.

  • Concevoir et réaliser un prototype en environnement de préproduction à partir de données réelles.

  • Mettre en œuvre et orchestrer des solutions de RPA et d’IA, par exemple UiPath ou Azure Document Intelligence, ou des outils équivalents.

Évaluer la faisabilité et préparer l’industrialisation

  • Étudier les modalités d’intégration avec la plateforme Convergence et contribuer à la définition d’une architecture cible.

  • Prendre en compte les contraintes de sécurité, d’hébergement, de performance, de passage à l’échelle et de traçabilité.

  • Identifier les cas d’usage pertinents, évaluer les limites et les risques, mesurer les gains attendus et formuler des recommandations ainsi qu’une feuille de route de mise en production.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Une familiarité avec UiPath, les tests logiciels ou l’analyse de conformité sera appréciée.

  • Vous êtes rigoureux·se et doté·e d’un bon esprit d’analyse.

  • Vous savez prendre en compte les enjeux de qualité, de fiabilité et de sécurité des données.

  • Vous appréciez le travail transversal avec des interlocuteurs techniques, réglementaires et métiers.

title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

  • Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

  • Act as a strategic advisor: Understand enterprise procurement challenges and position Zip as a transformational solution for efficiency and cost control.

  • Solution-sell with vision: Demonstrate Zip’s immediate impact while aligning with customers’ long-term digital transformation goals.

  • Shape the future: As an early sales leader in a hyper-growth startup, help refine Zip’s sales strategy, process, and team culture.

  • Leverage best-in-class sales tools: Utilize Salesforce, Clari, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach to optimize outreach and pipeline management.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

  • Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

  • Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

  • Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication and organization skills to manage multiple opportunities effectively.

Perks and Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health Insurance

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Connectivity reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 💸 Pension Contributions

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. Instead, you'll work across a large, shared pool of customers, 50+ at a time, and your job is to make every single one of them successful.

Unlike a traditional account role built around a handful of strategic relationships, you'll operate at scale: building Omnea's presence and community across your customer base through events, webinars, roundtables, and digital engagement, turning individual customers into a connected, invested group of Omnea advocates.

You'll still carry a commercial edge, owning retention and a smaller share of expansion across your pool, but the bulk of the role is about driving real value realisation and adoption at volume rather than running a small number of deep, high-touch relationships.

You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is energised by variety, and knows how to prioritise ruthlessly. You're as comfortable hosting a roundtable for 30 procurement leaders as you are running a tight renewal call with a CFO.

What You'll Do

  • Own a large, shared pool of accounts: Manage 50+ accounts at a time across SMB and mid-market, not a fixed book, building relationships from end users (Procurement, Finance, Ops) through to senior stakeholders (CFOs, COOs), and stepping in early wherever you spot a health risk.

  • Drive value realisation, with a lighter expansion motion: Own Net Revenue Retention across your pool. Lead renewal conversations, secure multi-year extensions, and pass qualified upsell signal to Sales rather than running full commercial cycles yourself.

  • Build community and drive engagement at scale: Design and run customer events, webinars, roundtables, and digital programmes that keep your accounts engaged, informed, and connected to each other. Co-host with Marketing and Sales, and turn your best customers into reference champions.

  • Be the voice of the customer internally: Translate patterns across your accounts into product feedback for the roadmap, and into scalable plays and campaigns for Marketing and Sales. Help define the playbooks, tools, and processes for managing accounts at this scale: you're building this function as much as running it.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a book-of-business role. You work across a large, shared pool of accounts rather than owning a fixed set, so leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints matters as much as one-to-one relationship-building.

  • The quota skews toward retention and value realisation, not expansion. Roughly 70% of what you own is keeping accounts healthy and renewed; the other 30% is expansion you spot and hand off or close.

  • Community is core to the role, not a nice-to-have. You're expected to build and run the events, webinars, and content that turn a shared pool of customers into a connected group of Omnea advocates.

  • There's no fixed playbook for managing accounts at this scale yet. You'll help define it as you go.

About You

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, energised by building community, and have the operational discipline to manage a high-volume, shared pool of accounts without letting anything slip. You know how to create leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints, and you balance that with the relationship skills to make customers feel genuinely looked after.

  • 2-7 years of experience in a B2B SaaS commercial or customer-facing role. You might come from account management, customer success, marketing, or events - what matters is a genuine commercial edge and a track record of excellence in whatever you've done

  • You're a natural community builder: you know how to design and run programmes that bring customers together, and you understand how those moments translate into retention, expansion, and advocacy

  • You have strong commercial intuition: you can spot an expansion opportunity in a conversation, navigate a renewal proactively, and hold your own in commercial discussions with senior stakeholders

  • You're a brilliant communicator in every format: warm, clear, and credible whether you're hosting a webinar for 50 people or writing a customer newsletter

  • You're operationally excellent. Managing 50+ accounts at a time means ruthless prioritisation, tight organisation, and building systems and processes that create leverage

  • You're outcomes-focused with a heavy bias to action, entrepreneurial, and want to help build a business. The scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes it on

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Strategic Sales Manager (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Strategic Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence with its most important French customers. This is a pivotal opportunity to shape how we win and grow strategic accounts, from developing senior relationships and navigating complex buying groups to building a repeatable approach for large, high-impact opportunities.

You’ll act as the business lead for the strategic segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team while staying close to customers, account plans, and active deals. You’ll build a focused pipeline and a sales motion suited to organizations with complex needs, multiple stakeholders, and ambitious transformation goals.

You’ll also orchestrate the cross-functional support needed to grow strategic accounts. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll direct resources toward the accounts and opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the Strategic sales team, including hiring, performance management, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set clear priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Develop a focused strategy for target accounts, including account plans, senior stakeholder relationships, and a clear view of customer priorities and decision processes.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on executive engagement, value-based selling, multi-threading, commercial strategy, and navigating complex buying groups.

  • Build a consistent, evidence-based strategic sales motion, refining qualification, messaging, and execution based on customer conversations and deal patterns.

  • Bring customer and market learning to Product, making clear recommendations on strategic customer needs, use cases, and opportunities.

  • Set pipeline priorities with BDR and Growth leaders, including targeted outbound and other channels suited to strategic accounts.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize executive events, campaigns, customer advocacy, and community programs that support strategic pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support strategic priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on account access, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to deliver credible evaluations, successful implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share strategic account and market insights with the CRO and other segment leads, helping shape a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience leading Strategic or Enterprise sales, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals and relationships with senior executives.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end, and building pipeline through teams and functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience making practical decisions about where to focus capacity and budget, including the roles of direct sales, marketing, and partners.

  • Strong judgment in developing account strategies, coaching complex deal execution, and building a reliable forecast.

  • The ability to create a repeatable sales approach without treating every strategic customer as the same.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building strategic sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Strategic segment has clear ownership, a focused pipeline, and measurable progress against its ARR goals. The team builds trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executes complex sales cycles with discipline. Cross-functional resources are aligned to the accounts and opportunities that matter most, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust sharpen its strategic sales approach in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €180K – €200K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Strategy & Operations - Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Strategy & Operations - Transformation

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £90k-£110k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our customers are some of the world's largest companies, and every partnership depends on Deducta delivering the measurable outcomes we've committed to. This role owns delivery for a set of our enterprise accounts, from sales handover through implementation, adoption and ongoing value. You'll report to the Chief of Staff.

You'll work directly with senior leaders at our customers, run complex programmes end to end, and work closely with whoever leads our customer function. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Deducta delivers and help make that model repeatable.

What you'll do

  • Account delivery: Own delivery for a set of enterprise accounts end to end, from sales handover through implementation, adoption, value realisation and ongoing partnership.

  • Enterprise programmes: Translate customer objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners and dependencies, and keep complex programmes moving.

  • Senior relationships: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day programme leads through CPOs, CFOs and other executives.

  • Data and platform: Work directly with customer data and the Deducta platform, understanding each customer's business so our work produces meaningful insights and outcomes.

  • Implementation and adoption: Identify blockers early, coordinate the right resources across product and engineering, and make sure customer learnings shape how we improve the product.

  • Delivery playbook: Turn what works on your accounts into repeatable processes the wider customer team can use.

Success in this role means:

  • Trusted partner: Your customers see Deducta as a partner that consistently delivers against its commitments.

  • Predictable implementations: Implementations move quickly, with risks and blockers surfaced early rather than through firefighting.

  • Visible value: Customers adopt the platform, can articulate the value Deducta creates, and keep deepening how they use it.

  • Repeatable delivery: The processes you build make delivery faster and more consistent across accounts.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency operator with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, ideally having reached Manager, with experience managing complex workstreams and confidence in front of senior clients. You should be as comfortable in the data as you are presenting to an executive. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Client leadership: You build credibility quickly, manage demanding stakeholders and become a trusted partner to senior executives.

  • Programme leadership: You turn an ambitious objective into a structured plan and create accountability across stakeholders you don't control.

  • Analytical depth: You get into the data yourself, identify what matters and synthesise complex information into clear conclusions.

  • Problem solving: You diagnose why something isn't working, separate symptoms from underlying problems, and drive the team to a practical solution.

  • Executive communication: You take complex, messy work and communicate the answer clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • High agency: You create clarity where none exists and follow problems through to resolution.

  • Nice to have: Experience in enterprise software, data, analytics, AI, procurement, complex technology implementations, or a high-growth environment.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.
