descriptionHtml:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell

As we are building the best milkman on earth, we are looking for sharp minds that can help us further shape Picnic as we expand across Europe. We are looking for experienced hires with a background in top strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, e-commerce or commercial roles, that can tackle challenges and growth opportunities at Picnic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Finance, Math or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in top tier management consulting, PE, investment banking, retail topics and hands-on deal experience
  • Out-of-the-box thinking and initiative: hands-on, nothing-is-impossible mindset
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, allowing you to explain complex analytical concepts in a simple and practical way
  • Proficient with SQL and Python or excited to learn

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

You'll always have something to learn with us! You’ll benefit from opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already know. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Which team will I join?

At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.  

What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?

You get full accountability from the start: from shaping the strategy and driving step-change improvements, to collaborating with multiple teams to achieve tangible business results.

At Picnic, the long-term opportunity isn't just a role—it’s a platform to shape your own career trajectory with real ownership, business impact, and fast growth. Hence the career paths are as diverse as your ambitions. Depending on your interests and strengths, these are most common career paths we’ve seen so far:

  • Given our scale-up environment, many projects tend to grow in scope and complexity under your responsibility and you naturally grow a team around you in order to take your project to a next level.
  • As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. We have numerous colleagues that have switched from Commercial to Fulfillment, or from Distribution to Customer and many other examples.

In what language should I apply?

Please send your application in English.

title: SW Team Lead
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Software Team Lead, you'll coordinate the efforts of the software team across the stack, driving performance optimization, deploying pilot and prototype stacks to grow the developer base, and ensuring alignment between client specifications and deliverables. You'll build and mentor a growing team while staying hands-on with code, architecture, and performance yourself, working closely with chip architects and hardware teams during early silicon bring-up.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong background in systems software for AI/ML accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, or other high-performance compute platforms.

  • Solid understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, parallel computing, and hardware-software interaction.

  • Proven ability to lead small engineering teams while retaining significant individual contribution.

  • Strong C/C++ programming skills.

  • Experience with Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, etc.) is highly desirable.

  • Strong communication and project ownership skills, including translating client requirements into technical scope, deliverables, and realistic timelines.

  • Strong background in testing and deployment infrastructure for large-scale software projects.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the software stack for AI accelerator products, balancing speed of execution with long-term technical foundations.

  • Work closely with chip architecture and hardware teams on hardware–software co-design and early silicon bring-up.

  • Lead development across kernel libraries, runtimes, drivers, firmware, and developer tooling as needed.

  • Optimize key AI workloads for performance, efficiency, memory usage, and reliability on emerging hardware.

  • Stay hands-on with architecture, coding, debugging, reviews, and performance analysis while mentoring a growing team.

  • Partner directly with clients to understand technical requirements, translate them into clear team deliverables, and align scope, priorities, and timelines.

Nice to have

  • Strong background in mathematics.

  • Hands-on experience with low-level software such as compilers, drivers, and firmware.

  • Experience profiling and optimizing AI workloads for performance, memory efficiency, and hardware utilization.

  • Experience with AI inference platforms such as vLLM and SGLang.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

Your Mission

Zefir is hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product and Ops, and the Talent team is the engine behind it. You'll join as the first Talent Acquisition intern, working day to day with our Founding Talent Lead, in a team that reports directly to the CEO.

This is not an admin internship. You'll own real pipelines, talk to candidates every day, and help build the AI-powered recruiting machine we run on. By the end of the six months, you'll have recruited people who are still at Zefir years later.

 

What You'll Do

Find and engage talent | About 70%

Help us find the people who will build Zefir's next chapter.

  • Turn hiring briefs and scorecards into searches: relevant backgrounds, target companies and places to look.

  • Explore LinkedIn Recruiter, revisit past Ashby candidates, and uncover promising profiles beyond incoming applications.

  • Explain why each candidate could be a fit in one clear sentence and keep their Ashby profile accurate.

  • Prepare personal outreach drafts in Zefir's voice, then use feedback to sharpen your approach.

Build and improve our AI recruiting workflows | About 30%

Work with our Talent Lead to turn ideas into useful automations and improve them through daily use.

  • Build and experiment: help create workflows for candidate sourcing, scoring, outreach and recruiting dashboards.

  • Test, learn, iterate: try different prompts and approaches, compare the results, and refine what works.

  • Apply your judgment: review AI recommendations against real profiles and use what you learn to improve the next batch.

  • Solve problems: investigate issues, debug workflows with the team, and find repetitive steps we can automate.

 

Who You Are

  • You're curious about people, technology and how companies build teams.

  • You think clearly, learn quickly, and enjoy turning an open-ended problem into concrete next steps.

  • You write strong French and can work in English.

  • You're comfortable exploring tools such as Claude or ChatGPT. Experience with Zapier or n8n is a bonus.

  • You're rigorous with details and resourceful when something doesn't work.

  • A first experience in sales, research, recruiting or a startup is welcome, but not required.

 

Practical Details

  • Contract: Internship (Master's level, convention de stage required).

  • Start: January 2027.

  • Duration: 6 months.

  • Location: On-site at our Le Peletier office, Paris 9th, five days a week.

  • Compensation: €1,750 gross per month at 100% of bonus target (€1,250 fixed + €500 hiring bonus: €250 per direct-sourcing hire, up to 2 hires per month).

  • Perks: Swile meal card (€11 per worked day) and Swile mobility card (€45/month).

 

A Short, Practical Hiring Process

  1. A 20-minute call with David, our Talent Lead, to discuss your interests and the internship.

  2. An on-site sourcing and outreach exercise, with nothing to prepare beforehand.

  3. A meeting with Remy, our CEO, followed by a decision within 48 hours.

Bring your curiosity and your ideas. Learn the craft, test your approach, and help us find our next teammates.


Benefits

descriptionHtml:
Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future.

For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required.

At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions.

As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization.

Climate for growth

Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water.

Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.

How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter

As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process.

You will:

· Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions;

· Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria;

· Develop effective candidate sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-supported sourcing tools;

· Proactively source and engage relevant talent in the market;

· Help hiring managers create structured and effective interview and selection processes;

· Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey;

· Contribute to the further development of our employer branding and talent attraction activities;

· Use recruitment insights and market knowledge to advise the business;

· Identify opportunities to continuously improve our recruitment processes and ways of working.


Who you are

You are an experienced recruiter who combines strong people skills with a practical and business-oriented approach. You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and building trusted relationships with hiring managers.

You are proactive, curious and not afraid to challenge the business when you believe there is a better way to attract or select talent.

For this role, we are looking for someone who:

· Has 3–5 years of experience in corporate recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably within a product, technology or international organization;

· Has experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to selection and offer;

· Is confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and proactive sourcing techniques;

· Has experience working closely with hiring managers and other business stakeholders;

· Understands the importance of candidate experience and employer branding;

· Is independent, proactive and comfortable working in a dynamic environment;

· Has a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys making recruitment processes better;

· Communicates fluently in Dutch and English, both written and spoken;

· Lives within reasonable commuting distance of De Lier, the Netherlands.


What you get  
In numbers 

· A monthly salary between €3.600,00 - €5.100,00 based on your experience; 

· We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

· 8% holiday allowance; 

· Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

For your own sustainability 

· Be secured with our pension plan; 

· Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

· Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

· Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Ready to help us find the people behind our future?

If recruitment is more than filling vacancies to you, and you enjoy combining sourcing, stakeholder management and candidate experience, we would love to hear from you.

Apply and discover how you can help us create a climate for growth.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer inside Ironclad, feeding insights from customer engagements and direct product expertise regularly to our Product team.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally - with Account Team, Adoption Strategists, Enterprise Architects, Forward Deployed Engineering, Legal AI Specialists, Support, and Success - to guide customers across the full journey and support their success.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • 4+ years of professional services and/or consulting experience with software companies.

  • Passion for learning new technologies and driving outcomes through technical solutions.

  • Strong AI consulting instincts and practical AI fluency. You understand what AI can and cannot do in practice, can explain AI concepts clearly to customer stakeholders, and can advise on how to apply AI responsibly within contracting workflows.

  • A transformation mindset. You are motivated by progressing a customer through adoption journey milestones and business outcomes.

  • Ownership mentality for customer success. You are comfortable charting a path forward, maintaining momentum, and helping customers translate technical design into practical adoption steps.

title: Technical Strategy Manager H/F
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Context

We are looking for hybrid profile, sitting at the intersection of strategy and engineering, able to rigorously evaluate the technology choices made by the R&D and innovation teams, audit our internal capabilities, and challenge product/tech trade-offs with a business lens. This is not a technical team management role, but a role of constructive counter-power and strategic alignment between engineering and business priorities.

You will ensure that our technological decisions (R&D, innovation, architecture choices, build vs buy, roadmap prioritization) are aligned with overall strategy, economically sound, and robust by actively challenging the relevant teams rather than rubber-stamping their proposals.

Role & Missions:

Strategic and technical challenge

  • Challenge the technical choices and roadmaps proposed by R&D and the Innovation team (architecture, stack, prioritization, build vs buy vs partner)

  • Question the underlying assumptions behind technical projects (feasibility, ROI, strategic alignment, technical debt incurred)

  • Produce well-argued, independent analyses not rubber-stamped validations

Technology and market watch

  • Run continuous technical and technology watch (competitors, emerging technologies, market trends, new tools, and platforms) to keep the company's decisions informed by the state of the art

  • Identify technologies or approaches that could create a competitive advantage, or expose the company to being left behind

  • Turn watch findings into actionable inputs for the R&D/Innovation roadmap and for COMEX-level strategic discussions

  • Build and maintain a structured watch process (sources, cadence, internal distribution) rather than ad hoc monitoring

Capability audit

  • Regularly map and assess the company's technical capabilities (skills, tools, infrastructure, external dependencies)

  • Identify areas of risk, over-investment, under-investment, or critical dependency

  • Benchmark our capabilities against the market and competitors

Technology strategy

  • Contribute to defining the company's technology strategy alongside the Strategy & Operations Director

  • Assess build, buy, partner, or acquisition opportunities on technology topics

  • Inform R&D resource allocation decisions with a strategic and financial lens

Reporting and governance

  • Produce syntheses and recommendations for COMEX on tech-strategy topics

  • Set up tracking indicators on technical execution vs. commitments made

  • Participate in R&D/Innovation committees as an independent strategic voice

Candidate profile

Experience

  • 5-6 years of overall experience, engineering background (degree in engineering or equivalent)

  • Ideal trajectory: 2-3 years of hands-on technical execution, followed by 2-3 years in a hybrid technical/business role e.g. Engineer → Technical Product Manager, Engineer → tech-focused strategy consulting, or Engineer → Chief of Staff to a CTO/VP Engineering

  • Profiles with only pure execution experience (no exposure to business trade-offs) or only early technical experience followed by years of generalist consulting (no longer technically credible) are not a fit for this role

  • Given the seniority level, the candidate should compensate for limited years of experience with either deep, recognized expertise in a specific technical domain (enough to be seen as a peer by R&D on that topic) or a strong, proven track record of challenging senior stakeholders from a strategy/consulting background.

Technical skills

  • Hands-on experience in a technical environment (dev, data, tech product, architecture, not consulting-only exposure)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand architecture choices and technical trade-offs, and to assess their relevance

  • Comfortable engaging as a peer with CTOs, tech leads, and senior engineers

title: Technische*r Projektleiter*in - Hardware & Sensorik
descriptionHtml:
Was wäre, wenn du nicht nur Projekte verwaltest – sondern tatsächlich verantwortest? Von der ersten Idee bis zur serienreifen Fertigung. Mit dem Überblick, der Durchsetzungsstärke und dem technischen Tiefgang, um Produkte zum Laufen zu bringen.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch – und der lässt sich nicht mit halbgaren Lösungen oder endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen erfüllen. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die technische Verantwortung für unsere Produkte tragen wollen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Wedel suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit als Technische*n Projektleiter*in mit Komponentenverantwortung.

Aufgaben

In vielen Unternehmen sind Projektleiter*innen Koordinatoren auf dem Papier – verantwortlich für Meetings, aber nicht für Ergebnisse. Bei uns ist das anders.

Du begleitest unsere Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zur serienreifen Realität und übernimmst dabei die volle Verantwortung für Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit. Als Produktverantwortliche*r und technische*r Projektleiter*in bist du über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus die treibende Kraft: Du koordinierst, löst Probleme und hältst die Fäden zusammen – als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung, Fertigung, Produktmanagement und Vertrieb. Analytisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe – wer eine bessere Lösung sieht, spricht sie an.

So sieht deine Arbeit konkret aus:

Entwicklungsmanagement

  • Technische Verantwortung für Entwicklungsprojekte im Kosten-, Zeit- und Qualitätsrahmen – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Fertigungsüberführung

  • Begleitung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Entwicklerteams – inhaltlich wie organisatorisch

  • Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen in konkrete Arbeitspakete sowie Erstellung und Pflege von Projektzeitplänen

  • Sicherstellung einer prüfbaren und qualitätsgesicherten Übergabe der Produkte in die Fertigung

Technisches Life Cycle Management

  • Aktive Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte auf technologischer und konzeptioneller Ebene

  • Erste Anlaufstelle bei fertigungs- und qualitätsbezogenen Fragestellungen und Problemen

  • Verantwortung für das Änderungsmanagement – von der Idee bis zur Serienreife

  • Unterstützung von Vertrieb und Produktmanagement mit fundierter technischer Expertise

Qualifikation

Wir suchen Menschen, die technische Verantwortung wirklich übernehmen wollen und wissen, wie man unterschiedliche Abteilungen zur Erreichung eines gemeinsamen Ziels bewegt. Wenn du dich hier und bei den nachfolgenden Punkten wiedererkennst, dann passt du zu uns:

  • Fundierte technische Erfahrung in der Produktentwicklung, idealerweise in einem industriellen Serienumfeld

  • Nachgewiesene Kompetenz im Entwicklungs- und Projektmanagement – du kennst Methoden, Tools und vor allem die Realität dahinter

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit – du weißt, wie du unterschiedliche Abteilungen und Interessen zusammenbringst

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du verlierst Themen nicht aus dem Blick, auch wenn du sie weitergibst

  • Freude daran, Dinge nachhaltig zu verbessern – nicht nur kurzfristig zu lösen

Benefits

Warum TWK? Weil hier mehr zählt als Obstkorb und Parkplatz.

Ja, wir haben Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad, eclara, Wellhub, Getränke, Obst und Firmenevents – aber seien wir ehrlich: Dafür wechselst du nicht den Job. Das hier macht den echten Unterschied:

Stabil aufgestellt und bereit zu investieren.

Ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit einer jungen, nahbaren Geschäftsleitung und einem stabilen wirtschaftlichen Fundament. Das schafft nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch den Spielraum, in Ausstattung zu investieren: Hochwertige Testumgebungen mit moderner Ausstattung von Steuerungen über Drehmotoren und Klimakammern bis hin zu modernen Messsensoren. Kontinuierlich erweitert und erneuert, ohne Investitionsmüdigkeit oder Sparrunden.

Dein Wachstum wird gefördert.

Weil das beste Equipment nichts nützt ohne die richtigen Menschen dahinter: Du startest mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung, die dich in alle relevanten Prozesse, Systeme und Tools einführt und sicher in deine Rolle hineinwachsen lässt. Danach geht es mit Schulungen, Weiterbildungen und dem Freiraum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln, weiter. Wer den Willen mitbringt, etwas zu bewegen, findet bei uns den Raum dazu und flache Hierarchien sorgen dafür, dass Ideen ankommen, ohne sich durch Hierarchieebenen kämpfen zu müssen.

Dein Arbeitsalltag passt zu deinem Leben.

Ob im Büro oder von zuhause – flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten geben dir den Spielraum, der zu deinem Leben passt. Dazu ein gut angebundener Standort in Wedel.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt – unkompliziert und direkt. Lebenslauf, relevante Zeugnisse und ein paar Sätze darüber, warum du zu uns passt. Kein Roman, einfach ehrlich.

Innerhalb einer Woche melden sich Christine oder Alina bei dir. Erstes Gespräch online, zweites vor Ort in Wedel. Ganz entspannt.

Kein Bullshit, keine leeren Versprechen – nur ehrliche Arbeit in einem Unternehmen, das vorwärts will.

title: Territory Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large Enterprise companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near a major German city with convenient transport links, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

title: Tools Developer (Rust / Linux)
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.


About the team and role

The tools built by the Developer Experience team are how engineers — both inside Fractile and at our customers — see, control and understand the Fractile inference accelerator. That means the command-line utilities used to discover, configure and health-check devices; the diagnostics used during hardware bring-up and in the datacentre; and the profiling, tracing and debugging tools that show where the time goes across the host, the driver and the silicon.

As a Tools Developer you will design and build these tools in Rust, running on Linux hosts from a single developer workstation against large datacentre deployments. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, kernel driver, runtime and Developer Experience teams to understand what they need, and turn that into fast, reliable and well-designed tools that fit naturally into existing Linux workflows. This is largely greenfield work, with real scope to shape how our tooling is architected and how it is used.


About you

You enjoy building tools that other engineers rely on every day, and you care about getting the details right: clear output, sensible defaults, good error messages and behaviour you can script against. You are at home on Linux, comfortable working anywhere from the shell down to sysfs, ioctls and the kernel/userspace boundary, and you know how to find out what a system is actually doing when it misbehaves. You are self-driven, able to identify tooling opportunities for yourself, and happy to work autonomously in areas of ambiguity.


Key Requirements

  • Strong Rust skills, with experience shipping production-quality tools or libraries

  • Knowledge of Linux from a developer's perspective: processes, memory, filesystems, sysfs/procfs, device files and ioctls, systemd and the kernel/userspace interface

  • Experience designing command-line tools and APIs that are easy to learn, script and automate

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience writing tools for PCIe-attached devices, GPUs or other ML accelerators

  • Experience using CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan Compute, or similar

  • Familiarity with tracing and telemetry formats or systems such as Perfetto, Chrome trace format, OpenTelemetry or Prometheus

  • Experience exposing Rust libraries to Python (e.g. PyO3) or C

  • Experience with Bazel, CI/CD or packaging software for Linux distributions

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: VP, Software Engineering (NwPS)
descriptionHtml:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Job Title: Head of NwPS Engineering 

Location: Global / Remote (preference for US, UK, or Spain) 

About the Role 

The Head of NwPS Engineering is a VP-level leadership role responsible for the full engineering delivery and technical strategy of Vonage’s Network Powered Solutions business. This is not a delivery management role — it is an engineering leadership role that carries end-to-end accountability for the platform powering Vonage’s fastest-growing business unit. 

NwPS is Vonage’s strategic growth engine, commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs — including Verify, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Number Verification, and Quality on Demand — for enterprise customers across FinTech, Healthcare, Transportation, and beyond. The engineering function that supports it spans multiple squads, complex multi-CSP integrations, a rapidly evolving product portfolio, and an emerging AI and agentic engineering capability. 

The Head of NwPS Engineering will own the vision, structure, and execution of this engineering function. They will report directly to the SA NwPS General Manager and serve as a key voice on the NwPS leadership team. 

Key Responsibilities 

Engineering Delivery 

  • Full engineering accountability for: Verify, VNA (Vonage Network APIs), Connectors, Intelligence Engine, Advanced NwPS, and future NwPS products 
  • Ownership of all NwPS squad delivery across Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, and Verify 
  • QA Excellence and SDET capability across NwPS engineering 
  • DevRel engineering in support of the NwPS developer ecosystem 
  • Operational Excellence, SRE practices, and platform reliability 

Architecture 

  • End-to-end architectural accountability for NwPS engineering 
  • Direct leadership of the NwPS Architecture function (Architecture Lead reports to this role) 
  • Ownership of architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture across NwPS products 
  • Technical decision-making authority for platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards 

Strategic Engineering Leadership 

  • Agentic AI and MCP engineering strategy and execution 
  • Engineering roadmap aligned with NwPS product strategy and commercial OKRs 
  • Representation on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside NwPS Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD 
  • Cross-functional partnership with CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering on shared platform standards and practices 

Reporting Structure 

This role leads the NwPS Architecture Lead and the squad leads for Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, Verify, and SDET Improvements. 

The engineering organisation comprises approximately 40+ engineers across the squads, with seven direct reports once the Architecture Lead position is filled. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

Engineering Vision and Strategy 

  • Demonstrated ability to set and communicate a multi-year engineering vision for a complex, API-native product portfolio 
  • Experience leading engineering for developer-facing or telco/network API products is strongly preferred 
  • Proven capability to align engineering strategy with product roadmap and commercial priorities — not just execute against them 

Leadership at Scale 

  • Track record of leading distributed, multi-squad engineering organisations across multiple geographies 
  • Ability to develop and retain engineering talent at all levels, including squad leads and senior engineers 
  • Experience managing engineering through periods of significant growth and structural change 

Technical Depth 

  • Strong grounding in API platform architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering 
  • Familiarity with CSP/telco network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) is a significant advantage 
  • Hands-on architecture experience sufficient to provide meaningful technical guidance to the Architecture function 

Execution and Accountability 

  • History of delivering complex, multi-CSP or multi-partner integrations on aggressive timelines 
  • Operational rigour: reliability, KTLO management, cycle time, and quality engineering are active leadership priorities, not delegated concerns 

Why This Role Matters 

NwPS is building the infrastructure for a market that is still being defined. Carrier-grade, developer-accessible network APIs are emerging as a category, and Vonage is positioned to lead it. The Head of NwPS Engineering will be the person who ensures the engineering organisation is built to move fast, scale reliably, and stay ahead of a rapidly evolving technical landscape. 

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not manage something that already exists. 

About Vonage and SA NwPS 

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader, part of the Ericsson group. The NwPS Solution Area is Vonage’s dedicated business unit for Network Powered Solutions — commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs for enterprise customers globally. NwPS operates as a standalone business with its own P&L accountability, product roadmap, sales motion, and engineering function. 

US Pay Transparency$263,103—$346,000 USD

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

title: Werkstudent Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Das sind wir:

BuildlinX entwickelt die nächste Generation der Gebäudeautomation. Damit packen wir eines der größten Klimaprobleme unserer Zeit an: Der Gebäudebetrieb verursacht rund 30 % der globalen CO₂-Emissionen. Genau hier setzen wir an - und machen Gebäude grundlegend effizienter und klimafreundlicher.
Mit einem Team von rund 20 Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir dafür die Technologie und die Werkzeuge, die Gebäudeautomation einfacher und skalierbarer machen. Gemeinsam mit einem etablierten öffentlichen Innovationspartner bringen wir die moderne Gebäudeautomation bereits heute im großen Maßstab in die Praxis und treiben so einen ganzen Markt in Richtung Zukunft.

Das machst Du bei uns:

Als Werkstudent in der Projektumsetzung bist Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen digitaler Planung und der Umsetzung vor Ort innerhalb Hamburgs tätig. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere intelligenten Lösungen im Gebäude lebendig werden.

  • Hands-on vor Ort: Du unterstützt unsere Umsetzung in den Gebäuden, installierst Sensorik sowie weitere Hardware und grenzt Fehlerquellen an technischen Anlagen systematisch ein.

  • Modellierung: Du modellierst Standorte als digitalen Zwilling und schaffst so die Datengrundlage für unsere Optimierungen.

  • Datenanalyse: Mit unseren digitalen Tools untersuchst Du Standorte nach Fehlern oder Anomalien und arbeitest Ursachen heraus.

  • Tech-Setup: Du provisionierst Edge-Computer, konfigurierst Hardware und unterstützt unser Team im operativen Projektgeschäft.

  • Prozess-Gestaltung: Du arbeitest aktiv daran mit, unsere Projektabläufe noch effizienter zu machen und sie zu leben.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Studium: Du studierst Energie-und Gebäudetechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Mechatronik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang (mind. noch 2 Semester).

  • Planverständnis: Du kannst technische Pläne lesen und verstehen (z. B. Hydraulikschemata, Elektroschaltpläne, Lüftungs- oder Automationsschemata).

  • Technik-Verständnis: Du verstehst komplexe technische Systeme in der Regelungs-, Steuerungs- und Kommunikationstechnik schnell und bringst eine Begeisterung für Software und IT mit.

  • Mindset: Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und hast keine Angst davor, auch mal selbst zum Schraubendreher zu greifen.

  • Auftreten: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und trittst unseren Kunden gegenüber professionell und freundlich auf.

Pluspunkte (optional):

  • Eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung (z. B. Elektriker, Mechatroniker).

  • Erweiterte Kenntnisse in der Hands-On-Programmierung.

  • Vorerfahrung im Bereich TGA (Technische Gebäudeausrüstung).

Das sind Deine Vorteile bei uns:

  • Eigenverantwortung: Kleines dynamisches Team, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst hands-on, wie Projekte in einem modernen Start-up funktionieren, im direkten Austausch mit unserem CEO und dem Tech-Team.

  • Sinnstiftend: Du arbeitest direkt an der Bekämpfung des Klimawandels – Dein Impact ist messbar.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Bis zu 40% Deiner monatlichen Arbeitszeit kannst Du innerhalb Deutschlands mobil arbeiten, frei auf den Monat verteilt.

  • Dein Morgen, Dein Rhythmus: Gleitzeit mit flexiblem Start bis 10 Uhr.

  • Feiertags-Bonus: Heiligabend und Silvester sind bei uns arbeitsfrei. Du sparst Dir deinen Urlaub und startest entspannt und ohne Abzüge ins neue Jahr.

title: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations

Als Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration

  • Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme.

  • Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher.

  • Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Finance Transformation & Standardisierung

  • Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg.

  • Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.

Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.

  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.

  • Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte.

  • Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab.

Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil.

  • Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert.

  • Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.

  • Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe: Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit.

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.

  • Auf Wunsch ist Vollbeschäftigung in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit möglich.

Kann ich komplett remote arbeiten? Ja, zu 100 % – Voraussetzung ist ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

title: Working Student B2G: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
01 · Why this role exists

This is not your typical student job.

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you help win it. You'll work directly with our B2G Manager and the founders on funding that flows straight into RIZM's cash flow, and you'll see from the inside how the public sector decides and buys. Something most students never get to see.

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one.

02 · What you'll do

  • Public funding as a growth channel: Help build the pipeline for Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: scout new calls, prepare applications and keep track of our running programmes.

  • Connect research: Support our research collaboration with Stanford and help turn it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first: Set up trackers, automations and AI workflows so our funding pipeline runs with as little manual work as possible. Your ideas count here.

  • Support ReNET-EV: Help with our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region): documentation, reporting and the rollout to more municipalities.

  • Get to know municipalities: Research how cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies decide and buy, as groundwork for our first public-sector customers.

  • Build the data foundation: Collect public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

03 · What you bring

  • Studies: You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme, e.g. public administration, political science, economics, business, energy, engineering or something similar.

  • Curiosity: The energy transition, municipal heat planning or how public funding works interest you. No prior experience needed.

  • Writing: You write clearly and in a structured way.

  • AI-native: You're curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility.

  • Languages: Fluent German and good English.

04 · Why you should apply now

B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start.

  • Small team: You'll work actively and day to day with our full-time B2G Manager, not on the sidelines.

  • Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch.

  • Founders: You work directly with them.

  • Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making.

  • Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

title: Workplace Intern
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Mission

Help keep Qonto’s Bonne Nouvelle HQ running smoothly for our Paris teams. Working side by side with our Hospitality Manager, you’ll handle day-to-day workplace operations and support Agathe on workplace projects. Expect about 70% daily operations and 30% project assistance, with real responsibility and guidance along the way.

Start date: As soon as possible
📍 Paris-based, fully on-site. Remote is not available for this role.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Keep the site running: Work in tandem with Lindsay, our Hospitality Manager. Do office rounds, talk to Qontoers, and track issues until they’re resolved.

  • Follow up our service providers: Check cleaning and security tasks, share feedback, and escalate to Agathe when needed.

  • Support event logistics: Help with practical setup and make sure cleaning and security teams have the right information before and after each event.

  • Keep operations organized: Update Notion documentation, create purchase orders, follow up invoices, and support basic budget tracking.

  • Learn through project support: Assist Agathe on workplace project coordination tasks alongside your core operational work.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • You communicate clearly in French and English: You ask questions early, flag issues, and adapt your updates to colleagues and providers.

  • You’re organized and reliable: You follow through, care about details, and can mix on-site tasks with admin follow-up.

  • You have a service mindset: You enjoy helping people and making a workplace welcoming. Experience in hospitality, customer service, or office operations is a plus.

  • You’re hands-on and adaptable: You like being on-site, work well in a team, and stay calm when priorities change.

  • You’re ready to learn: You’re comfortable with shared digital tools (Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) and eager to grow in operations and project coordination. No specific academic background required.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Practical Workplace experience: See how a large headquarters runs, from provider coordination to operational administration.

  • Real responsibility, with support: Own agreed operational tasks while learning from Agathe and working closely with Lindsay.

  • Exposure across teams: Work with many Qontoers and external partners, building your communication, service, and coordination skills.


➡️ Your future manager

You’ll report to Agathe Voulfow, our Head of Workplace and Internal Events, who will also be your mentor. Agathe has spent more than a decade running workplace and facilities operations, at LinkedIn, Uber and OpenClassrooms before joining Qonto in 2024. She leads with trust and autonomy, is inclusive and supportive, and values proactive communication. You’ll also meet weekly with her and Lindsay to align on priorities and your learning.

title: ZMB Praktikum/Des. Ernährungsberater*in BSc (a)
descriptionHtml:
Du bist Student:in der Ernährung und Diätetik und möchtest deine Ausbildung mit der offiziellen Qualifikation als Ernährungsberater:in in der Schweiz abschliessen?

Für das dafür obligatorische, einjährige Zusatzmodul (Praktikumsjahr) suchen wir motivierte Nachwuchstalente: Wenn du praxisnah lernen möchtest, wie moderne ambulante Beratungen funktionieren, und wertvolle Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von persönlicher Patient*innenbetreuung und zukunftsweisender Digital Health sammeln willst, ist unser Graduate-Internship genau das Richtige für dich.

Für unser Oviva-Team in der Schweiz suchen wir dich per Oktober 2027 als Des. Ernährungsberater*in BSc.

Warum Oviva?

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch, jedes Coaching und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

Als Graduate / des. Ernährungsberater*in machst du dich Schritt für Schritt mit dem Arbeitsalltag einer Fachperson im ambulanten Beratungssetting vertraut und baust deine Handlungskompetenz kontinuierlich auf:

  • Ambulante Ernährungstherapie: Du führst Beratungen von Erwachsenen, Kindern und Jugendlichen durch – zunächst eng begleitet vor Ort in unseren Partnerpraxen und digital, später eigenständig mit Vor- und Nachbesprechungen (Praxisauslastung ca. 1–4 Beratungen pro Halbtag).

  • Zuweisermanagement & Vernetzung: Du arbeitest interprofessionell mit Ärzt*innen sowie medizinischem Praxispersonal zusammen, stärkst Beziehungen und unterstützt bei der Gewinnung und Entwicklung regionaler Partnerpraxen.

  • Wissensvermittlung: Du konzipierst und führst Fachwebinare (z. B. für MPA) durch und hältst praxisnahe Vorträge an Fachveranstaltungen sowie internen Weiterbildungen.

  • Qualität & Projekte: Du erstellst und überarbeitest hochwertige Beratungshilfsmittel, nimmst regelmässig an internen Fallbesprechungen teil und unterstützt bei regionalen Marketingprojekten.

  • Office-Präsenz: Jeden Mittwoch bist du vor Ort in unserem Büro in Zürich präsent, tauschst dich mit anderen Graduates aus und vertiefst dein Netzwerk.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ausbildung: Du stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss deines Bachelorstudiums (des. Ernährungsberater*in BSc) an einer Fachhochschule (z. B. BFH) in Ernährung und Diätetik.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbständig, flexibel und bist top organisiert.

  • Begeisterung: Du hast Freude an der persönlichen sowie digitalen Patient*innenbegleitung und bist offen für unterschiedliche Fach- und Indikationsgebiete.

  • Standort-Flexibilität: Du arbeitest flexibel im Homeoffice sowie digital, bist jedoch jeden Mittwoch verbindlich vor Ort in unserem Office in Zürich.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift setzen wir voraus; gute Englischkenntnisse sowie weitere Sprachen sind ein grosses Plus.

Deine Benefits bei Oviva

  • Strukturierter Berufseinstieg: Ein massgeschneidertes Graduate-Programm mit gezielter Einarbeitung, Supervision und enger Begleitung auf dem Weg in die selbständige Beratung.

  • Vergütung & Spesen (Basis 100 % Pensum):

    • Grundgehalt: CHF 2'525.– pro Monat

    • Feste Spesenpauschalen: CHF 225.– Monatsspesen, CHF 30.– Telekommunikation sowie CHF 137.50 Reisespesen-Zusatz für Graduates

Unser Praktikum findet in der Regel mit einem Pensum von 80 % statt.

  • Modernste Arbeitsmittel: Eine eigenentwickelte, innovative App und Beratungssoftware, die administrative Abläufe erleichtert.

  • Teamkultur & Vernetzung: Ein dynamisches, interdisziplinäres Team, in dem Wissen geteilt und Erfolge gemeinsam gefeiert werden.

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Eine Unternehmenskultur, bei der Patient*innenzufriedenheit und Behandlungsqualität an erster Stelle stehen.

(a) = alle: Vielfalt ist uns wichtig.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.
Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.


Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidat*innen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!
